361class FExecuteConcurrentWithSlateTickTask
362{
363 TFunction<void()> TickWithSlate;
364
365public:
366
367 FExecuteConcurrentWithSlateTickTask(TFunction<void()> InTickWithSlate, FEvent* InCompleteEvent)
368 : TickWithSlate(InTickWithSlate)
369 , CompleteEvent(InCompleteEvent)
370 {
371 check(CompleteEvent);
372 }
373
374 static FORCEINLINE TStatId GetStatId()
375 {
376 RETURN_QUICK_DECLARE_CYCLE_STAT(FExecuteConcurrentWithSlateTickTask, STATGROUP_TaskGraphTasks);
377 }
378
379 static FORCEINLINE ENamedThreads::Type GetDesiredThread()
380 {
381 return CPrio_AsyncEndOfFrameGameTasks.Get();
382 }

384 static FORCEINLINE ESubsequentsMode::Type GetSubsequentsMode() { return ESubsequentsMode::TrackSubsequents; }
385
386 void DoTask(ENamedThreads::Type CurrentThread, const FGraphEventRef& MyCompletionGraphEvent)
387 {
388 TickWithSlate();
389 CompleteEvent->Trigger();
390 }
391
392private:
393 FEvent* CompleteEvent;
394};

396// Exits the game/editor if any of the specified phrases appears in the log output
397class FOutputDeviceTestExit : public FOutputDevice
398{
399 TArray<FString> ExitPhrases;
400 FString* FoundExitPhrase = nullptr;
401public:
402 FOutputDeviceTestExit(TArray<FString>&& InExitPhrases)
403 : ExitPhrases(InExitPhrases)
404 {
405 }
406 virtual ~FOutputDeviceTestExit()
407 {
408 }
409 bool RequestExit() { return !IsEngineExitRequested() && FoundExitPhrase; }
410 FString RequestExitPhrase() { return FoundExitPhrase ? *FoundExitPhrase : FString(); }
411 virtual void Serialize(const TCHAR* V, ELogVerbosity::Type Verbosity, const class FName& Category) override
412 {
413 if (FoundExitPhrase || IsEngineExitRequested())
414 {
415 return;
416 }
417
418 for (auto& Phrase : ExitPhrases)
419 {
420 // look for the exit phrase, but ignore the output of the actual commandline string
421 if (FCString::Stristr(V, *Phrase) && !FCString::Stristr(V, TEXT("-testexit=")))
422 {
423 FoundExitPhrase = &Phrase;
424 break;
425 }
426 }
427 }
428};

430#if WITH_ENGINE && WITH_EDITOR
431static FAutoConsoleCommand CmdRunCommandlet(
432 TEXT("RunCommandlet"),
433 TEXT("<Commandlet> <Args...>. NOTE: This is for debugging/iteration purposes only! Running commandlets multiple times in an editor session may result in issues!"),
434 FConsoleCommandWithArgsDelegate::CreateLambda( [](const TArray<FString>& Args)
435 {
436 if ( Args.Num() == 0 )
437 {
438 UE_LOGF(LogInit, Error, "Need to specify a commandlet name to run!");
439 return;
440 }
441
442 FString CommandletName = Args[0];
443 UClass* CommandletClass = nullptr;
444
445 CommandletClass = Cast<UClass>(StaticFindFirstObject(UClass::StaticClass(), *CommandletName, EFindFirstObjectOptions::None, ELogVerbosity::Warning, TEXT("looking for commandlet")));
446 int32 PeriodIdx;
447 if (!CommandletClass && CommandletName.FindChar('.', PeriodIdx))
448 {
449 // try to load module for commandlet specified before a period.
450 FModuleManager::Get().LoadModule(*CommandletName.Left(PeriodIdx));
451 CommandletClass = FindFirstObject<UClass>(*CommandletName, EFindFirstObjectOptions::None, ELogVerbosity::Warning, TEXT("Looking for commandlet class"));
452 }
453 if (!CommandletClass)
454 {
455 UE_LOGF(LogInit, Error, "Commandlet class '%ls' not found!", *CommandletName);
456 return;
457 }
458 TStrongObjectPtr<UCommandlet> Commandlet( NewObject<UCommandlet>(GetTransientPackage(), CommandletClass) );
459
460 // Execute the commandlet.
461 double CommandletExecutionStartTime = FPlatformTime::Seconds();
462
463 // Commandlets don't always handle -run= properly in the commandline so we'll provide them
464 // with a custom version that doesn't have it.
465 TArray<FString> CmdlineArgs = Args;
466 CmdlineArgs.RemoveAt(0);
467 FString CommandletCommandLine = FString::Join(CmdlineArgs, TEXT(" "));
468 Commandlet->ParseParms(*CommandletCommandLine);
469
470 PRIVATE_GRunningCommandletClass = CommandletClass;
471
472 {
473 SCOPED_NAMED_EVENT_TEXT("FCoreDelegates::OnCommandletPreMain", CoreDelegatesColor);
474 FCoreDelegates::OnCommandletPreMain.Broadcast();
475 }
476
477 int32 ErrorLevel;
478 {
479 TRACE_CPUPROFILER_EVENT_SCOPE_TEXT(*WriteToString<512>(TEXT("Commandlet Main "), Commandlet->GetFName()));
480 FTrackedActivityScope CommandletActivity(FTrackedActivity::GetEngineActivity(), *FString::Printf(TEXT("Running %s"), *Commandlet->GetName()), false, FTrackedActivity::ELight::Green);
481 ErrorLevel = Commandlet->Main(CommandletCommandLine);
482 }
483
484 {
485 SCOPED_NAMED_EVENT_TEXT("FCoreDelegates::OnCommandletPostMain", CoreDelegatesColor);
486 FCoreDelegates::OnCommandletPostMain.Broadcast();
487 }
488
489 PRIVATE_GRunningCommandletClass = nullptr;
490
491 double CommandletExecutionTime = FPlatformTime::Seconds() - CommandletExecutionStartTime;
492 UE_LOG(LogInit, Display, LINE_TERMINATOR TEXT("Commandlet returned %d. Execution time: %.2f seconds"), ErrorLevel, CommandletExecutionTime);
493 })
494 );
495#endif

497#if defined(WITH_LAUNCHERCHECK) && defined(WITH_LAUNCHERCHECK_PAKVERIFY) && WITH_LAUNCHERCHECK && WITH_LAUNCHERCHECK_PAKVERIFY
498struct FPakValidator
499{
500 explicit FPakValidator()
501 {
502 Handle = FCoreDelegates::PakFileMountFailedDelegate.AddLambda([this](const FString& InError) { PakMountErrors.Add(InError); });
503 }
504
505 ~FPakValidator()
506 {
507 FCoreDelegates::PakFileMountFailedDelegate.Remove(Handle);
508 }
509
510 bool HasPakMountFailed() const { return !PakMountErrors.IsEmpty(); }
511
512 void HandlePakMountError()
513 {
514 UE_LOGF(LogInit, Warning, "Corrupt or missing files detected: %ls", *FString::Join(PakMountErrors, TEXT(", ")));
515 const FText DialogTitle = LOCTEXT("Error.CorruptInstall.Title", "Corrupt/missing files detected");
516
517 if (ILauncherCheckModule::Get().WasRanFromLauncher())
518 {
519 bool bRunVerifyInstallation = FMessageDialog::Open(
520 EAppMsgCategory::Error,
521 EAppMsgType::YesNo,
522 EAppReturnType::No,
523 LOCTEXT("Error.CorruptInstall.VerifyLauncher", "Corrupt or missing files detected. \n\nDo you want to verify your installation?"),
524 DialogTitle
525 ) == EAppReturnType::Yes;
526
527 if (bRunVerifyInstallation)
528 {
529 ILauncherCheckModule::Get().RunLauncher(ELauncherAction::AppVerifyInstallation);
530 }
531 RequestEngineExit(TEXT("Corrupt files detected; running verify in launcher"));
532 }
533 else
534 {
535#if UE_BUILD_SHIPPING
536 FMessageDialog::Open(
537 EAppMsgCategory::Error,
538 EAppMsgType::Ok,
539 LOCTEXT("Error.CorruptInstall", "Corrupt or missing files detected. Please verify your installation."),
540 DialogTitle
541 );
542 RequestEngineExit(TEXT("Corrupt or missing files detected; exiting"));
543#else
544 constexpr int MAX_PAK_ERRORS { 10 };
545 const FString TruncatedMessage = PakMountErrors.Num() > MAX_PAK_ERRORS ? FString::Format(TEXT("(showing first {0} errors)"), { MAX_PAK_ERRORS }) : TEXT("");
546 const TConstArrayView<FString> PakMountErrorsSubset = MakeArrayView(PakMountErrors).Slice(0, FMath::Min(MAX_PAK_ERRORS, PakMountErrors.Num()));
547 const FString Message = FString::Format(TEXT("Corrupt or missing files detected {0}:\n{1}\n\nWould you like to continue loading anyway?"),
548 { TruncatedMessage, FString::Join(PakMountErrorsSubset, TEXT("\n")) } );
549
550 bool bRequestExit = FMessageDialog::Open(
551 EAppMsgCategory::Error,
552 EAppMsgType::YesNo,
553 EAppReturnType::No,
554 FText::FromString(Message),
555 DialogTitle
556 ) == EAppReturnType::No;
557
558 if (bRequestExit)
559 {
560 RequestEngineExit(TEXT("Corrupt or missing files detected; exiting"));
561 }
562#endif
563 }
564 }
565
566private:
567 FDelegateHandle Handle;
568 TArray<FString> PakMountErrors;
569};
570
571#else
572struct FPakValidator
573{
574 void HandlePakMountError() {}
575 bool HasPakMountFailed() const { return false; }
576};
577
578#endif

599bool ParseGameProjectFromCommandLine(const TCHAR* InCmdLine, FString& OutProjectFilePath, FString& OutGameName)
600{
601 FString ProjectFilePathOption;
602
603 const TCHAR *CmdLine = InCmdLine;
604 bool ParseProjectOptionResult = FParse::Value(CmdLine, TEXT("project="), ProjectFilePathOption);
605 FString FirstCommandLineToken = FParse::Token(CmdLine, 0);
606
607 // trim any whitespace at edges of string - this can happen if the token was quoted with leading or trailing whitespace
608 // VC++ tends to do this in its "external tools" config
609 FirstCommandLineToken.TrimStartInline();
610
611 // Output parameters
612 OutProjectFilePath = TEXT("");
613 OutGameName = TEXT("");
614
615 if ( ( FirstCommandLineToken.Len() && !FirstCommandLineToken.StartsWith(TEXT("-"))) || ParseProjectOptionResult)
616 {
617 // The first command line argument could be the project file if it exists or the game name if not launching with a project file
618 FString ProjectFilePath = ProjectFilePathOption.IsEmpty() ? FString(FirstCommandLineToken) : ProjectFilePathOption;
619 if ( FPaths::GetExtension(ProjectFilePath) == FProjectDescriptor::GetExtension() )
620 {
621 OutProjectFilePath = ProjectFilePath;
622 // Here we derive the game name from the project file
623 OutGameName = FPaths::GetBaseFilename(OutProjectFilePath);
624 return true;
625 }
626 else if (FPaths::IsRelative(ProjectFilePath) && FPlatformProperties::IsMonolithicBuild() == false && FPlatformProperties::IsMergedModulesBuild() == false)
627 {
628 // Full game name is assumed to be the first token
629 OutGameName = MoveTemp(ProjectFilePath);
630 // Derive the project path from the game name. All games must have a uproject file, even if they are in the root folder.
631 OutProjectFilePath = FPaths::Combine(*FPaths::RootDir(), *OutGameName, *FString(OutGameName + TEXT(".") + FProjectDescriptor::GetExtension()));
632 return true;
633 }
634 }
635
636#if WITH_EDITOR && WITH_ENGINE
637 if (FEditorCommandLineUtils::ParseGameProjectPath(InCmdLine, OutProjectFilePath, OutGameName))
638 {
639 return true;
640 }
641#endif
642 return false;
643}

645#if WITH_EDITOR
646bool ReadInstalledProjectPath(FString& OutProjFilePath)
647{
648 if(FApp::IsInstalled())
649 {
650 FString ProjFilePath;
651 if (FFileHelper::LoadFileToString(ProjFilePath, *(FPaths::RootDir() / TEXT("Engine/Build/InstalledProjectBuild.txt"))))
652 {
653 ProjFilePath.TrimStartAndEndInline();
654 if(ProjFilePath.Len() > 0)
655 {
656 OutProjFilePath = FPaths::RootDir() / ProjFilePath;
657 FPaths::NormalizeFilename(OutProjFilePath);
658 return true;
659 }
660 }
661 }
662 return false;
663}
664#endif

666bool LaunchSetGameName(const TCHAR *InCmdLine, FString& OutGameProjectFilePathUnnormalized)
667{
668 if (GIsGameAgnosticExe)
669 {
670 // Initialize GameName to an empty string. Populate it below.
671 FApp::SetProjectName(TEXT(""));
672
673 FString ProjFilePath;
674 FString LocalGameName;
675 if (ParseGameProjectFromCommandLine(InCmdLine, ProjFilePath, LocalGameName) == true)
676 {
677 // Only set the game name if this is NOT a program...
678 if (FPlatformProperties::IsProgram() == false)
679 {
680 FApp::SetProjectName(*LocalGameName);
681 }
682 OutGameProjectFilePathUnnormalized = ProjFilePath;
683 FPaths::SetProjectFilePath(ProjFilePath);
684 }
685#if WITH_EDITOR
686 else if(ReadInstalledProjectPath(ProjFilePath))
687 {
688 // Only set the game name if this is NOT a program...
689 if (FPlatformProperties::IsProgram() == false)
690 {
691 FApp::SetProjectName(*FPaths::GetBaseFilename(ProjFilePath));
692 }
693 OutGameProjectFilePathUnnormalized = ProjFilePath;
694 FPaths::SetProjectFilePath(ProjFilePath);
695 }
696#endif
697#if UE_GAME
698 else
699 {
700 // Try to use the executable name as the game name.
701 LocalGameName = FPlatformProcess::ExecutableName();
702 int32 FirstCharToRemove = INDEX_NONE;
703 if (LocalGameName.FindChar(TCHAR('-'), FirstCharToRemove))
704 {
705 LocalGameName.LeftInline(FirstCharToRemove, EAllowShrinking::No);
706 }
707 FApp::SetProjectName(*LocalGameName);
708
709 // Check it's not UnrealGame, otherwise assume a uproject file relative to the game project directory
710 if (LocalGameName != TEXT("UnrealGame"))
711 {
712 ProjFilePath = FPaths::Combine(TEXT(".."), TEXT(".."), TEXT(".."), *LocalGameName, *FString(LocalGameName + TEXT(".") + FProjectDescriptor::GetExtension()));
713 OutGameProjectFilePathUnnormalized = ProjFilePath;
714 FPaths::SetProjectFilePath(ProjFilePath);
715 }
716 }
717#endif
718
719 static bool bPrinted = false;
720 if (!bPrinted)
721 {
722 bPrinted = true;
723 if (FApp::HasProjectName())
724 {
725 UE_LOGF(LogInit, Display, "Running engine for game: %ls", FApp::GetProjectName());
726 }
727 else
728 {
729 if (FPlatformProperties::RequiresCookedData())
730 {
731 UE_LOGF(LogInit, Fatal, "Non-agnostic games on cooked platforms require a uproject file be specified.");
732 }
733 else
734 {
735 UE_LOGF(LogInit, Display, "Running engine without a game");
736 }
737 }
738 }
739 }
740 else
741 {
742 FString ProjFilePath;
743 FString LocalGameName;
744 if (ParseGameProjectFromCommandLine(InCmdLine, ProjFilePath, LocalGameName) == true)
745 {
746 if (FPlatformProperties::RequiresCookedData())
747 {
748 // Non-agnostic exes that require cooked data cannot load projects, so make sure that the LocalGameName is the GameName
749 if (LocalGameName != FApp::GetProjectName())
750 {
751 UE_LOGF(LogInit, Fatal, "Non-agnostic games cannot load projects on cooked platforms - expected [%ls], found [%ls]", FApp::GetProjectName(), *LocalGameName);
752 }
753 }
754 // Only set the game name if this is NOT a program...
755 if (FPlatformProperties::IsProgram() == false)
756 {
757 FApp::SetProjectName(*LocalGameName);
758 }
759 OutGameProjectFilePathUnnormalized = ProjFilePath;
760 FPaths::SetProjectFilePath(ProjFilePath);
761 }
762
763 // In a non-game agnostic exe, the game name should already be assigned by now.
764 if (!FApp::HasProjectName())
765 {
766 UE_LOGF(LogInit, Fatal,"Could not set game name!");
767 }
768 }
769
770 return true;
771}

783void LaunchFixGameNameCase()
784{
785#if PLATFORM_DESKTOP && !IS_PROGRAM
786 // This is to make sure this function is not misused and is only called when the game name is set
787 check(FApp::HasProjectName());
788
789 // correct the case of the game name, if possible (unless we're running a program and the game name is already set)
790 if (FPaths::IsProjectFilePathSet())
791 {
792 const FString GameName(FPaths::GetBaseFilename(FPaths::GetProjectFilePath()));
793
794 const bool bGameNameMatchesProjectCaseSensitive = (FCString::Strcmp(*GameName, FApp::GetProjectName()) == 0);
795 if (!bGameNameMatchesProjectCaseSensitive && (FApp::IsProjectNameEmpty() || GIsGameAgnosticExe || (GameName.Len() > 0 && GIsGameAgnosticExe)))
796 {
797 if (GameName == FApp::GetProjectName()) // case insensitive compare
798 {
799 FApp::SetProjectName(*GameName);
800 }
801 else
802 {
803 const FText Message = FText::Format(
804 NSLOCTEXT("Core", "MismatchedGameNames", "The name of the .uproject file ('{0}') must match the name of the project passed in the command line ('{1}')."),
805 FText::FromString(*GameName),
806 FText::FromString(FApp::GetProjectName()));
807 if (!GIsBuildMachine)
808 {
809 UE_LOGF(LogInit, Warning, "%ls", *Message.ToString());
810 FMessageDialog::Open(EAppMsgType::Ok, Message);
811 }
812 FApp::SetProjectName(TEXT("")); // this disables part of the crash reporter to avoid writing log files to a bogus directory
813 if (!GIsBuildMachine)
814 {
815 exit(1);
816 }
817 UE_LOGF(LogInit, Fatal, "%ls", *Message.ToString());
818 }
819 }
820 }
821#endif //PLATFORM_DESKTOP
822}

825static IPlatformFile* ConditionallyCreateFileWrapper(const TCHAR* Name, IPlatformFile* CurrentPlatformFile, const TCHAR* CommandLine, bool* OutFailedToInitialize = nullptr, bool* bOutShouldBeUsed = nullptr )
826{
827 if (OutFailedToInitialize)
828 {
829 *OutFailedToInitialize = false;
830 }
831 if ( bOutShouldBeUsed )
832 {
833 *bOutShouldBeUsed = false;
834 }
835 IPlatformFile* WrapperFile = FPlatformFileManager::Get().GetPlatformFile(Name);
836 if (WrapperFile != nullptr && WrapperFile->ShouldBeUsed(CurrentPlatformFile, CommandLine))
837 {
838 if ( bOutShouldBeUsed )
839 {
840 *bOutShouldBeUsed = true;
841 }
842 if (WrapperFile->Initialize(CurrentPlatformFile, CommandLine) == false)
843 {
844 if (OutFailedToInitialize)
845 {
846 *OutFailedToInitialize = true;
847 }
848 // Don't delete the platform file. It will be automatically deleted by its module.
849 WrapperFile = nullptr;
850 }
851 }
852 else
853 {
854 // Make sure it won't be used.
855 WrapperFile = nullptr;
856 }
857 return WrapperFile;
858}

860
864bool LaunchCheckForFileOverride(const TCHAR* CmdLine, bool& OutFileOverrideFound)
865{
866 OutFileOverrideFound = false;
867
868 // Get the physical platform file.
869 IPlatformFile* CurrentPlatformFile = &FPlatformFileManager::Get().GetPlatformFile();
870
871 // NetworkPlatformFile can be only one of StorageServerClient, StreamingFile or NetworkFile
872 // Having a NetworkPlatformFile present prevents creation of Pakfile, CachedReadFile and SandboxFile
873 IPlatformFile* NetworkPlatformFile = nullptr;
874
875#if !UE_BUILD_SHIPPING
876 if (!NetworkPlatformFile)
877 {
878 NetworkPlatformFile = ConditionallyCreateFileWrapper(TEXT("StorageServerClient"), CurrentPlatformFile, CmdLine);
879 if (NetworkPlatformFile)
880 {
881 CurrentPlatformFile = NetworkPlatformFile;
882 FPlatformFileManager::Get().SetPlatformFile(*CurrentPlatformFile);
883 // pak streaming currently needs this to be the PlatformPhysical, although it can potentially
884 // cause issues for other code that assumes PlatformPhysical only refers to the absolute lowest
885 // level for the platform
886 if (UE::IsUsingZenPakFileStreaming())
887 {
888 FPlatformFileManager::Get().SetPlatformPhysical(*CurrentPlatformFile);
889 }
890 }
891 }
892
893 // Streaming network wrapper (it has a priority over normal network wrapper)
894 bool bShouldInitializeNetwork = !NetworkPlatformFile;
895 while (bShouldInitializeNetwork)
896 {
897 bool bShouldUseStreamingFile = false;
898 NetworkPlatformFile = ConditionallyCreateFileWrapper(TEXT("StreamingFile"), CurrentPlatformFile, CmdLine, &bShouldInitializeNetwork, &bShouldUseStreamingFile);
899 if (NetworkPlatformFile)
900 {
901 CurrentPlatformFile = NetworkPlatformFile;
902 FPlatformFileManager::Get().SetPlatformFile(*CurrentPlatformFile);
903 }
904
905 // if streaming network platform file was tried this loop don't try this one
906 // Network file wrapper (only create if the streaming wrapper hasn't been created)
907 if (!bShouldUseStreamingFile && !NetworkPlatformFile)
908 {
909 NetworkPlatformFile = ConditionallyCreateFileWrapper(TEXT("NetworkFile"), CurrentPlatformFile, CmdLine, &bShouldInitializeNetwork);
910 if (NetworkPlatformFile)
911 {
912 CurrentPlatformFile = NetworkPlatformFile;
913 FPlatformFileManager::Get().SetPlatformFile(*CurrentPlatformFile);
914 }
915 }
916
917 if (bShouldInitializeNetwork)
918 {
919 FString HostIpString;
920 FParse::Value(CmdLine, TEXT("-FileHostIP="), HostIpString);
921#if PLATFORM_REQUIRES_FILESERVER
922 FPlatformMisc::LowLevelOutputDebugStringf(TEXT("Failed to connect to file server at %s. RETRYING in 5s.\n"), *HostIpString);
923 FPlatformProcess::Sleep(5.0f);
924 constexpr uint32 Result = 2;
925#else //PLATFORM_REQUIRES_FILESERVER
926 // note that this can't be localized because it happens before we connect to a filserver - localizing would cause ICU to try to load.... from over the file server connection!
927 FString Error = FString::Printf(TEXT("Failed to connect to any of the following file servers:\n\n %s\n\nWould you like to try again? No will fallback to local disk files, Cancel will quit."), *HostIpString.Replace( TEXT("+"), TEXT("\n ")));
928 uint32 Result = FMessageDialog::Open( EAppMsgType::YesNoCancel, FText::FromString( Error ) );
929#endif //PLATFORM_REQUIRES_FILESERVER
930
931 if (Result == EAppReturnType::No)
932 {
933 break;
934 }
935 else if (Result == EAppReturnType::Cancel)
936 {
937 // Cancel - return a failure, and quit
938 return false;
939 }
940 }
941 }
942#endif
943 if (UE::IsUsingZenPakFileStreaming() || !NetworkPlatformFile)
944 {
945 FPakValidator Validator;
946 IPlatformFile* PlatformFile = ConditionallyCreateFileWrapper(TEXT("PakFile"), CurrentPlatformFile, CmdLine);
947 if (Validator.HasPakMountFailed())
948 {
949 Validator.HandlePakMountError();
950 if (IsEngineExitRequested())
951 {
952 return false;
953 }
954 }
955 if (PlatformFile)
956 {
957 CurrentPlatformFile = PlatformFile;
958 FPlatformFileManager::Get().SetPlatformFile(*CurrentPlatformFile);
959 }
960 }
961
962 if (!NetworkPlatformFile)
963 {
964 IPlatformFile* PlatformFile = ConditionallyCreateFileWrapper(TEXT("CachedReadFile"), CurrentPlatformFile, CmdLine);
965 if (PlatformFile)
966 {
967 CurrentPlatformFile = PlatformFile;
968 FPlatformFileManager::Get().SetPlatformFile(*CurrentPlatformFile);
969 }
970
971 PlatformFile = ConditionallyCreateFileWrapper(TEXT("SandboxFile"), CurrentPlatformFile, CmdLine);
972 if (PlatformFile)
973 {
974 CurrentPlatformFile = PlatformFile;
975 FPlatformFileManager::Get().SetPlatformFile(*CurrentPlatformFile);
976 }
977 }
978
979#if !UE_BUILD_SHIPPING
980 // Try to create file profiling wrapper
981 {
982 IPlatformFile* PlatformFile = ConditionallyCreateFileWrapper(TEXT("ProfileFile"), CurrentPlatformFile, CmdLine);
983 if (PlatformFile)
984 {
985 CurrentPlatformFile = PlatformFile;
986 FPlatformFileManager::Get().SetPlatformFile(*CurrentPlatformFile);
987 }
988 }
989 {
990 IPlatformFile* PlatformFile = ConditionallyCreateFileWrapper(TEXT("SimpleProfileFile"), CurrentPlatformFile, CmdLine);
991 if (PlatformFile)
992 {
993 CurrentPlatformFile = PlatformFile;
994 FPlatformFileManager::Get().SetPlatformFile(*CurrentPlatformFile);
995 }
996 }
997 // Try and create file timings stats wrapper
998 {
999 IPlatformFile* PlatformFile = ConditionallyCreateFileWrapper(TEXT("FileReadStats"), CurrentPlatformFile, CmdLine);
1000 if (PlatformFile)
1001 {
1002 CurrentPlatformFile = PlatformFile;
1003 FPlatformFileManager::Get().SetPlatformFile(*CurrentPlatformFile);
1004 }
1005 }
1006 // Try and create file open log wrapper (lists the order files are first opened)
1007 {
1008 IPlatformFile* PlatformFile = ConditionallyCreateFileWrapper(TEXT("FileOpenLog"), CurrentPlatformFile, CmdLine);
1009 if (PlatformFile)
1010 {
1011 CurrentPlatformFile = PlatformFile;
1012 FPlatformFileManager::Get().SetPlatformFile(*CurrentPlatformFile);
1013 }
1014 }
1015#endif //#if !UE_BUILD_SHIPPING
1016
1017 // Wrap the above in a file logging singleton if requested
1018 {
1019 IPlatformFile* PlatformFile = ConditionallyCreateFileWrapper(TEXT("LogFile"), CurrentPlatformFile, CmdLine);
1020 if (PlatformFile)
1021 {
1022 CurrentPlatformFile = PlatformFile;
1023 FPlatformFileManager::Get().SetPlatformFile(*CurrentPlatformFile);
1024 }
1025 }
1026
1027 // If our platform file is different than it was when we started, then an override was used
1028 OutFileOverrideFound = (CurrentPlatformFile != &FPlatformFileManager::Get().GetPlatformFile());
1029
1030 // Report if Zen streaming is in use now that configuration is complete.
1031 CSV_METADATA(TEXT("ZenStreaming"), FPlatformFileManager::Get().FindPlatformFile(TEXT("StorageServer")) == nullptr ? TEXT("0") : TEXT("1"));
1032
1033 return true;
1034}

1036#if !UE_BUILD_SHIPPING
1041void LaunchCheckForCommandLineAliases(const FConfigFile& Config, TArray<FString>& PrevExpansions, bool& bChanged)
1042{
1043 bChanged = false;
1044
1045 if (const FConfigSection* Section = Config.FindSection(TEXT("CommandLineAliases")))
1046 {
1047 TArray<FString> Tokens;
1048 {
1049 const TCHAR* Stream = FCommandLine::Get();
1050 FString NextToken;
1051 while (FParse::Token(Stream, NextToken, false))
1052 {
1053 Tokens.Add(NextToken);
1054 }
1055 }
1056
1057 for (FConfigSection::TConstIterator ConfigIt(*Section); ConfigIt; ++ConfigIt)
1058 {
1059 FString Key = FString("-") + ConfigIt.Key().ToString();
1060 TArray<FString>::TIterator TokenIt(Tokens);
1061 while (TokenIt)
1062 {
1063 if (PrevExpansions.Contains(*TokenIt))
1064 {
1065 TokenIt.RemoveCurrent();
1066 bChanged = true;
1067 continue;
1068 }
1069
1070 if (*TokenIt == Key)
1071 {
1072 PrevExpansions.Add(MoveTemp(*TokenIt));
1073 *TokenIt = ConfigIt.Value().GetValue();
1074 bChanged = true;
1075 }
1076
1077 ++TokenIt;
1078 }
1079 }
1080
1081 if (bChanged)
1082 {
1083 FString NewCommandLine = FString::Join(Tokens, TEXT(" "));
1084 FCommandLine::Set(*NewCommandLine);
1085 }
1086 }
1087}
1088
1093void LaunchCheckForCmdLineFile(TArray<FString>& PrevExpansions, bool& bChanged)
1094{
1095 bChanged = false;
1096
1097 auto RemoveExpansion = [&bChanged]()
1098 {
1099 FString NewCommandLine = FCommandLine::Get();
1100 FString Left;
1101 FString Right;
1102 if (NewCommandLine.Split(TEXT("-CmdLineFile="), &Left, &Right))
1103 {
1104 FString NextToken;
1105 const TCHAR* Stream = *Right;
1106 if (FParse::Token(Stream, NextToken, /*bUseEscape=*/ false))
1107 {
1108 Right = FString(Stream);
1109 }
1110
1111 NewCommandLine = Left + TEXT(" ") + Right;
1112 NewCommandLine.TrimStartAndEndInline();
1113 FCommandLine::Set(*NewCommandLine);
1114 bChanged = true;
1115 }
1116 };
1117
1118 auto TryProcessFile = [&RemoveExpansion, &bChanged](const FString& InFilePath)
1119 {
1120 FString FileCmds;
1121 if (FFileHelper::LoadFileToString(FileCmds, *InFilePath))
1122 {
1123 UE_LOGF(LogInit, Log, "Inserting commandline from file: %ls, %ls", *InFilePath, *FileCmds);
1124
1125 FileCmds = FileCmds.TrimStartAndEnd();
1126 if (FileCmds.Len() == 0)
1127 {
1128 RemoveExpansion();
1129 return true;
1130 }
1131
1132 FString NewCommandLine = FCommandLine::Get();
1133 FString Left;
1134 FString Right;
1135 if (NewCommandLine.Split(TEXT("-CmdLineFile="), &Left, &Right))
1136 {
1137 FString NextToken;
1138 const TCHAR* Stream = *Right;
1139 if (FParse::Token(Stream, NextToken, /*bUseEscape=*/ false))
1140 {
1141 Right = FString(Stream);
1142 }
1143
1144 NewCommandLine = Left + TEXT(" ") + FileCmds + TEXT(" ") + Right;
1145 NewCommandLine.TrimStartAndEndInline();
1146 FCommandLine::Set(*NewCommandLine);
1147 bChanged = true;
1148 return true;
1149 }
1150 }
1151
1152 return false;
1153 };
1154
1155 FString CmdLineFile;
1156 while (FParse::Value(FCommandLine::Get(), TEXT("-CmdLineFile="), CmdLineFile))
1157 {
1158 if (!CmdLineFile.EndsWith(TEXT(".txt")))
1159 {
1160 UE_LOGF(LogInit, Warning, "Can only load commandline files ending with .txt, can't load: %ls", *CmdLineFile);
1161 RemoveExpansion();
1162 continue;
1163 }
1164
1165 if (PrevExpansions.Contains(CmdLineFile))
1166 {
1167 // If already expanded, just remove it
1168 RemoveExpansion();
1169 continue;
1170 }
1171
1172 bool bFoundFile = TryProcessFile(CmdLineFile);
1173 if (!bFoundFile && FPaths::ProjectDir().Len() > 0)
1174 {
1175 const FString ProjectDir = FPaths::ProjectDir();
1176 bFoundFile = TryProcessFile(ProjectDir + CmdLineFile);
1177 if (!bFoundFile)
1178 {
1179 const FString ProjectPluginsDir = ProjectDir + TEXT("Plugins/");
1180 TArray<FString> DirectoryNames;
1181 IFileManager::Get().IterateDirectory(*ProjectPluginsDir, [&](const TCHAR* FilenameOrDirectory, bool bIsDirectory) -> bool
1182 {
1183 if (bIsDirectory && TryProcessFile(FString(FilenameOrDirectory) + TEXT("/") + CmdLineFile))
1184 {
1185 bFoundFile = true;
1186 return false;
1187 }
1188 return true;
1189 });
1190 }
1191 }
1192
1193 if (!bFoundFile)
1194 {
1195 UE_LOGF(LogInit, Warning, "Failed to load commandline file '%ls'.", *CmdLineFile);
1196 RemoveExpansion();
1197 continue;
1198 }
1199
1200 PrevExpansions.Add(MoveTemp(CmdLineFile));
1201 }
1202}
1203#endif

1205bool LaunchHasIncompleteGameName()
1206{
1207 if ( FApp::HasProjectName() && !FPaths::IsProjectFilePathSet() )
1208 {
1209 // Verify this is a legitimate game name
1210 // Launched with a game name. See if the <GameName> folder exists. If it doesn't, it could instead be <GameName>Game
1211 const FString NonSuffixedGameFolder = FPaths::RootDir() / FApp::GetProjectName();
1212 if (FPlatformFileManager::Get().GetPlatformFile().DirectoryExists(*NonSuffixedGameFolder) == false)
1213 {
1214 const FString SuffixedGameFolder = NonSuffixedGameFolder + TEXT("Game");
1215 if (FPlatformFileManager::Get().GetPlatformFile().DirectoryExists(*SuffixedGameFolder))
1216 {
1217 return true;
1218 }
1219 }
1220 }
1221
1222 return false;
1223}

1226void LaunchUpdateMostRecentProjectFile()
1227{
1228 // If we are launching without a game name or project file, we should use the last used project file, if it exists
1229 const FString& AutoLoadProjectFileName = IProjectManager::Get().GetAutoLoadProjectFileName();
1230 FString RecentProjectFileContents;
1231 if ( FFileHelper::LoadFileToString(RecentProjectFileContents, *AutoLoadProjectFileName) )
1232 {
1233 if ( RecentProjectFileContents.Len() )
1234 {
1235 const FString AutoLoadInProgressFilename = AutoLoadProjectFileName + TEXT(".InProgress");
1236 if ( FPlatformFileManager::Get().GetPlatformFile().FileExists(*AutoLoadInProgressFilename) )
1237 {
1238 // We attempted to auto-load a project but the last run did not make it to UEditorEngine::InitEditor.
1239 // This indicates that there was a problem loading the project.
1240 // Do not auto-load the project, instead load normally until the next time the editor starts successfully.
1241 UE_LOGF(LogInit, Display, "There was a problem auto-loading %ls. Auto-load will be disabled until the editor successfully starts up with a project.", *RecentProjectFileContents);
1242 }
1243 else if ( FPlatformFileManager::Get().GetPlatformFile().FileExists(*RecentProjectFileContents) )
1244 {
1245 // The previously loaded project file was found. Change the game name here and update the project file path
1246 FApp::SetProjectName(*FPaths::GetBaseFilename(RecentProjectFileContents));
1247 FPaths::SetProjectFilePath(RecentProjectFileContents);
1248 UE_LOGF(LogInit, Display, "Loading recent project file: %ls", *RecentProjectFileContents);
1249
1250 // Write a file indicating that we are trying to auto-load a project.
1251 // This file prevents auto-loading of projects for as long as it exists. It is a detection system for failed auto-loads.
1252 // The file is deleted in UEditorEngine::InitEditor, thus if the load does not make it that far then the project will not be loaded again.
1253 FFileHelper::SaveStringToFile(TEXT(""), *AutoLoadInProgressFilename);
1254 }
1255 }
1256 }
1257}

1265#if !UE_BUILD_SHIPPING
1266class FFileInPakFileHistoryHelper
1267{
1268private:
1269 struct FFileInPakFileHistory
1270 {
1271 FString PakFileName;
1272 FString FileName;
1273 };
1274 friend uint32 GetTypeHash(const FFileInPakFileHistory& H)
1275 {
1276 uint32 Hash = GetTypeHash(H.PakFileName);
1277 Hash = HashCombine(Hash, GetTypeHash(H.FileName));
1278 return Hash;
1279 }
1280 friend bool operator==(const FFileInPakFileHistory& A, const FFileInPakFileHistory& B)
1281 {
1282 return A.PakFileName == B.PakFileName && A.FileName == B.FileName;
1283 }
1284
1285 TSet<FFileInPakFileHistory> History;
1286 FCriticalSection HistoryLock;
1287
1288 void OnFileOpenedForRead(const TCHAR* PakFileName, const TCHAR* FileName)
1289 {
1290 //UE_LOGF(LogInit, Warning, "OnFileOpenedForRead %u: %ls - %ls", FPlatformTLS::GetCurrentThreadId(), PakFileName, FileName);
1291
1292 FScopeLock ScopeLock(&HistoryLock);
1293 History.Emplace(FFileInPakFileHistory{ PakFileName, FileName });
1294 }
1295
1296public:
1297 FFileInPakFileHistoryHelper()
1298 {
1299 FCoreDelegates::GetOnFileOpenedForReadFromPakFile().AddRaw(this, &FFileInPakFileHistoryHelper::OnFileOpenedForRead);
1300 }
1301
1302 ~FFileInPakFileHistoryHelper()
1303 {
1304 FCoreDelegates::GetOnFileOpenedForReadFromPakFile().RemoveAll(this);
1305 }
1306
1307 void DumpHistory()
1308 {
1309 FScopeLock ScopeLock(&HistoryLock);
1310
1311 History.Sort([](const FFileInPakFileHistory& A, const FFileInPakFileHistory& B)
1312 {
1313 if (A.PakFileName == B.PakFileName)
1314 {
1315 return A.FileName < B.FileName;
1316 }
1317
1318 return A.PakFileName < B.PakFileName;
1319 });
1320
1321 const FString SavePath = FPaths::ProjectLogDir() / TEXT("FilesLoadedFromPakFiles.csv");
1322
1323 FArchive* Writer = IFileManager::Get().CreateFileWriter(*SavePath, FILEWRITE_NoFail);
1324
1325 auto WriteLine = [Writer](FString&& Line)
1326 {
1327 UE_LOGF(LogInit, Display, "%ls", *Line);
1328 FTCHARToUTF8 UTF8String(*(MoveTemp(Line) + LINE_TERMINATOR));
1329 Writer->Serialize((UTF8CHAR*)UTF8String.Get(), UTF8String.Length());
1330 };
1331
1332 UE_LOGF(LogInit, Display, "Dumping History of files read from Paks to %ls", *SavePath);
1333 UE_LOGF(LogInit, Display, "Begin History of files read from Paks");
1334 UE_LOGF(LogInit, Display, "------------------------------------------------------");
1335 WriteLine(FString::Printf(TEXT("PakFile, File")));
1336 for (const FFileInPakFileHistory& H : History)
1337 {
1338 WriteLine(FString::Printf(TEXT("%s, %s"), *H.PakFileName, *H.FileName));
1339 }
1340 UE_LOGF(LogInit, Display, "------------------------------------------------------");
1341 UE_LOGF(LogInit, Display, "End History of files read from Paks");
1342
1343 delete Writer;
1344 Writer = nullptr;
1345 }
1346};
1347TUniquePtr<FFileInPakFileHistoryHelper> FileInPakFileHistoryHelper;
1348#endif // !UE_BUILD_SHIPPING

1406#if WITH_ENGINE
1407bool IsServerDelegateForOSS(FName WorldContextHandle)
1408{
1409 if (IsRunningDedicatedServer())
1410 {
1411 return true;
1412 }
1413
1414 UWorld* World = nullptr;
1415#if WITH_EDITOR
1416 if (GEngine && WorldContextHandle != NAME_None)
1417 {
1418 const FWorldContext* WorldContext = GEngine->GetWorldContextFromHandle(WorldContextHandle);
1419 if (WorldContext)
1420 {
1421 check(WorldContext->WorldType == EWorldType::Game || WorldContext->WorldType == EWorldType::PIE);
1422 World = WorldContext->World();
1423 }
1424 }
1425#endif
1426
1427 if (!World)
1428 {
1429 UGameEngine* GameEngine = Cast<UGameEngine>(GEngine);
1430 if (GameEngine)
1431 {
1432 World = GameEngine->GetGameWorld();
1433 }
1434 else
1435 {
1436 // The calling code didn't pass in a world context and really should have
1437 if (GIsPlayInEditorWorld)
1438 {
1439 World = GWorld;
1440 }
1441
1442#if !WITH_DEV_AUTOMATION_TESTS
1443 // Not having a world to make the right determination is a bad thing
1444 // In the editor during PIE this will confuse the individual PIE windows and their associated online components
1445 UE_CLOGF(World == nullptr, LogInit, Error, "Failed to determine if OSS is server in PIE, OSS requests will fail");
1446#endif
1447 }
1448 }
1449
1450 ENetMode NetMode = World ? World->GetNetMode() : NM_Standalone;
1451 return (NetMode == NM_ListenServer || NetMode == NM_DedicatedServer);
1452}
1453#endif

1455#if WITH_ENGINE && CSV_PROFILER
1456static void UpdateCoreCsvStats_BeginFrame()
1457{
1458 if (FCsvProfiler::Get()->IsCapturing())
1459 {
1460 TRACE_CPUPROFILER_EVENT_SCOPE(UpdateCoreCsvStats_BeginFrame);
1461 if (!IsRunningDedicatedServer())
1462 {
1463#if !UE_BUILD_SHIPPING
1464 const uint32 ProcessId = (uint32)FPlatformProcess::GetCurrentProcessId();
1465 float ProcessUsagePercent = 0.f, IdleUsagePercent = 0.f;
1466 if (FPlatformProcess::GetPerFrameProcessorUsage(ProcessId, ProcessUsagePercent, IdleUsagePercent))
1467 {
1468 CSV_CUSTOM_STAT_GLOBAL(CPUUsage_Process, ProcessUsagePercent, ECsvCustomStatOp::Set);
1469 CSV_CUSTOM_STAT_GLOBAL(CPUUsage_Idle, IdleUsagePercent, ECsvCustomStatOp::Set);
1470 }
1471#endif
1472
1473 }
1474#if CSV_PROFILER_ALLOW_DEBUG_FEATURES
1475 // Handle CsvExecCmds for this frame
1476 if (GEngine && GWorld)
1477 {
1478 TArray<FString> FrameCommands;
1479 FCsvProfiler::Get()->GetFrameExecCommands(FrameCommands);
1480 for (FString Cmd : FrameCommands)
1481 {
1482 CSV_EVENT_GLOBAL(TEXT("CsvExecCommand : %s"), *Cmd);
1483
1484 // Try to execute on the local player
1485 bool bExecuted = false;
1486 for (FConstPlayerControllerIterator Iterator = GWorld->GetPlayerControllerIterator(); Iterator; ++Iterator)
1487 {
1488 APlayerController* PlayerController = Iterator->Get();
1489 if (PlayerController)
1490 {
1491 if (ULocalPlayer* LocalPlayer = Cast<ULocalPlayer>(PlayerController->Player))
1492 {
1493 LocalPlayer->Exec(GWorld, *Cmd, *GLog);
1494 bExecuted = true;
1495 }
1496 }
1497 }
1498 if (!bExecuted)
1499 {
1500 // Fallback to GEngine exec
1501 GEngine->Exec(GWorld, *Cmd);
1502 }
1503 }
1504 }
1505#endif // CSV_PROFILER_ALLOW_DEBUG_FEATURES
1506 }
1507}

1605static TArray<FString> TokenizeCommandline(const TCHAR* CmdLine, bool bRetainQuotes)
1606{
1607 TArray<FString> TokenArray;
1608
1609 const TCHAR* ParsedCmdLine = CmdLine;
1610
1611 while (*ParsedCmdLine)
1612 {
1613 FString Token;
1614
1615 // skip over whitespace to look for a quote
1616 while (FChar::IsWhitespace(*ParsedCmdLine))
1617 {
1618 ParsedCmdLine++;
1619 }
1620
1621 // if we want to keep quotes around the token, and the first character is a quote, then FToken::Parse
1622 // will remove the quotes, so put them back
1623 if (bRetainQuotes && (*ParsedCmdLine == TEXT('"')))
1624 {
1625 FParse::Token(ParsedCmdLine, Token, 0);
1626 Token = FString::Printf(TEXT("\"%s\""), *Token);
1627 }
1628 else
1629 {
1630 FParse::Token(ParsedCmdLine, Token, 0);
1631 Token.TrimStartAndEndInline();
1632 }
1633
1634 if (!Token.IsEmpty())
1635 {
1636 TokenArray.Add(MoveTemp(Token));
1637 }
1638 }
1639
1640 return MoveTemp(TokenArray);
1641}
1642
1644enum class EGameStringType
1645{
1646 GameName,
1647 ProjectPath,
1648 ProjectShortName,
1649 Unknown
1650};
1651
1660static FString ExtractGameStringArgument(TArray<FString>& TokenArray, TArray<FString>& QuotedTokenArray, EGameStringType& OutStringType)
1661{
1662 for (int32 I = 0; I < TokenArray.Num(); ++I)
1663 {
1664 FString NormalizedToken = TokenArray[I];
1665
1666 // Path returned by FPaths::GetProjectFilePath() is normalized, so may have symlinks and ~ resolved and may differ from the original path to .uproject passed in the command line
1667 FPaths::NormalizeFilename(NormalizedToken);
1668
1669 const bool bTokenIsGameName = (FApp::HasProjectName() && TokenArray[I] == FApp::GetProjectName());
1670 const bool bTokenIsGameProjectFilePath = (FPaths::IsProjectFilePathSet() && NormalizedToken == FPaths::GetProjectFilePath());
1671 const bool bTokenIsGameProjectFileShortName = (FPaths::IsProjectFilePathSet() && TokenArray[I] == FPaths::GetCleanFilename(FPaths::GetProjectFilePath()));
1672
1673 if (bTokenIsGameName || bTokenIsGameProjectFilePath || bTokenIsGameProjectFileShortName)
1674 {
1675 if (bTokenIsGameName)
1676 {
1677 OutStringType = EGameStringType::GameName;
1678 }
1679 else if (bTokenIsGameProjectFilePath)
1680 {
1681 OutStringType = EGameStringType::ProjectPath;
1682 }
1683 else if (bTokenIsGameProjectFileShortName)
1684 {
1685 OutStringType = EGameStringType::ProjectShortName;
1686 }
1687
1688 FString Result = TokenArray[I];
1689
1690 TokenArray.RemoveAt(I);
1691 QuotedTokenArray.RemoveAt(I);
1692
1693 return Result;
1694 }
1695 }
1696
1697 OutStringType = EGameStringType::Unknown;
1698
1699 return FString();
1700}

1725DECLARE_CYCLE_STAT(TEXT("FEngineLoop::PreInitPreStartupScreen.AfterStats"), STAT_FEngineLoop_PreInitPreStartupScreen_AfterStats, STATGROUP_LoadTime);
1726DECLARE_CYCLE_STAT(TEXT("FEngineLoop::PreInitPostStartupScreen.AfterStats"), STAT_FEngineLoop_PreInitPostStartupScreen_AfterStats, STATGROUP_LoadTime);
1727
1728int32 FEngineLoop::PreInitPreStartupScreen(const TCHAR* CmdLine)
1729{
1730 ON_SCOPE_EXIT { FBootProfiling::OnPreInitPreStartupScreenComplete(); };
1731 FDelayedAutoRegisterHelper::RunAndClearDelayedAutoRegisterDelegates(EDelayedRegisterRunPhase::StartOfEnginePreInit);
1732#if WITH_ENGINE && CSV_PROFILER
1733 // PreInit the CSV profiler as early as possible in case we're boot profiling with -csvCaptureFrames
1734 FCsvProfiler::PreInit(CmdLine);
1735#endif
1736 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("FEngineLoop::PreInitPreStartupScreen");
1737
1738 // GLog is initialized lazily and its default primary thread is the thread that initialized it.
1739 // This lazy initialization can happen during initialization of a DLL, which Windows does on a
1740 // worker thread, which makes that worker thread the primary thread. Make this the primary thread
1741 // until initialization is far enough along to try to start a dedicated primary thread.
1742 GLog->SetCurrentThreadAsPrimaryThread();
1743
1744#if IS_PROGRAM
1745 // Non-program targets have the backlog enabled by default. Enable it as early as possible here for
1746 // cases where it is disabled by default. It will be disabled when module loading is complete.
1747 // Do not disable the backlog if the program enabled it explicitly before calling PreInit().
1748 const bool bDisableBacklog = !GLog->EnableBacklog(true);
1749 ON_SCOPE_EXIT
1750 {
1751 if (bDisableBacklog)
1752 {
1753 GLog->EnableBacklog(false);
1754 }
1755 };
1756#endif
1757
1758 // Command line option for enabling named events
1759 if (FParse::Param(CmdLine, TEXT("statnamedevents")))
1760 {
1761 ++GCycleStatsShouldEmitNamedEvents;
1762 }
1763
1764 if (FParse::Param(CmdLine, TEXT("verbosenamedevents")))
1765 {
1766 ++GCycleStatsShouldEmitNamedEvents;
1767 GShouldEmitVerboseNamedEvents = true;
1768 }
1769
1770
1771 // Set the flag for whether we've build DebugGame instead of Development. The engine does not know this (whereas the launch module does) because it is always built in development.
1772#if UE_BUILD_DEVELOPMENT && defined(UE_BUILD_DEVELOPMENT_WITH_DEBUGGAME) && UE_BUILD_DEVELOPMENT_WITH_DEBUGGAME
1773 FApp::SetDebugGame(true);
1774#endif
1775
1776#if PLATFORM_WINDOWS
1777 // Register a handler for Ctrl-C so we've effective signal handling from the outset.
1778 FWindowsPlatformMisc::SetGracefulTerminationHandler();
1779#endif // PLATFORM_WINDOWS
1780
1781#if BUILD_EMBEDDED_APP
1782#ifdef EMBEDDED_LINKER_GAME_HELPER_FUNCTION
1783 extern void EMBEDDED_LINKER_GAME_HELPER_FUNCTION();
1784 EMBEDDED_LINKER_GAME_HELPER_FUNCTION();
1785#endif
1786 FEmbeddedCommunication::Init();
1787 FEmbeddedCommunication::KeepAwake(TEXT("Startup"), false);
1788#endif
1789
1790 FMemory::SetupTLSCachesOnCurrentThread();
1791
1792 FPlatformMisc::SetUTF8Output();
1793
1794#if !UE_BUILD_SHIPPING
1795 if (FParse::Param(CmdLine, TEXT("IgnoreDebugger")))
1796 {
1797 GIgnoreDebugger = true;
1798 }
1799#endif // !UE_BUILD_SHIPPING
1800
1801 // Switch into executable's directory.
1802#if !defined(DISABLE_CWD_CHANGES) || DISABLE_CWD_CHANGES==0
1803 FPlatformProcess::SetCurrentWorkingDirectoryToBaseDir();
1804#endif
1805
1806 // this is set later with shorter command lines, but we want to make sure it is set ASAP as some subsystems will do the tests themselves...
1807 // also realize that command lines can be pulled from the network at a slightly later time.
1808 if (!FCommandLine::Set(CmdLine))
1809 {
1810 // Fail, shipping builds will crash if setting command line fails
1811 return -1;
1812 }
1813
1814 // Avoiding potential exploits by not exposing command line overrides in the shipping games.
1815#if !UE_BUILD_SHIPPING && WITH_EDITORONLY_DATA
1816 // Retrieve additional command line arguments from environment variable.
1817 FString Env = FPlatformMisc::GetEnvironmentVariable(TEXT("UE-CmdLineArgs")).TrimStart();
1818 if (Env.Len())
1819 {
1820 UE_LOGF(LogInit, Log, "Inserting commandline from UE-CmdLineArgs: %ls", *Env);
1821
1822 // Append the command line environment after inserting a space as we can't set it in the
1823 // environment.
1824 FCommandLine::Append(TEXT(" -EnvAfterHere "));
1825 FCommandLine::Append(*Env);
1826 CmdLine = FCommandLine::Get();
1827 }
1828#endif
1829
1830 // Name of project file before normalization (as specified in command line).
1831 // Used to fixup project name if necessary.
1832 FString GameProjectFilePathUnnormalized;
1833
1834 {
1835 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("LaunchSetGameName");
1836
1837 // Set GameName, based on the command line
1838 if (LaunchSetGameName(CmdLine, GameProjectFilePathUnnormalized) == false)
1839 {
1840 // If it failed, do not continue
1841 return 1;
1842 }
1843 }
1844
1845 // Initialize trace
1846 FTraceAuxiliary::Initialize(CmdLine);
1847 FTraceAuxiliary::TryAutoConnect();
1848
1849 // disable/enable LLM based on commandline
1850 {
1851 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("LLM Init");
1852 LLM(FLowLevelMemTracker::Get().ProcessCommandLine(CmdLine));
1853#if MEMPRO_ENABLED
1854 FMemProProfiler::Init(CmdLine);
1855#endif
1856 }
1857 LLM_SCOPE(ELLMTag::EnginePreInitMemory);
1858
1859 {
1860 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("InitTaggedStorage");
1861 FPlatformMisc::InitTaggedStorage(1024);
1862 }
1863
1864#if WITH_ENGINE
1865 FCoreUObjectDelegates::PostGarbageCollectConditionalBeginDestroy.AddStatic(DeferredPhysResourceCleanup);
1866#endif
1867 FCoreDelegates::OnSamplingInput.AddStatic(UpdateGInputTime);
1868
1869#if defined(WITH_LAUNCHERCHECK) && WITH_LAUNCHERCHECK && !WITH_EDITOR
1870 if (ILauncherCheckModule::Get().WasRanFromLauncher() == false)
1871 {
1872 // Tell Launcher to run us instead
1873 ILauncherCheckModule::Get().RunLauncher(ELauncherAction::AppLaunch);
1874 // We wish to exit
1875 RequestEngineExit(TEXT("Run outside of launcher; restarting via launcher"));
1876 return 1;
1877 }
1878#endif
1879
1880#if WITH_APPLICATION_CORE
1881 {
1882 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("CreateConsoleOutputDevice");
1883 // Initialize log console here to avoid statics initialization issues when launched from the command line.
1884 GScopedLogConsole = TUniquePtr<FOutputDeviceConsole>(FPlatformApplicationMisc::CreateConsoleOutputDevice());
1885 }
1886#endif
1887
1888 // Initialize std out device as early as possible if requested in the command line
1889#if PLATFORM_DESKTOP
1890 // consoles don't typically have stdout, and FOutputDeviceDebug is responsible for echoing logs to the
1891 // terminal
1892 if (FParse::Param(FCommandLine::Get(), TEXT("stdout")))
1893 {
1894 InitializeStdOutDevice();
1895 }
1896#endif
1897
1898 if (FParse::Param(CmdLine, TEXT("UTF8Output")))
1899 {
1900 // UE_DEPRECATED(5.6, "This comment exists to describe when -UTF8Output was deprecated and allow finding it in a search for UE 5.6 deprecations.")
1901 UE_LOGF(LogInit, Display, "Output is UTF-8 by default. Use of -UTF8Output on the command is deprecated and can be removed.");
1902 }
1903
1904// If we are in Debug, Development, or Test/Shipping with ALLOW_PROFILEGPU... enabled, then automatically allow draw events.
1905// Command lines allow disabling of draw events if WITH_PROGILEGPU is enabled. Test/Shipping on their own require explicit opt in.
1906#if WITH_PROFILEGPU
1907 if (!FParse::Param(FCommandLine::Get(), TEXT("nodrawevents")))
1908 {
1909 SetEmitDrawEvents(true);
1910 }
1911// Continue to protect shipping build from emitdrawevents (if needed in shipping, ALLOW_PROFILEGPU_IN_SHIPPING should be used instead to enable WITH_PROFILEGPU)
1912#elif !UE_BUILD_SHIPPING
1913 if (FParse::Param(FCommandLine::Get(), TEXT("emitdrawevents")))
1914 {
1915 SetEmitDrawEvents(true);
1916 }
1917#endif
1918
1919#if !UE_BUILD_SHIPPING
1920 if (FPlatformProperties::SupportsQuit())
1921 {
1922 FString ExitPhrases;
1923 if (FParse::Value(FCommandLine::Get(), TEXT("testexit="), ExitPhrases))
1924 {
1925 TArray<FString> ExitPhrasesList;
1926 if (ExitPhrases.ParseIntoArray(ExitPhrasesList, TEXT("+"), true) > 0)
1927 {
1928 GScopedTestExit = MakeUnique<FOutputDeviceTestExit>(MoveTemp(ExitPhrasesList));
1929 GLog->AddOutputDevice(GScopedTestExit.Get());
1930 }
1931 }
1932 }
1933
1934 // Activates malloc frame profiler from the command line
1935 // Recommend enabling bGenerateSymbols to ensure callstacks can resolve and bRetainFramePointers to ensure frame pointers remain valid.
1936 // Also disabling the hitch detector ALLOW_HITCH_DETECTION=0 helps ensure quicker more accurate runs.
1937 if (FParse::Param(FCommandLine::Get(), TEXT("mallocframeprofiler")))
1938 {
1939 GMallocFrameProfilerEnabled = true;
1940 UE::Private::GMalloc = FMallocFrameProfiler::OverrideIfEnabled(UE::Private::GMalloc);
1941 }
1942#endif // !UE_BUILD_SHIPPING
1943
1944 // Switch into executable's directory (may be required by some of the platform file overrides)
1945#if !defined(DISABLE_CWD_CHANGES) || DISABLE_CWD_CHANGES==0
1946 FPlatformProcess::SetCurrentWorkingDirectoryToBaseDir();
1947#endif
1948
1949 // This fixes up the relative project path, needs to happen before we set platform file paths
1950 if (FPlatformProperties::IsProgram() == false)
1951 {
1952 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("Fix up the relative project path");
1953
1954 if (FPaths::IsProjectFilePathSet())
1955 {
1956 FString ProjPath = FPaths::GetProjectFilePath();
1957 if (FPaths::FileExists(ProjPath) == false)
1958 {
1959 // display it multiple ways, it's very important error message...
1960 FPlatformMisc::LowLevelOutputDebugStringf(TEXT("Project file not found: %s\n"), *ProjPath);
1961 UE_LOGF(LogInit, Display, "Project file not found: %ls", *ProjPath);
1962 UE_LOGF(LogInit, Display, "\tAttempting to find via project info helper.");
1963 // Use the uprojectdirs
1964 FString GameProjectFile = FUProjectDictionary::GetDefault().GetRelativeProjectPathForGame(FApp::GetProjectName(), FPlatformProcess::BaseDir());
1965 if (GameProjectFile.IsEmpty() == false)
1966 {
1967 UE_LOGF(LogInit, Display, "\tFound project file %ls.", *GameProjectFile);
1968 FPaths::SetProjectFilePath(GameProjectFile);
1969
1970 // Fixup command line if project file wasn't found in specified directory to properly parse next arguments.
1971 FString OldCommandLine = FString(FCommandLine::Get());
1972 OldCommandLine.ReplaceInline(*GameProjectFilePathUnnormalized, *GameProjectFile, ESearchCase::CaseSensitive);
1973 FCommandLine::Set(*OldCommandLine);
1974 CmdLine = FCommandLine::Get();
1975 }
1976 }
1977 }

1980#if !IS_PROGRAM && !IS_MONOLITHIC
1981 FString EngineBinariesRootDirectory = FPlatformMisc::EngineDir();
1982#endif
1983 FString ProjectBinariesRootDirectory;
1984 if (FApp::HasProjectName())
1985 {
1986 ProjectBinariesRootDirectory = FPlatformMisc::ProjectDir();
1987#if !IS_MONOLITHIC
1988#if !IS_PROGRAM
1989 FPlatformMisc::GetEngineAndProjectAbsoluteDirsFromExecutable(ProjectBinariesRootDirectory, EngineBinariesRootDirectory);
1990#endif
1991
1992 // Strip suffix "-Platform-Config" to allow building module name to load: "App" + "-ModuleName" + "-Platform-Config"
1993 const FString ExecutableNameWithoutExtension = FPlatformProcess::ExecutableName();
1994 const FStringView BaseExecutableName = FPathViews::GetBaseFilename(ExecutableNameWithoutExtension);
1995 FStringView BasePrefix = BaseExecutableName;
1996 FString BaseSuffix;

2187 // These bools are the mode selector and are mutually exclusive. This function selects the mode by calling one of the
2188 // SetIsRunningAs* lambdas, which it does based on commandline and configuration considerations in a specific order.
2189 // TODO: Convert these bools to an enum since they are mutually exclusive.
2190 bool bHasCommandletToken = false;
2191 bool bHasEditorToken = false;
2192 bool bIsRunningAsDedicatedServer = false;
2193 bool bIsRegularClient = false;
2194
2195 FString TokenToForward;
2196
2197 // these tokens are use later to restore a single commandline string, so keep a version that has quotes around tokens,
2198 // in case there are spaces in a token which will break parsing that single string
2199 TArray<FString> TokenArray = TokenizeCommandline(CmdLine, false);
2200 TArray<FString> QuotedTokenArray = TokenizeCommandline(CmdLine, true);
2201
2202 EGameStringType GameStringType = EGameStringType::Unknown;
2203 FString GameString = ExtractGameStringArgument(TokenArray, QuotedTokenArray, GameStringType);
2204
2205 auto IsModeSelected = [&bHasCommandletToken, &bHasEditorToken, &bIsRegularClient, &bIsRunningAsDedicatedServer]()
2206 {
2207 return bHasCommandletToken || bHasEditorToken || bIsRegularClient || bIsRunningAsDedicatedServer;
2208 };
2209#if UE_EDITOR || WITH_ENGINE
2210 FString CommandletCommandLine;
2211 auto SetIsRunningAsCommandlet = [&CommandletCommandLine, &QuotedTokenArray,
2212 &bHasCommandletToken, &bIsRunningAsDedicatedServer, &bHasEditorToken, &bIsRegularClient, &IsModeSelected, &TokenToForward]
2213 (FStringView CommandletName)
2214 {
2215 checkf(!IsModeSelected(), TEXT("SetIsRunningAsCommandlet should not be called after mode has been selected."));
2216 bHasCommandletToken = true;
2217
2218 TokenToForward = CommandletName;
2219
2220 GIsClient = true;
2221 GIsServer = true;
2222#if WITH_EDITORONLY_DATA
2223 GIsEditor = true;
2224#endif
2225#if STATS
2226 // Leave the stats enabled.
2227 if (!UE::Stats::FStats::EnabledForCommandlet())
2228 {
2229 FThreadStats::PrimaryDisableForever();
2230 }
2231#endif
2232
2233 CommandletCommandLine = FString::Join(QuotedTokenArray, TEXT(" "));
2234#if WITH_EDITOR && WITH_ENGINE
2235 if (CommandletName == TEXTVIEW("cookcommandlet") || FParse::Param(FCommandLine::Get(), TEXT("RunAsCookCommandlet")))
2236 {
2237 PRIVATE_GIsRunningCookCommandlet = true;
2238 UE::Cook::InitializeCookGlobals();
2239 PRIVATE_GIsRunningDLCCookCommandlet = (FCString::Strifind(FCommandLine::Get(), TEXT("-dlcname=")) != nullptr);
2240 }
2241#endif
2242#if WITH_ENGINE
2243 PRIVATE_GIsRunningCommandlet = true;
2244#endif
2245 // Allow commandlet rendering and/or audio based on command line switch (too early to let the commandlet itself override this).
2246 PRIVATE_GAllowCommandletRendering = FParse::Param(FCommandLine::Get(), TEXT("AllowCommandletRendering"));
2247 PRIVATE_GAllowCommandletAudio = FParse::Param(FCommandLine::Get(), TEXT("AllowCommandletAudio"));
2248 };
2249#endif // UE_EDITOR || WITH_ENGINE || WITH_EDITOR
2250 auto SetIsRunningAsRegularClient = [&IsModeSelected, &bIsRegularClient, &TokenArray, &TokenToForward]()
2251 {
2252 checkf(!IsModeSelected(), TEXT("SetIsRunningAsRegularClient should not be called after mode has been selected."));
2253 bIsRegularClient = true;
2254
2255 // Take the first non-switch command-line parameter (i.e. one not starting with a dash) and remember
2256 // it to check later as it could be a mistyped commandlet (short name).
2257 const FString* NonSwitchParam = TokenArray.FindByPredicate(
2258 [](const FString& Token)
2259 {
2260 return Token[0] != TCHAR('-');
2261 }
2262 );
2263
2264 if (NonSwitchParam)
2265 {
2266 TokenToForward = *NonSwitchParam;
2267 }
2268
2269 GIsClient = true;
2270 GIsServer = false;
2271#if WITH_EDITORONLY_DATA
2272 GIsEditor = false;
2273#endif
2274#if WITH_ENGINE
2275 checkf(!PRIVATE_GIsRunningCommandlet, TEXT("It should not be possible for PRIVATE_GIsRunningCommandlet to have been set when calling SetIsRunningAsRegularClient"));
2276#endif
2277 };
2278 auto SetIsRunningAsDedicatedServer = [&IsModeSelected, &bIsRunningAsDedicatedServer]()
2279 {
2280 checkf(!IsModeSelected(), TEXT("SetIsRunningAsDedicatedServer should not be called after mode has been selected."));
2281 bIsRunningAsDedicatedServer = true;
2282
2283 GIsClient = false;
2284 GIsServer = true;
2285#if WITH_EDITORONLY_DATA
2286 GIsEditor = false;
2287#endif
2288#if WITH_ENGINE
2289 checkf(!PRIVATE_GIsRunningCommandlet, TEXT("It should not be possible for PRIVATE_GIsRunningCommandlet to have been set when calling SetIsRunningAsDedicatedServer"));
2290#endif
2291 };
2292#if WITH_EDITORONLY_DATA
2293 auto SetIsRunningAsEditor = [&IsModeSelected, &bHasEditorToken]()
2294 {
2295 checkf(!IsModeSelected(), TEXT("SetIsRunningAsEditor should not be called after mode has been selected."));
2296 bHasEditorToken = true;
2297
2298 GIsClient = true;
2299 GIsServer = true;
2300 GIsEditor = true;
2301#if WITH_ENGINE
2302 checkf(!PRIVATE_GIsRunningCommandlet, TEXT("It should not be possible for PRIVATE_GIsRunningCommandlet to have been set when calling SetIsRunningAsEditor"));
2303#endif
2304 };
2305#endif
2306
2307 if (IsRunningDedicatedServer())
2308 {
2309 SetIsRunningAsDedicatedServer();
2310 }

2312#if UE_EDITOR || WITH_ENGINE
2313 TArray<FString> NonSwitchTokens;
2314 TArray<FString> Switches;
2315 UCommandlet::ParseCommandLine(CmdLine, NonSwitchTokens, Switches);
2316 if (!IsModeSelected())
2317 {
2318 for (const FString& ParsedToken : NonSwitchTokens)
2319 {
2320 if (ParsedToken.EndsWith(TEXT("Commandlet")))
2321 {
2322 SetIsRunningAsCommandlet(ParsedToken.TrimStartAndEnd());
2323 break;
2324 }
2325 }
2326 if (!bHasCommandletToken)
2327 {
2328 for (const FString& ParsedSwitch : Switches)
2329 {
2330 if (ParsedSwitch.StartsWith(TEXT("RUN=")))
2331 {
2332 FString LocalToken = ParsedSwitch.RightChop(4);
2333 LocalToken.TrimStartAndEndInline();
2334 if (!LocalToken.EndsWith(TEXT("Commandlet")))
2335 {
2336 LocalToken += TEXT("Commandlet");
2337 }
2338 SetIsRunningAsCommandlet(LocalToken);
2339 break;
2340 }
2341 }
2342 }
2343 }
2344#endif // UE_EDITOR || WITH_ENGINE || WITH_EDITOR
2345#if WITH_EDITOR

2349 UE::Private::SetMultiprocessId(MultiprocessId);
2350 }
2351#endif

2353
2354 // In the commandlet case, we have set the Token to something other than the first token from commandline.
2355 // In all other cases we should check for the first token being the Project Specifier
2356 if (!bHasCommandletToken)
2357 {
2358 if (GameStringType != EGameStringType::Unknown)
2359 {
2360 // Set a new command-line that doesn't include the game name as the first argument.
2361 FCommandLine::Set(*FString::Join(QuotedTokenArray, TEXT(" ")));
2362
2363 // Remove spurious project file tokens (which can happen on some platforms that combine commandlines).
2364 // This handles extra .uprojects, but if you run with MyGame MyGame, we can't tell if the second MyGame is a map or not.
2365 TokenArray.RemoveAll(
2366 [](const FString& Token)
2367 {
2368 return Token[0] != TCHAR('-') && FPaths::GetExtension(Token) == FProjectDescriptor::GetExtension();
2369 }
2370 );
2371
2372 if (GameStringType == EGameStringType::ProjectPath || GameStringType == EGameStringType::ProjectShortName)
2373 {
2374 // Convert it to relative if possible...
2375 FString RelativeGameProjectFilePath = FFileManagerGeneric::DefaultConvertToRelativePath(*FPaths::GetProjectFilePath());
2376 if (RelativeGameProjectFilePath != FPaths::GetProjectFilePath())
2377 {
2378 FPaths::SetProjectFilePath(RelativeGameProjectFilePath);
2379 }
2380 }
2381 }
2382
2383#if UE_EDITOR
2384 // Handle the first token being '-game' or '-server'
2385 if (!TokenArray.IsEmpty())
2386 {
2387 if (TokenArray[0] == TEXT("-GAME") || TokenArray[0] == TEXT("-SERVER"))
2388 {
2389 // This isn't necessarily pretty, but many requests have been made to allow
2390 // UnrealEditor.exe <GAMENAME> -game <map>
2391 // or
2392 // UnrealEditor.exe <GAMENAME> -game 127.0.0.0
2393 // We don't want to remove the -game from the commandline just yet in case
2394 // we need it for something later. So, just move it to the end for now...
2395 FString LocalToken = TokenArray[0];
2396 TokenArray.Add(LocalToken);
2397 TokenArray.RemoveAt(0);
2398 QuotedTokenArray.Add(LocalToken);
2399 QuotedTokenArray.RemoveAt(0);
2400
2401 FCommandLine::Set(*FString::Join(QuotedTokenArray, TEXT(" ")));
2402 }
2403 }
2404#endif
2405 }

2407 // If we have no Commandlet or -server, test if we are running as the editor, and set the GIsEditor/GIsClient/GIsServer flags if so.
2408 // Do this early (and certainly before AppInit) so plugin-consumed library code can know (they wouldn't otherwise)

2410 if (!IsModeSelected())
2411 {
2412#if UE_EDITOR

2975 // Take the first non-switch command-line parameter (i.e. one not starting with a dash). We will check if it's possibly a commandlet.

2977 [](const FString& Token)
2978 {
2979 return Token[0] != TCHAR('-');
2980 }
2981 );
2982
2983 bool bIsPossiblyCommandletName = NonSwitchParam != nullptr;

2986 FString CommandletName = *NonSwitchParam;
2987

2992
2993 UClass* TempCommandletClass = FindFirstObject<UClass>(*CommandletName, EFindFirstObjectOptions::None, ELogVerbosity::Warning, TEXT("Looking for commandlet class"));

2995 {
2996 checkf(TempCommandletClass->IsChildOf(UCommandlet::StaticClass()), TEXT("It is not valid to have a class that ends with \"Commandlet\" that is not a UCommandlet subclass."));
2997
2998 LateCommandletName = CommandletName;
2999 }
3000 }

3252

3255 }
3256 else

3260 }
3261 }
3262
3263 {
3264 EShaderPermutationFlags Flags = EShaderPermutationFlags::None;
3265
3266 bool bSupportCookedEditor = false;
3267 GConfig->GetBool(TEXT("CookedEditorSettings"), TEXT("bSupportCookedEditor"), bSupportCookedEditor, GGameIni);
3268 Flags |= bSupportCookedEditor ? EShaderPermutationFlags::HasEditorOnlyData : EShaderPermutationFlags::None;
3269
3270 const bool bShouldCompileODSCOnlyShaders = ShouldCompileODSCOnlyShaders();
3271 Flags |= bShouldCompileODSCOnlyShaders ? EShaderPermutationFlags::IsODSCOnly : EShaderPermutationFlags::None;
3272
3273 SetAdditionalShaderPermutationFlags(Flags);
3274 }
3275
3276 {
3277 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("GetRendererModule");
3278 // Cache the renderer module in the main thread so that we can safely retrieve it later from the rendering thread.
3279 GetRendererModule();
3280 }
3281
3282 {
3283 if (AllowShaderCompiling())
3284 {
3285 UE_SCOPED_ENGINE_ACTIVITY(TEXT("Initializing Shader Types"));
3286 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("InitializeShaderTypes");
3287
3288#if WITH_EDITOR
3289 // Explicitly generate AutogenShaderHeaders.ush prior to shader type initialization
3290 // (since that process will load and cache this header as a sideeffect)
3291 FShaderCompileUtilities::GenerateBrdfHeaders(GMaxRHIShaderPlatform);
3292#endif
3293
3294 // Initialize shader types before loading any shaders
3295 InitializeShaderTypes();
3296 }
3297
3298 FDelayedAutoRegisterHelper::RunAndClearDelayedAutoRegisterDelegates(EDelayedRegisterRunPhase::ShaderTypesReady);
3299
3300 SlowTask.EnterProgressFrame(25, LOCTEXT("CompileGlobalShaderMap", "Compiling Global Shaders..."));
3301
3302 // Load the global shaders
3303 if (AllowGlobalShaderLoad())
3304 {
3305 LLM_SCOPE(ELLMTag::Shaders);
3306 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("CompileGlobalShaderMap");
3307 CompileGlobalShaderMap(false);
3308 if (IsEngineExitRequested())
3309 {
3310 // This means we can't continue without the global shader map.
3311 return 1;
3312 }
3313 }
3314
3315 SlowTask.EnterProgressFrame(5);
3316
3317 {
3318 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("CreateMoviePlayer");
3319 CreateMoviePlayer();
3320 }
3321
3322 if (FPreLoadScreenManager::ArePreLoadScreensEnabled())
3323 {
3324 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("FPreLoadScreenManager::Create");
3325 FPreLoadScreenManager::Create();
3326 ensure(FPreLoadScreenManager::Get());
3327 }
3328
3329 // If platforms support early movie playback we have to start the rendering thread much earlier
3330#if PLATFORM_SUPPORTS_EARLY_MOVIE_PLAYBACK
3331 {
3332 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("PostInitRHI");
3333 PostInitRHI();
3334 }
3335
3336 InitRenderingThread();
3337#endif
3338
3339 FEmbeddedCommunication::ForceTick(4);
3340
3341 {
3342#if !UE_SERVER// && !UE_EDITOR
3343 if (!IsRunningDedicatedServer() && !IsRunningCommandlet())
3344 {
3345 TSharedPtr<FSlateRenderer> SlateRenderer = GUsingNullRHI ?
3346 FModuleManager::Get().LoadModuleChecked<ISlateNullRendererModule>("SlateNullRenderer").CreateSlateNullRenderer() :
3347 FModuleManager::Get().GetModuleChecked<ISlateRHIRendererModule>("SlateRHIRenderer").CreateSlateRHIRenderer();
3348 TSharedRef<FSlateRenderer> SlateRendererSharedRef = SlateRenderer.ToSharedRef();
3349
3350 {
3351 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("CurrentSlateApp.InitializeRenderer");
3352 // If Slate is being used, initialize the renderer after RHIInit
3353 FSlateApplication& CurrentSlateApp = FSlateApplication::Get();
3354 CurrentSlateApp.InitializeRenderer(SlateRendererSharedRef);
3355 }
3356
3357 {
3358 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("FEngineFontServices::Create");
3359 // Create the engine font services now that the Slate renderer is ready
3360 FEngineFontServices::Create();
3361 }
3362
3363 {
3364 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("LoadModulesForProject(ELoadingPhase::PostSplashScreen)");
3365 // Load up all modules that need to hook into the custom splash screen
3366 if (!IProjectManager::Get().LoadModulesForProject(ELoadingPhase::PostSplashScreen) || !IPluginManager::Get().LoadModulesForEnabledPlugins(ELoadingPhase::PostSplashScreen))
3367 {
3368 return 1;
3369 }
3370 }
3371
3372 {
3373 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("PlayFirstPreLoadScreen");
3374
3375 if (FPreLoadScreenManager::Get())
3376 {
3377 {
3378 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("PlayFirstPreLoadScreen - FPreLoadScreenManager::Get()->Initialize");
3379 // initialize and present custom splash screen
3380 FPreLoadScreenManager::Get()->Initialize(SlateRendererSharedRef.Get());
3381 }
3382
3383 if (FPreLoadScreenManager::Get()->HasRegisteredPreLoadScreenType(EPreLoadScreenTypes::CustomSplashScreen))
3384 {
3385 FPreLoadScreenManager::Get()->PlayFirstPreLoadScreen(EPreLoadScreenTypes::CustomSplashScreen);
3386 }
3387 }
3388 }
3389
3390 PreInitContext.SlateRenderer = SlateRenderer;
3391 }
3392 else
3393#endif // !UE_SERVER
3394 {
3395 {
3396 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("LoadModulesForProject(ELoadingPhase::PostSplashScreen)");
3397 // Load up all modules that need to hook into the custom splash screen
3398 if (!IProjectManager::Get().LoadModulesForProject(ELoadingPhase::PostSplashScreen) || !IPluginManager::Get().LoadModulesForEnabledPlugins(ELoadingPhase::PostSplashScreen))
3399 {
3400 return 1;
3401 }
3402 }
3403 }
3404 }
3405 }
3406#endif // WITH_ENGINE
3407
3408 // Save PreInitContext
3409 PreInitContext.bDumpEarlyConfigReads = bDumpEarlyConfigReads;
3410 PreInitContext.bDumpEarlyPakFileReads = bDumpEarlyPakFileReads;
3411 PreInitContext.bForceQuitAfterEarlyReads = bForceQuitAfterEarlyReads;
3412 PreInitContext.bWithConfigPatching = bWithConfigPatching;
3413 PreInitContext.bHasEditorToken = bHasEditorToken;
3414#if WITH_ENGINE
3415 PreInitContext.bIsRegularClient = bIsRegularClient;
3416#endif // WITH_ENGINE
3417 PreInitContext.bIsPossiblyUnrecognizedCommandlet = bIsRegularClient && TokenToForward.Len() && !TokenToForward.Contains(TEXT("-"));
3418 PRAGMA_DISABLE_DEPRECATION_WARNINGS;
3419 PreInitContext.bTokenDoesNotHaveDash = PreInitContext.bIsPossiblyUnrecognizedCommandlet;
3420 PRAGMA_ENABLE_DEPRECATION_WARNINGS;
3421 PreInitContext.Token = TokenToForward;
3422#if UE_EDITOR || WITH_ENGINE
3423 PreInitContext.CommandletCommandLine = CommandletCommandLine;
3424#endif // UE_EDITOR || WITH_ENGINE
3425
3426#if WITH_COREUOBJECT
3427#if (WITH_VERSE_VM || defined(__INTELLISENSE__))
3428 Verse::VerseVM::Startup();
3429#else
3430 verse::FExecutionContext::Create();
3431#endif
3432#endif
3433
3434 return 0;
3435}
