3447int32 FEngineLoop::PreInitPostStartupScreen(const TCHAR* CmdLine)
3448{
3449 ON_SCOPE_EXIT{ FBootProfiling::OnPreInitPostStartupScreenComplete(); };
3450 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("FEngineLoop::PreInitPostStartupScreen");
3451 LLM_SCOPE(ELLMTag::EnginePreInitMemory);
3452
3453 if (IsEngineExitRequested())
3454 {
3455 return 0;
3456 }
3457
3458 extern bool GIsConsoleExecutable;
3459#if PLATFORM_WINDOWS
3460 /*
3461 Note - ImageNtHeader must be called after DbgHelp is initialized.Failure to wait before initialization will cause calls to
3462 SymFromAddr for monolithic exes to fail. This results in callstacks not being written to the log.
3463 From discussion with Microsoft it is unclear when this time is and could be related to large pdbs. At this time here is an appropriate spot.
3464 */
3465 if (PIMAGE_NT_HEADERS NtHeaders = ImageNtHeader(GetModuleHandle(nullptr)))
3466 {
3467 GIsConsoleExecutable = (NtHeaders->OptionalHeader.Subsystem == IMAGE_SUBSYSTEM_WINDOWS_CUI);
3468 }
3469 else
3470 {
3471 GIsConsoleExecutable = (GetFileType(GetStdHandle(STD_OUTPUT_HANDLE)) == FILE_TYPE_CHAR);
3472 }
3473#endif // PLATFORM_WINDOWS
3474
3475 FScopeCycleCounter CycleCount_AfterStats(GET_STATID(STAT_FEngineLoop_PreInitPostStartupScreen_AfterStats));
3476
3477 // Restore PreInitContext
3478 bool bDumpEarlyConfigReads = PreInitContext.bDumpEarlyConfigReads;
3479 bool bDumpEarlyPakFileReads = PreInitContext.bDumpEarlyPakFileReads;
3480 bool bForceQuitAfterEarlyReads = PreInitContext.bForceQuitAfterEarlyReads;
3481 bool bWithConfigPatching = PreInitContext.bWithConfigPatching;
3482 bool bHasEditorToken = PreInitContext.bHasEditorToken;
3483#if WITH_ENGINE
3484 bool bIsRegularClient = PreInitContext.bIsRegularClient;
3485#endif // WITH_ENGINE
3486 bool bIsPossiblyUnrecognizedCommandlet = PreInitContext.bIsPossiblyUnrecognizedCommandlet;
3487 FString Token = PreInitContext.Token;
3488#if UE_EDITOR || WITH_ENGINE
3489 const TCHAR* CommandletCommandLine = *PreInitContext.CommandletCommandLine;
3490#endif // UE_EDITOR || WITH_ENGINE
3491
3492 check(PreInitContext.SlowTaskPtr);
3493 FScopedSlowTask& SlowTask = *PreInitContext.SlowTaskPtr;
3494
3495#if WITH_ENGINE
3496 {
3497 TSharedPtr<IInstallBundleManager> BundleManager = IInstallBundleManager::GetPlatformInstallBundleManager();
3498
3499#if !UE_SERVER// && !UE_EDITOR
3500 if (!IsRunningDedicatedServer() && !IsRunningCommandlet())
3501 {
3502 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("PreInitPostStartupScreen_StartupGraphics");
3503
3504 TSharedPtr<FSlateRenderer> SlateRenderer = PreInitContext.SlateRenderer;
3505 TSharedRef<FSlateRenderer> SlateRendererSharedRef = SlateRenderer.ToSharedRef();
3506
3507 {
3508 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("LoadModulesForProject(ELoadingPhase::PreEarlyLoadingScreen)");
3509 // Load up all modules that need to hook into the loading screen
3510 if (!IProjectManager::Get().LoadModulesForProject(ELoadingPhase::PreEarlyLoadingScreen) || !IPluginManager::Get().LoadModulesForEnabledPlugins(ELoadingPhase::PreEarlyLoadingScreen))
3511 {
3512 return 1;
3513 }
3514 }
3515
3516 if (BundleManager != nullptr && !BundleManager->IsNullInterface())
3517 {
3518 IInstallBundleManager::InstallBundleCompleteDelegate.AddStatic(
3519 &OnStartupContentMounted, bDumpEarlyConfigReads, bDumpEarlyPakFileReads, bWithConfigPatching, bForceQuitAfterEarlyReads);
3520 }
3521 // If not using the bundle manager, config will be reloaded after ESP, see below
3522
3523 //If the PreLoadScreen is active, then we don't want to initialise the MoviePlayer from the same data.
3524 bool hasPreloadStartupMovie = false;
3525 //If true then we want the splash screen to be handled defaultly
3526 bool useDefaultSplash = true;
3527
3528 UE_SCOPED_ENGINE_ACTIVITY(TEXT("Play Preload Screen"));
3529 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("PlayFirstPreLoadScreen");
3530
3531 if (FPreLoadScreenManager::Get())
3532 {
3533 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("PlayFirstPreLoadScreen - FPreLoadScreenManager::Get()->Initialize");
3534 // initialize and play our first Early PreLoad Screen if one is setup
3535 FPreLoadScreenManager::Get()->Initialize(SlateRendererSharedRef.Get());
3536
3537 //If either early/engine screen is present then the DefaultMoviePlayer should not be configured with the same data.
3538 hasPreloadStartupMovie =
3539 FPreLoadScreenManager::Get()->HasRegisteredPreLoadScreenType(EPreLoadScreenTypes::EarlyStartupScreen) ||
3540 FPreLoadScreenManager::Get()->HasRegisteredPreLoadScreenType(EPreLoadScreenTypes::EngineLoadingScreen);
3541
3542 if (FPreLoadScreenManager::Get()->HasRegisteredPreLoadScreenType(EPreLoadScreenTypes::EarlyStartupScreen))
3543 {
3544 // disable the splash before playing the early startup screen
3545 FPreLoadScreenManager::Get()->IsResponsibleForRenderingDelegate.AddLambda(
3546 [](bool bIsPreloadScreenManResponsibleForRendering)
3547 {
3548 FPlatformMisc::PlatformHandleSplashScreen(!bIsPreloadScreenManResponsibleForRendering);
3549 }
3550 );
3551 FPreLoadScreenManager::Get()->PlayFirstPreLoadScreen(EPreLoadScreenTypes::EarlyStartupScreen);
3552
3553 useDefaultSplash = false;
3554 }
3555 else
3556 {
3557 useDefaultSplash = true;
3558 }
3559 }
3560
3561 //If a PreLoadScreenManager is present, then MoviePlayer should not read the same configurable data and rely on a different configuration setup.
3562 if (IsMoviePlayerEnabled() && !hasPreloadStartupMovie)
3563 {
3564 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("GetMoviePlayer()->SetupLoadingScreenFromIni");
3565 // allow the movie player to load a sequence from the .inis (a PreLoadingScreen module could have already initialized a sequence, in which case
3566 // it wouldn't have anything in it's .ini file)
3567 GetMoviePlayer()->SetupLoadingScreenFromIni();
3568 }
3569
3570 if (IsMoviePlayerEnabled() && GetMoviePlayer()->HasEarlyStartupMovie())
3571 {
3572 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("EarlyStartupMovie");
3573 GetMoviePlayer()->Initialize(SlateRendererSharedRef.Get(), FPreLoadScreenManager::Get() ? FPreLoadScreenManager::Get()->GetRenderWindow() : nullptr);
3574
3575 // hide splash screen now before playing any movies
3576 FPlatformMisc::PlatformHandleSplashScreen(false);
3577
3578 // only allowed to play any movies marked as early startup. These movies or widgets can have no interaction whatsoever with uobjects or engine features
3579 GetMoviePlayer()->PlayEarlyStartupMovies();
3580
3581 // display the splash screen again now that early startup movies have played
3582 FPlatformMisc::PlatformHandleSplashScreen(true);
3583
3584#if 0 && PAK_TRACKER// dump the files which have been accessed inside the pak file
3585 FPakPlatformFile* PakPlatformFile = (FPakPlatformFile*)(FPlatformFileManager::Get().FindPlatformFile(FPakPlatformFile::GetTypeName()));
3586 FString FileList = "All files accessed before init\n";
3587 for (const auto& PakMapFile : PakPlatformFile->GetPakMap())
3588 {
3589 FileList += PakMapFile.Key + TEXT("\n");
3590 }
3591 UE_LOGF(LogInit, Display, "\n%ls", *FileList);
3592#endif
3593
3594 useDefaultSplash &= true;
3595 }
3596
3597 if (useDefaultSplash)
3598 {
3599 // no early startup screen, show the splash screen
3600 FPlatformMisc::PlatformHandleSplashScreen(true);
3601 }
3602 }
3603 else
3604#endif // !UE_SERVER
3605 {
3606#if !UE_SERVER
3607 if (IsRunningCommandlet())
3608 {
3609 // Create the engine font services now that the Slate renderer is ready
3610 FEngineFontServices::Create();
3611 }
3612#endif
3613 {
3614 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("LoadModulesForProject(ELoadingPhase::PreEarlyLoadingScreen)");
3615 // Load up all modules that need to hook into the loading screen, even though there
3616 // is no loading screen we still need to load the modules registered in that phase.
3617 if (!IProjectManager::Get().LoadModulesForProject(ELoadingPhase::PreEarlyLoadingScreen)
3618 || !IPluginManager::Get().LoadModulesForEnabledPlugins(ELoadingPhase::PreEarlyLoadingScreen))
3619 {
3620 return 1;
3621 }
3622 }
3623 }
3624
3625 //Now that our EarlyStartupScreen is finished, lets take the necessary steps to mount paks, apply .ini cvars, and open the shader libraries if we installed content we expect to handle
3626 //If using a bundle manager, assume its handling all this stuff and that we don't have to do it.
3627 if (BundleManager == nullptr || BundleManager->IsNullInterface() || !BundleManager->SupportsEarlyStartupPatching())
3628 {
3629 // Mount Paks that were installed during EarlyStartupScreen
3630 if (FCoreDelegates::OnMountAllPakFiles.IsBound() && FPaths::HasProjectPersistentDownloadDir() )
3631 {
3632 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("MountPaksAfterEarlyStartupScreen");
3633
3634 FString InstalledGameContentDir = FPaths::Combine(*FPaths::ProjectPersistentDownloadDir(), TEXT("InstalledContent"), FApp::GetProjectName(), TEXT("Content"), TEXT("Paks"));
3635 FPlatformMisc::AddAdditionalRootDirectory(FPaths::Combine(*FPaths::ProjectPersistentDownloadDir(), TEXT("InstalledContent")));
3636
3637 TArray<FString> PakFolders;
3638 PakFolders.Add(InstalledGameContentDir);
3639 FCoreDelegates::OnMountAllPakFiles.Execute(PakFolders);
3640
3641 // Look for any plugins installed during EarlyStartupScreen
3642 IPluginManager::Get().RefreshPluginsList();
3643 IPluginManager::Get().LoadModulesForEnabledPlugins(ELoadingPhase::PreEarlyLoadingScreen);
3644 }
3645
3646 DumpEarlyReads(bDumpEarlyConfigReads, bDumpEarlyPakFileReads, bForceQuitAfterEarlyReads);
3647
3648 //Reapply CVars after our EarlyLoadScreen
3649 if(bWithConfigPatching)
3650 {
3651 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("ReapplyCVarsFromIniAfterEarlyStartupScreen");
3652 HandleConfigReload(bWithConfigPatching);
3653 }
3654
3655 //Handle opening shader library after our EarlyLoadScreen
3656 {
3657 LLM_SCOPE(ELLMTag::Shaders);
3658 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("FShaderCodeLibrary::OpenLibrary");
3659
3660 // Open the game library which contains the material shaders.
3661 FShaderCodeLibrary::OpenLibrary(FApp::GetProjectName(), FPaths::ProjectContentDir());
3662 for (const FString& RootDir : FPlatformMisc::GetAdditionalRootDirectories())
3663 {
3664 FShaderCodeLibrary::OpenLibrary(FApp::GetProjectName(), FPaths::Combine(RootDir, FApp::GetProjectName(), TEXT("Content")));
3665 }
3666
3667 // Now our shader code main library is opened, kick off the precompile, if already initialized
3668 FShaderPipelineCache::OpenPipelineFileCache(GMaxRHIShaderPlatform);
3669 }
3670 }
3671#if WITH_EDITOR
3672 else if (GAllowCookedDataInEditorBuilds)
3673 {
3674 //Handle opening shader library after our EarlyLoadScreen
3675 {
3676 LLM_SCOPE(ELLMTag::Shaders);
3677 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("FShaderCodeLibrary::OpenLibrary");
3678
3679 // Open the game library which contains the material shaders.
3680 FShaderCodeLibrary::OpenLibrary(FApp::GetProjectName(), FPaths::ProjectContentDir());
3681 }
3682 }
3683#endif
3684
3685 InitGameTextLocalization();
3686
3687 DECLARE_SCOPE_CYCLE_COUNTER(TEXT("Initial UObject load"), STAT_InitialUObjectLoad, STATGROUP_LoadTime);
3688
3689 // In order to be able to use short script package names get all script
3690 // package names from ini files and register them with FPackageName system.
3691 FPackageName::RegisterShortPackageNamesForUObjectModules();
3692
3693 SlowTask.EnterProgressFrame(5);
3694
3695
3696 {
3697 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("LoadAssetRegistryModule");
3698 UE_SCOPED_ENGINE_ACTIVITY(TEXT("Loading AssetRegistry"));
3699 // If we don't do this now and the async loading thread is active, then we will attempt to load this module from a thread
3700 FModuleManager::Get().LoadModule("AssetRegistry");
3701 }
3702#if WITH_COREUOBJECT
3703 // Initialize the PackageResourceManager, which is needed to load any (non-script) Packages. It is first used in ProcessNewlyLoadedObjects (due to the loading of asset references in Class Default Objects)
3704 // It has to be intialized after the AssetRegistryModule; the editor implementations of PackageResourceManager relies on it
3705 IPackageResourceManager::Initialize();
3706#endif
3707#if WITH_EDITOR
3708 // Initialize the BulkDataRegistry, which registers BulkData structs loaded from Packages for later building. It uses the same lifetime as IPackageResourceManager
3709 IBulkDataRegistry::Initialize();
3710#endif
3711
3712 FEmbeddedCommunication::ForceTick(5);
3713
3714 // for any auto-registered functions that want to wait until main(), run them now
3715 // @todo loadtime: this should have phases, so caller can decide when auto-register runs [use plugin phases probably?]
3716 FDelayedAutoRegisterHelper::RunAndClearDelayedAutoRegisterDelegates(EDelayedRegisterRunPhase::PreObjectSystemReady);
3717
3718 // Make sure all UObject classes are registered and default properties have been initialized
3719 {
3720 UE_SCOPED_ENGINE_ACTIVITY(TEXT("Initializing UObject Classes"));
3721 ProcessNewlyLoadedUObjects();
3722 }
3723
3724#if WITH_EDITOR
3725
3726 // To make sure the shader headers are generated correctly, it needs to run after ProcessNewlyLoadedUObjects. ProcessNewlyLoadedUObjects sets up
3727 // the DeviceProfileManager, which is necessary to access certain console variables.
3728 // Also, the shader header needs to be generated before the call to GEditor->InitEditor because some modules (at least Niagara) will generate
3729 // and cache shaders dependencies during plugin loading so I need the shader headers at that moment.
3730 if (AllowShaderCompiling())
3731 {
3732 GenerateShaderHeaders();
3733 }
3734
3735 if (!UE::Virtualization::ShouldInitializePreSlate())
3736 {
3737 // Explicit initialization of the virtualization system, after slate has initialized and we can show error dialogs.
3738 UE::Virtualization::Initialize(UE::Virtualization::EInitializationFlags::None);
3739 }
3740#endif //WITH_EDITOR
3741
3742 // Ensure game localization has loaded before we continue
3743 FTextLocalizationManager::Get().WaitForAsyncTasks();
3744
3745 FDelayedAutoRegisterHelper::RunAndClearDelayedAutoRegisterDelegates(EDelayedRegisterRunPhase::ObjectSystemReady);
3746
3747 FEmbeddedCommunication::ForceTick(6);
3748
3749#if USE_LOCALIZED_PACKAGE_CACHE
3750 {
3751 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("FPackageLocalizationManager::Get().PerformLazyInitialization()");
3752 // CoreUObject is definitely available now, so make sure the package localization cache is available
3753 // This may have already been initialized from the CDO creation from ProcessNewlyLoadedUObjects
3754 FPackageLocalizationManager::Get().PerformLazyInitialization();
3755 }
3756#endif // USE_LOCALIZED_PACKAGE_CACHE
3757
3758 {
3759 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("InitDefaultMaterials etc");
3760 // Default materials may have been loaded due to dependencies when loading
3761 // classes and class default objects. If not, do so now.
3762 UMaterialInterface::InitDefaultMaterials();
3763 UMaterialInterface::AssertDefaultMaterialsExist();
3764 UMaterialInterface::AssertDefaultMaterialsPostLoaded();
3765 }
3766 }
3767
3768 {
3769 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("IStreamingManager::Get()");
3770 // Initialize the texture streaming system (needs to happen after RHIInit and ProcessNewlyLoadedUObjects).
3771 IStreamingManager::Get();
3772 }
3773
3774 SlowTask.EnterProgressFrame(5);
3775
3776 // Tell the module manager is may now process newly-loaded UObjects when new C++ modules are loaded
3777 FModuleManager::Get().StartProcessingNewlyLoadedObjects();
3778
3779 FEmbeddedCommunication::ForceTick(7);
3780
3781 SlowTask.EnterProgressFrame(10);
3782
3783 {
3784 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("LoadStartupCoreModules");
3785 if (!LoadStartupCoreModules())
3786 {
3787 // At least one startup module failed to load, return 1 to indicate an error
3788 return 1;
3789 }
3790 }
3791
3792
3793 SlowTask.EnterProgressFrame(10);
3794
3795 {
3796 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("IProjectManager::Get().LoadModulesForProject(ELoadingPhase::PreLoadingScreen)");
3797 // Load up all modules that need to hook into the loading screen
3798 if (!IProjectManager::Get().LoadModulesForProject(ELoadingPhase::PreLoadingScreen) || !IPluginManager::Get().LoadModulesForEnabledPlugins(ELoadingPhase::PreLoadingScreen))
3799 {
3800 return 1;
3801 }
3802 }
3803
3804#if !UE_SERVER
3805 //See if we have an engine loading PreLoadScreen registered, if not try to play an engine loading movie as a backup.
3806 if (IsMoviePlayerEnabled() && !GetMoviePlayer()->IsMovieCurrentlyPlaying())
3807 {
3808 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("FPreLoadScreenManager::Get()->Initialize etc");
3809 if (FSlateRenderer* Renderer = FSlateApplication::Get().GetRenderer())
3810 {
3811 if (FPreLoadScreenManager::Get())
3812 {
3813 if (FPreLoadScreenManager::Get()->HasRegisteredPreLoadScreenType(EPreLoadScreenTypes::EngineLoadingScreen))
3814 {
3815 FPreLoadScreenManager::Get()->Initialize(*Renderer);
3816 }
3817 else
3818 {
3819 //If we don't have a PreLoadScreen to show, try and initialize old flow with the movie player.
3820 GetMoviePlayer()->Initialize(*Renderer, FPreLoadScreenManager::Get()->GetRenderWindow());
3821 }
3822 }
3823 else
3824 {
3825 GetMoviePlayer()->Initialize(*Renderer, nullptr);
3826 }
3827 }
3828 }
3829#endif
3830
3831 {
3832 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("FPlatformApplicationMisc::PostInit");
3833 // do any post appInit processing, before the render thread is started.
3834 FPlatformApplicationMisc::PostInit();
3835 }
3836 SlowTask.EnterProgressFrame(5);
3837
3838#if !PLATFORM_SUPPORTS_EARLY_MOVIE_PLAYBACK
3839 {
3840 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("PostInitRHI etc");
3841 PostInitRHI();
3842 }
3843
3844 InitRenderingThread();
3845#endif // !PLATFORM_SUPPORTS_EARLY_MOVIE_PLAYBACK
3846
3847 // Playing a movie can only happen after the rendering thread is started.
3848#if !UE_SERVER// && !UE_EDITOR
3849 if (IsMoviePlayerEnabled() && !GetMoviePlayer()->IsMovieCurrentlyPlaying())
3850 {
3851 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("PlayFirstPreLoadScreen etc");
3852 if (FPreLoadScreenManager::Get() && FPreLoadScreenManager::Get()->HasRegisteredPreLoadScreenType(EPreLoadScreenTypes::EngineLoadingScreen))
3853 {
3854 FPreLoadScreenManager::Get()->PlayFirstPreLoadScreen(EPreLoadScreenTypes::EngineLoadingScreen);
3855 FPreLoadScreenManager::Get()->SetEngineLoadingComplete(false);
3856 }
3857 else
3858 {
3859 // Play any non-early startup loading movies.
3860 GetMoviePlayer()->PlayMovie();
3861 }
3862 }
3863#endif
3864
3865 {
3866 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("PlatformHandleSplashScreen etc");
3867#if !UE_SERVER
3868 if (!IsRunningDedicatedServer())
3869 {
3870 // show or hide splash screen based on movie
3871 FPlatformMisc::PlatformHandleSplashScreen(!(IsMoviePlayerEnabled() && GetMoviePlayer()->IsMovieCurrentlyPlaying()));
3872 }
3873 else
3874#endif
3875 {
3876 // show splash screen
3877 FPlatformMisc::PlatformHandleSplashScreen(true);
3878 }
3879 }
3880
3881 {
3882 FCoreUObjectDelegates::PreGarbageCollectConditionalBeginDestroy.AddStatic(StartRenderCommandFenceBundler);
3883 FCoreUObjectDelegates::PostGarbageCollectConditionalBeginDestroy.AddStatic(StopRenderCommandFenceBundler);
3884 }
3885
3886#if WITH_EDITOR
3887 // We need to mount the shared resources for templates (if there are any) before we try and load and game classes
3888 FUnrealEdMisc::Get().MountTemplateSharedPaths();
3889
3890 // We need to load any animation compression settings before we load game classes
3891 FAnimationUtils::PreloadCompressionSettings();
3892#endif
3893
3894 {
3895 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("LoadStartupModules");
3896 if (!LoadStartupModules())
3897 {
3898 // At least one startup module failed to load, return 1 to indicate an error
3899 return 1;
3900 }
3901 }
3902#else // !WITH_ENGINE
3903#if WITH_COREUOBJECT
3904 // Initialize the PackageResourceManager, which is needed to load any (non-script) Packages.
3905 IPackageResourceManager::Initialize();
3906#endif
3907#endif // WITH_ENGINE
3908
3909#if WITH_COREUOBJECT
3910 if (GUObjectArray.IsOpenForDisregardForGC())
3911 {
3912 // Flushing async loading before closing the DisregardForGC window to avoid having packages that start async loading before the window is closed
3913 // contain assets that are created after the window is closed.
3914 FlushAsyncLoading();
3915
3916 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("CloseDisregardForGC");
3917 GUObjectArray.CloseDisregardForGC();
3918 }
3919 NotifyRegistrationComplete();
3920 FReferencerFinder::NotifyRegistrationComplete();
3921#endif // WITH_COREUOBJECT
3922
3923#if WITH_ENGINE
3924 if (UOnlineEngineInterface::Get()->IsLoaded())
3925 {
3926 SetIsServerForOnlineSubsystemsDelegate(FQueryIsRunningServer::CreateStatic(&IsServerDelegateForOSS));
3927 }
3928
3929 SlowTask.EnterProgressFrame(5);
3930
3931 if (!bHasEditorToken && !IsRunningDedicatedServer())
3932 {
3933 UClass* CommandletClass = nullptr;
3934
3935 if (!bIsRegularClient)
3936 {
3937 checkf(PRIVATE_GIsRunningCommandlet, TEXT("This should have been set in PreInitPreStartupScreen"));
3938
3939 CommandletClass = Cast<UClass>(StaticFindFirstObject(UClass::StaticClass(), *Token, EFindFirstObjectOptions::None, ELogVerbosity::Warning, TEXT("looking for commandlet")));
3940 int32 PeriodIdx;
3941 if (!CommandletClass && Token.FindChar('.', PeriodIdx))
3942 {
3943 // try to load module for commandlet specified before a period.
3944 FModuleManager::Get().LoadModule(*Token.Left(PeriodIdx));
3945 CommandletClass = FindFirstObject<UClass>(*Token, EFindFirstObjectOptions::None, ELogVerbosity::Warning, TEXT("Looking for commandlet class"));
3946 }
3947 if (!CommandletClass)
3948 {
3949 if (GLogConsole && !GIsSilent)
3950 {
3951 GLogConsole->Show(true);
3952 }
3953 UE_LOGF(LogInit, Error, "%ls looked like a commandlet, but we could not find the class.", *Token);
3954 RequestEngineExit(FString::Printf(TEXT("Failed to find commandlet class %s"), *Token));
3955 return 1;
3956 }
3957
3958#if PLATFORM_WINDOWS || PLATFORM_MAC || PLATFORM_UNIX
3959 if (GIsConsoleExecutable)
3960 {
3961 if (GLogConsole != nullptr && GLogConsole->IsAttached())
3962 {
3963 GLog->RemoveOutputDevice(GLogConsole);
3964 }
3965 // Setup Ctrl-C handler for console application
3966 FPlatformMisc::SetGracefulTerminationHandler();
3967 }
3968 else
3969#endif
3970 {
3971 // Bring up console unless we're a silent build.
3972 if( GLogConsole && !GIsSilent )
3973 {
3974 GLogConsole->Show( true );
3975 }
3976 }
3977
3978 // print output immediately
3979 setvbuf(stdout, nullptr, _IONBF, 0);
3980
3981 UE_LOGF(LogInit, Log, "Executing %ls", *CommandletClass->GetFullName() );
3982
3983 // Allow commandlets to individually override those settings.
3984 UCommandlet* Default = CastChecked<UCommandlet>(CommandletClass->GetDefaultObject());
3985
3986 if ( IsEngineExitRequested() )
3987 {
3988 // commandlet set IsEngineExitRequested() during construction
3989 return 1;
3990 }
3991
3992 GIsClient = Default->IsClient;
3993 GIsServer = Default->IsServer;
3994#if WITH_EDITOR
3995 GIsEditor = Default->IsEditor;
3996#else
3997 if (Default->IsEditor)
3998 {
3999 UE_LOGF(LogInit, Error, "Cannot run editor commandlet %ls with game executable.", *CommandletClass->GetFullName());
4000 RequestEngineExit(TEXT("Tried to run commandlet in non-editor build"));
4001 return 1;
4002 }
4003#endif
4004 // Reset aux log if we don't want to log to the console window.
4005 if( !Default->LogToConsole )
4006 {
4007 GLog->RemoveOutputDevice( GLogConsole );
4008 }
4009
4010 // allow the commandlet the opportunity to create a custom engine
4011 CommandletClass->GetDefaultObject<UCommandlet>()->CreateCustomEngine(CommandletCommandLine);
4012 if ( GEngine == nullptr )
4013 {
4014#if WITH_EDITOR
4015 if ( GIsEditor )
4016 {
4017 FString EditorEngineClassName;
4018 GConfig->GetString(TEXT("/Script/Engine.Engine"), TEXT("EditorEngine"), EditorEngineClassName, GEngineIni);
4019 UClass* EditorEngineClass = StaticLoadClass( UEditorEngine::StaticClass(), nullptr, *EditorEngineClassName);
4020 if (EditorEngineClass == nullptr)
4021 {
4022 UE_LOGF(LogInit, Fatal, "Failed to load Editor Engine class '%ls'.", *EditorEngineClassName);
4023 }
4024
4025 GEngine = GEditor = NewObject<UEditorEngine>(GetTransientPackage(), EditorEngineClass);
4026
4027 GEngine->ParseCommandline();
4028
4029 UE_LOGF(LogInit, Log, "Initializing Editor Engine...");
4030 GEditor->InitEditor(this);
4031 UE_LOGF(LogInit, Log, "Initializing Editor Engine Completed");
4032 }
4033 else
4034#endif
4035 {
4036 FString GameEngineClassName;
4037 GConfig->GetString(TEXT("/Script/Engine.Engine"), TEXT("GameEngine"), GameEngineClassName, GEngineIni);
4038
4039 UClass* EngineClass = StaticLoadClass( UEngine::StaticClass(), nullptr, *GameEngineClassName);
4040
4041 if (EngineClass == nullptr)
4042 {
4043 UE_LOGF(LogInit, Fatal, "Failed to load Engine class '%ls'.", *GameEngineClassName);
4044 }
4045
4046 // must do this here so that the engine object that we create on the next line receives the correct property values
4047 GEngine = NewObject<UEngine>(GetTransientPackage(), EngineClass);
4048 check(GEngine);
4049
4050 GEngine->ParseCommandline();
4051
4052 UE_LOGF(LogInit, Log, "Initializing Game Engine...");
4053 GEngine->Init(this);
4054 UE_LOGF(LogInit, Log, "Initializing Game Engine Completed");
4055 }
4056 }
4057
4058 // Call init callbacks
4059 {
4060 SCOPED_NAMED_EVENT_TEXT("FCoreDelegates::OnPostEngineInit", CoreDelegatesColor);
4061PRAGMA_DISABLE_DEPRECATION_WARNINGS
4062 FCoreDelegates::OnPostEngineInit.Broadcast();
4063PRAGMA_ENABLE_DEPRECATION_WARNINGS
4064 FCoreDelegates::GetOnPostEngineInit().Broadcast();
4065 }
4066
4067 // Load all the post-engine init modules
4068 ensure(IProjectManager::Get().LoadModulesForProject(ELoadingPhase::PostEngineInit));
4069 ensure(IPluginManager::Get().LoadModulesForEnabledPlugins(ELoadingPhase::PostEngineInit));
4070
4071 // Call module loading phases completion callbacks
4072 SetEngineStartupModuleLoadingComplete();
4073
4074 // Disable the backlog only after module loading is complete because that gives modules
4075 // a chance to consume the backlog when constructing output devices.
4076 GLog->EnableBacklog(false);
4077
4078 //run automation smoke tests now that the commandlet has had a chance to override the above flags and GEngine is available
4079 FAutomationTestFramework::Get().RunSmokeTests();
4080
4081 UCommandlet* Commandlet = NewObject<UCommandlet>(GetTransientPackage(), CommandletClass);
4082 check(Commandlet);
4083 Commandlet->AddToRoot();
4084
4085 // Execute the commandlet.
4086 double CommandletExecutionStartTime = FPlatformTime::Seconds();
4087
4088 // Commandlets don't always handle -run= properly in the commandline so we'll provide them
4089 // with a custom version that doesn't have it.
4090 Commandlet->ParseParms( CommandletCommandLine );
4091#if STATS
4092 // We have to close the scope, otherwise we will end with broken stats.
4093 CycleCount_AfterStats.StopAndResetStatId();
4094#endif // STATS
4095 UE::Stats::FStats::TickCommandletStats();
4096
4097#if WITH_ENGINE
4098 PRIVATE_GRunningCommandletClass = CommandletClass;
4099#endif
4100
4101 {
4102 SCOPED_NAMED_EVENT_TEXT("FCoreDelegates::OnCommandletPreMain", CoreDelegatesColor);
4103 FCoreDelegates::OnCommandletPreMain.Broadcast();
4104 }
4105
4106 int32 ErrorLevel;
4107 {
4108 TRACE_CPUPROFILER_EVENT_SCOPE_TEXT(*WriteToString<512>(TEXT("Commandlet Main "), Commandlet->GetFName()));
4109 FTrackedActivityScope CommandletActivity(FTrackedActivity::GetEngineActivity(), *FString::Printf(TEXT("Running %s"), *Commandlet->GetName()), false, FTrackedActivity::ELight::Green);
4110 ErrorLevel = Commandlet->Main(CommandletCommandLine);
4111 }
4112
4113 {
4114 SCOPED_NAMED_EVENT_TEXT("FCoreDelegates::OnCommandletPostMain", CoreDelegatesColor);
4115 FCoreDelegates::OnCommandletPostMain.Broadcast();
4116 }
4117
4118#if WITH_ENGINE
4119 PRIVATE_GRunningCommandletClass = nullptr;
4120#endif
4121
4122 UE::Stats::FStats::TickCommandletStats();
4123
4124 RequestEngineExit(FString::Printf(TEXT("Commandlet %s finished execution (result %d)"), *Commandlet->GetName(), ErrorLevel));
4125
4126 // Log warning/ error summary.
4127 if( Commandlet->ShowErrorCount )
4128 {
4129 TArray<FString> AllErrors;
4130 TArray<FString> AllWarnings;
4131 GWarn->GetErrors(AllErrors);
4132 GWarn->GetWarnings(AllWarnings);
4133
4134 if (AllErrors.Num() || AllWarnings.Num())
4135 {
4136 SET_WARN_COLOR(COLOR_WHITE);
4137 UE_LOGF(LogInit, Display, "");
4138 UE_LOGF(LogInit, Display, "Warning/Error Summary (Unique only)");
4139 UE_LOGF(LogInit, Display, "-----------------------------------");
4140
4141 const int32 MaxMessagesToShow = (GIsBuildMachine || FParse::Param(FCommandLine::Get(), TEXT("DUMPALLWARNINGS"))) ?
4142 (AllErrors.Num() + AllWarnings.Num()) : 50;
4143
4144 TSet<FString> ShownMessages;
4145 ShownMessages.Empty(MaxMessagesToShow);
4146
4147 SET_WARN_COLOR(COLOR_RED);
4148
4149 for (const FString& ErrorMessage : AllErrors)
4150 {
4151 bool bAlreadyShown = false;
4152 ShownMessages.Add(ErrorMessage, &bAlreadyShown);
4153
4154 if (!bAlreadyShown)
4155 {
4156 if (ShownMessages.Num() > MaxMessagesToShow)
4157 {
4158 SET_WARN_COLOR(COLOR_WHITE);
4159 UE_CLOG(MaxMessagesToShow < AllErrors.Num(), LogInit, Display, TEXT("NOTE: Only first %d errors displayed."), MaxMessagesToShow);
4160 break;
4161 }
4162
4163 UE_LOGF(LogInit, Display, "%ls", *ErrorMessage);
4164 }
4165 }
4166
4167 SET_WARN_COLOR(COLOR_YELLOW);
4168 ShownMessages.Empty(MaxMessagesToShow);
4169
4170 for (const FString& WarningMessage : AllWarnings)
4171 {
4172 bool bAlreadyShown = false;
4173 ShownMessages.Add(WarningMessage, &bAlreadyShown);
4174
4175 if (!bAlreadyShown)
4176 {
4177 if (ShownMessages.Num() > MaxMessagesToShow)
4178 {
4179 SET_WARN_COLOR(COLOR_WHITE);
4180 UE_CLOG(MaxMessagesToShow < AllWarnings.Num(), LogInit, Display, TEXT("NOTE: Only first %d warnings displayed."), MaxMessagesToShow);
4181 break;
4182 }
4183
4184 UE_LOGF(LogInit, Display, "%ls", *WarningMessage);
4185 }
4186 }
4187 }
4188
4189 // Allow the caller to request that we issue an ensure when there are any errors from the executed commandlet
4190 ConditionallyEnsureOnCommandletErrors(AllErrors.Num());
4191
4192 UE_LOGF(LogInit, Display, "");
4193
4194 if( ErrorLevel != 0 )
4195 {
4196 SET_WARN_COLOR(COLOR_RED);
4197 UE_LOGF(LogInit, Display, "Commandlet->Main return this error code: %d", ErrorLevel );
4198 UE_LOGF(LogInit, Display, "With %d error(s), %d warning(s)", AllErrors.Num(), AllWarnings.Num() );
4199 }
4200 else if( ( AllErrors.Num() == 0 ) )
4201 {
4202 SET_WARN_COLOR(AllWarnings.Num() ? COLOR_YELLOW : COLOR_GREEN);
4203 UE_LOGF(LogInit, Display, "Success - %d error(s), %d warning(s)", AllErrors.Num(), AllWarnings.Num() );
4204 }
4205 else
4206 {
4207 SET_WARN_COLOR(COLOR_RED);
4208 UE_LOGF(LogInit, Display, "Failure - %d error(s), %d warning(s)", AllErrors.Num(), AllWarnings.Num() );
4209 }
4210 CLEAR_WARN_COLOR();
4211 }
4212 else
4213 {
4214 UE_LOGF(LogInit, Display, "Finished.");
4215 }
4216
4217 // Return an non-zero code if errors were logged and UseCommandletResultAsExitCode is false
4218 if (!Commandlet->UseCommandletResultAsExitCode)
4219 {
4220 if ((ErrorLevel == 0) && (GWarn->GetNumErrors() > 0))
4221 {
4222 ErrorLevel = 1;
4223 }
4224 }
4225
4226 double CommandletExecutionTime = FPlatformTime::Seconds() - CommandletExecutionStartTime;
4227 FPlatformMemoryStats Stats = FPlatformMemory::GetStats();
4228 uint64 PeakPhysMemoryMB = static_cast<uint64>(Stats.PeakUsedPhysical) / (1024 * 1024);
4229 uint64 PeakVirtMemoryMB = static_cast<uint64>(Stats.PeakUsedVirtual) / (1024 * 1024);
4230 if (CommandletExecutionTime <= 60)
4231 {
4232 UE_LOG(LogInit, Display, LINE_TERMINATOR TEXT("Execution of commandlet took: %.2f seconds, PeakPhysMemoryMB=%llu MB, PeakVirtMemoryMB=%llu MB"),
4233 CommandletExecutionTime, PeakPhysMemoryMB, PeakVirtMemoryMB);
4234 }
4235 else
4236 {
4237 FTimespan ExecutionTimeSpan = FTimespan::FromSeconds(CommandletExecutionTime);
4238 int32 Hours = (int32)(ExecutionTimeSpan.GetTotalHours());
4239 int32 Minutes = ExecutionTimeSpan.GetMinutes();
4240 int32 Seconds = ExecutionTimeSpan.GetSeconds();
4241 // Tried FText::AsTimespan here but it actually felt harder to visually parse than just explicit labeling. Leaving the
4242 // seconds in so that it's easy to subtract between multiple runs.
4243 if (Hours)
4244 {
4245 UE_LOG(LogInit, Display, LINE_TERMINATOR TEXT("Execution of commandlet took: %dh %dm %ds (%.2f seconds), PeakPhysMemoryMB=%llu MB, PeakVirtMemoryMB=%llu MB"), Hours, Minutes, Seconds, CommandletExecutionTime,
4246 PeakPhysMemoryMB, PeakVirtMemoryMB);
4247 }
4248 else
4249 {
4250 UE_LOG(LogInit, Display, LINE_TERMINATOR TEXT("Execution of commandlet took: %dm %ds (%.2f seconds), PeakPhysMemoryMB=%llu MB, PeakVirtMemoryMB=%llu MB"), Minutes, Seconds, CommandletExecutionTime,
4251 PeakPhysMemoryMB, PeakVirtMemoryMB);
4252 }
4253 }
4254
4255 const bool bShouldPerformFastExit = Commandlet->FastExit || FParse::Param(FCommandLine::Get(), TEXT("fastexit"));
4256 if (bShouldPerformFastExit)
4257 {
4258 FPlatformMisc::RequestExitWithStatus(true, ErrorLevel);
4259 }
4260
4261 // We're ready to exit!
4262 return ErrorLevel;
4263 }
4264 else
4265 {
4266 // We're a regular client.
4267 check(bIsRegularClient);
4268
4269 if (bIsPossiblyUnrecognizedCommandlet)
4270 {
4271 // here we give people a reasonable warning if they tried to use the short name of a commandlet
4272 UClass* TempCommandletClass = FindFirstObject<UClass>(*(Token + TEXT("Commandlet")), EFindFirstObjectOptions::None, ELogVerbosity::Warning, TEXT("Looking for commandlet class"));
4273 if (TempCommandletClass)
4274 {
4275 UE_LOGF(LogInit, Fatal, "You probably meant to call a commandlet. Please use the full name %ls.", *(Token+TEXT("Commandlet")));
4276 }
4277 }
4278 }
4279 }
4280
4281 // exit if wanted.
4282 if( IsEngineExitRequested() )
4283 {
4284 if ( GEngine != nullptr )
4285 {
4286#if WITH_EDITOR
4287 if (GIsEditor)
4288 {
4289 SCOPED_NAMED_EVENT_TEXT("FCoreDelegates::OnEditorPreExit", CoreDelegatesColor);
4290 FEditorDelegates::OnEditorPreExit.Broadcast();
4291 }
4292#endif // WITH_EDITOR
4293
4294 GEngine->PreExit();
4295 }
4296 AppPreExit();
4297 // appExit is called outside guarded block.
4298 return 1;
4299 }
4300
4301 FEmbeddedCommunication::ForceTick(8);
4302
4303 if(FParse::Param(FCommandLine::Get(),TEXT("DUMPMOVIE")))
4304 {
4305 // -1: remain on
4306 GIsDumpingMovie = -1;
4307 }
4308
4309 // If dumping movie then we do NOT want on-screen messages
4310 GAreScreenMessagesEnabled = !GIsDumpingMovie && !GIsDemoMode;
4311
4312#if !UE_BUILD_SHIPPING
4313 if (FParse::Param(FCommandLine::Get(),TEXT("NOSCREENMESSAGES")))
4314 {
4315 GAreScreenMessagesEnabled = false;
4316 }
4317
4318 if (GEngine && FParse::Param(FCommandLine::Get(), TEXT("statunit")))
4319 {
4320 GEngine->Exec(nullptr, TEXT("stat unit"));
4321 }
4322
4323 // Don't update INI files if benchmarking or -noini
4324 if( FApp::IsBenchmarking() || FParse::Param(FCommandLine::Get(),TEXT("NOINI")))
4325 {
4326 GConfig->Detach( GEngineIni );
4327 GConfig->Detach( GInputIni );
4328 GConfig->Detach( GGameIni );
4329 GConfig->Detach( GEditorIni );
4330 }
4331#endif // !UE_BUILD_SHIPPING
4332
4333 // initialize the pointer, as it is deleted before being assigned in the first frame
4334 PendingCleanupObjects = nullptr;
4335
4336 // Initialize profile visualizers.
4337#if !(UE_BUILD_SHIPPING || UE_BUILD_TEST)
4338 FModuleManager::Get().LoadModule(TEXT("ProfileVisualizer"));
4339#endif
4340
4341 // Init HighRes screenshot system, unless running on server
4342 if (!IsRunningDedicatedServer())
4343 {
4344 GetHighResScreenshotConfig().Init();
4345 }
4346
4347 // precache compute PSOs for global shaders - enough time should have passed since loading global SM to avoid a blocking load
4348 if (AllowGlobalShaderLoad())
4349 {
4350 PrecacheComputePipelineStatesForGlobalShaders(GMaxRHIFeatureLevel, nullptr);
4351 }
4352
4353 UE::RenderCommandPipe::Initialize();
4354
4355#else // WITH_ENGINE
4356 InitEngineTextLocalization();
4357 InitGameTextLocalization();
4358 FTextLocalizationManager::Get().WaitForAsyncTasks();
4359#if USE_LOCALIZED_PACKAGE_CACHE
4360 {
4361 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("FPackageLocalizationManager::Get().InitializeFromDefaultCache");
4362 FPackageLocalizationManager::Get().InitializeFromDefaultCache();
4363 }
4364#endif // USE_LOCALIZED_PACKAGE_CACHE
4365#if WITH_APPLICATION_CORE
4366 {
4367 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("FPlatformApplicationMisc::PostInit");
4368 FPlatformApplicationMisc::PostInit();
4369 }
4370#endif
4371#endif // WITH_ENGINE
4372
4373 {
4374 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("RunSmokeTests");
4375 //run automation smoke tests now that everything is setup to run
4376 FAutomationTestFramework::Get().RunSmokeTests();
4377 }
4378
4379#if WITH_ENGINE && (!UE_BUILD_SHIPPING)
4380 IRHITestModule* RHIUnitTests = static_cast<IRHITestModule*>(FModuleManager::Get().GetModule(TEXT("RHITests")));
4381 if (RHIUnitTests)
4382 {
4383 RHIUnitTests->RunAllTests();
4384 }
4385#endif //(!UE_BUILD_SHIPPING)
4386
4387 FEmbeddedCommunication::ForceTick(9);
4388
4389 PreInitContext.Cleanup();
4390
4391 // Note we still have 20% remaining on the slow task: this will be used by the Editor/Engine initialization next
4392 return 0;
4393}
4394
4395int32 FEngineLoop::PreInit(const TCHAR* CmdLine)
4396{
4397#if UE_ENABLE_ARRAY_SLACK_TRACKING
4398 // Any array allocations before this point won't have array slack tracking, although subsequent reallocations of existing arrays
4399 // will gain tracking if that occurs. The goal is to filter out startup constructors which run before Main, which introduce a
4400 // ton of noise into slack reports. Especially the roughly 30,000 static FString constructors in the code base, each with a
4401 // unique call stack, and all having a little bit of slack due to malloc bucket size rounding.
4402 ArraySlackTrackInit();
4403#endif
4404
4405 FBootProfiling::InitCounters();
4406
4407 const int32 rv1 = PreInitPreStartupScreen(CmdLine);
4408 if (rv1 != 0)
4409 {
4410 PreInitContext.Cleanup();
4411 return rv1;
4412 }
4413
4414 const int32 rv2 = PreInitPostStartupScreen(CmdLine);
4415 if (rv2 != 0)
4416 {
4417 PreInitContext.Cleanup();
4418 return rv2;
4419 }
4420
4421 return 0;
4422}

4429 RegisterModularObjectsProcessing();

4442void FEngineLoop::LoadPreInitModules()
4443{
4444 DECLARE_SCOPE_CYCLE_COUNTER(TEXT("Loading PreInit Modules"), STAT_PreInitModules, STATGROUP_LoadTime);
4445
4446 // GGetMapNameDelegate is initialized here
4447#if WITH_ENGINE
4448 FModuleManager::Get().LoadModule(TEXT("Engine"));
4449
4450 FModuleManager::Get().LoadModule(TEXT("Renderer"));
4451
4452 FModuleManager::Get().LoadModule(TEXT("AnimGraphRuntime"));
4453
4454 FPlatformApplicationMisc::LoadPreInitModules();
4455
4456#if !UE_SERVER
4457 if (!IsRunningDedicatedServer() )
4458 {
4459 if (!GUsingNullRHI)
4460 {
4461 // This needs to be loaded before InitializeShaderTypes is called

4463 }
4464 }
4465#endif

4467 FModuleManager::Get().LoadModule(TEXT("Landscape"));
4468
4469 FModuleManager::Get().LoadModule(TEXT("RHICore"));

4471 // Initialize ShaderCore before loading or compiling any shaders,
4472 // But after Renderer and any other modules which implement shader types.
4473 FModuleManager::Get().LoadModule(TEXT("RenderCore"));

4475#if WITH_EDITORONLY_DATA
4476 // Load the texture compressor module before any textures load. They may
4477 // compress asynchronously and that can lead to a race condition.

4479#endif

4482 {
4483 FModuleManager::Get().LoadModule(TEXT("Virtualization"));

4487#if WITH_EDITOR
4488 // Load audio editor module before engine class CDOs are loaded

4490
4491#if !(UE_BUILD_SHIPPING || UE_BUILD_TEST) // todo: revist
4492 FModuleManager::Get().LoadModule(TEXT("AnimationModifiers"));

4494#endif // WITH_EDITOR
4495}

4501bool FEngineLoop::LoadStartupCoreModules()
4502{
4503 FScopedSlowTask SlowTask(100);
4504
4505 DECLARE_SCOPE_CYCLE_COUNTER(TEXT("Loading Startup Modules"), STAT_StartupModules, STATGROUP_LoadTime);
4506
4507 bool bSuccess = true;
4508
4509 // Load all Runtime modules
4510 SlowTask.EnterProgressFrame(10);
4511 {
4512 FModuleManager::Get().LoadModule(TEXT("Core"));

4539 SlowTask.EnterProgressFrame(10);
4540#if WITH_EDITOR

4542 FModuleManager::Get().LoadModuleChecked("LandscapeEditorUtilities");
4543 FModuleManager::Get().LoadModuleChecked("SubobjectDataInterface");
4544#endif //WITH_EDITOR
4545
4546 // Load UI modules

4549 {
4550 FModuleManager::Get().LoadModule("SlateCore");

4562 // UMG must be loaded for runtime and cooking.
4563 FModuleManager::Get().LoadModule("UMG");
4564 // ScriptableEditorWidgets was refactored out of UMG, load it now so that we don't break existing
4565 // projets that are not listing it in their uproject or uplugin:

4567#else
4568 if ( !IsRunningDedicatedServer() )
4569 {
4570 // UMG must be loaded for runtime and cooking.
4571 FModuleManager::Get().LoadModule("UMG");
4572 }
4573#endif //WITH_EDITOR
4574
4575 // Load all Development modules
4576 SlowTask.EnterProgressFrame(20);
4577 if (!IsRunningDedicatedServer())
4578 {
4579#if WITH_UNREAL_DEVELOPER_TOOLS
4580 FModuleManager::Get().LoadModule("MessageLog");
4581#endif // WITH_UNREAL_DEVELOPER_TOOLS
4582#if WITH_EDITOR
4583 FModuleManager::Get().LoadModule("CollisionAnalyzer");
4584#endif // WITH_EDITOR

4586
4587#if WITH_UNREAL_DEVELOPER_TOOLS

4590
4591 SlowTask.EnterProgressFrame(30);
4592#if (WITH_EDITOR && !(UE_BUILD_SHIPPING || UE_BUILD_TEST)) // todo: revisit
4593 // HACK: load BT editor as early as possible for statically initialized assets (non cooked BT assets needs it)
4594 // cooking needs this module too

4596
4597 // Ability tasks are based on GameplayTasks, so we need to make sure that module is loaded as well

4608#if (WITH_EDITOR && !(UE_BUILD_SHIPPING || UE_BUILD_TEST)) // todo: revisit

4620 FModuleManager::Get().LoadModule(TEXT("Blutility"));

4622
4623#endif //(WITH_EDITOR && !(UE_BUILD_SHIPPING || UE_BUILD_TEST))
4624
4625#if WITH_EDITOR
4626 if (!IsRunningDedicatedServer())
4627 {
4628 FModuleManager::Get().LoadModule(TEXT("MaterialEditor"));
4629 }
4630#endif // WITH_EDITOR
4631
4632#if WITH_ENGINE
4633 // Load runtime client modules (which are also needed at cook-time)

4635 {
4636 FModuleManager::Get().LoadModule(TEXT("Overlay"));
4637 }
4638
4639 FModuleManager::Get().LoadModule(TEXT("MediaAssets"));
4640#endif
4641
4642 FModuleManager::Get().LoadModule(TEXT("ClothingSystemRuntimeNv"));
4643#if WITH_EDITOR
4644 FModuleManager::Get().LoadModule(TEXT("ClothingSystemEditor"));
4645 FModuleManager::Get().LoadModule(TEXT("AnimationDataController"));

4647 // Required during serialization of AnimSequence which could happen from async loading thread.

4652 // See UAnimBlueprint::UAnimBlueprint().

4654

4656
4657 FModuleManager::Get().LoadModule(TEXT("WorldPartitionEditor"));

4660 FModuleManager::Get().LoadModule(TEXT("PacketHandler"));
4661 FModuleManager::Get().LoadModule(TEXT("NetworkReplayStreaming"));
4662
4663 FModuleManager::Get().LoadModule(TEXT("MassEntity"));
4664
4665 return bSuccess;

4669bool FEngineLoop::LoadStartupModules()
4670{
4671 FScopedSlowTask SlowTask(3);
4672 LLM_SCOPE_BYNAME(TEXT("Modules"));
4673 SlowTask.EnterProgressFrame(1);
4674 // Load any modules that want to be loaded before default modules are loaded up.
4675 if (!IProjectManager::Get().LoadModulesForProject(ELoadingPhase::PreDefault) || !IPluginManager::Get().LoadModulesForEnabledPlugins(ELoadingPhase::PreDefault))
4676 {
4677 return false;
4678 }
4679
4680 SlowTask.EnterProgressFrame(1);
4681 // Load modules that are configured to load in the default phase
4682 if (!IProjectManager::Get().LoadModulesForProject(ELoadingPhase::Default) || !IPluginManager::Get().LoadModulesForEnabledPlugins(ELoadingPhase::Default))
4683 {
4684 return false;
4685 }
4686
4687 SlowTask.EnterProgressFrame(1);
4688 // Load any modules that want to be loaded after default modules are loaded up.
4689 if (!IProjectManager::Get().LoadModulesForProject(ELoadingPhase::PostDefault) || !IPluginManager::Get().LoadModulesForEnabledPlugins(ELoadingPhase::PostDefault))
4690 {
4691 return false;
4692 }
4693
4694 return true;
4695}

4698void FEngineLoop::InitTime()
4699{
4700 // Init variables used for benchmarking and ticking.
4701 FApp::SetCurrentTime(FPlatformTime::Seconds());
4702 MaxFrameCounter = 0;
4703 MaxTickTime = 0;
4704 TotalTickTime = 0;
4705 LastFrameCycles = FPlatformTime::Cycles();
4706
4707 float FloatMaxTickTime = 0;
4708#if (!UE_BUILD_SHIPPING || ENABLE_PGO_PROFILE)
4709 FParse::Value(FCommandLine::Get(),TEXT("SECONDS="),FloatMaxTickTime);
4710 MaxTickTime = FloatMaxTickTime;
4711
4712 // look of a version of seconds that only is applied if FApp::IsBenchmarking() is set. This makes it easier on
4713 // say, iOS, where we have a toggle setting to enable benchmarking, but don't want to have to make user
4714 // also disable the seconds setting as well. -seconds= will exit the app after time even if benchmarking
4715 // is not enabled
4716 // NOTE: This will override -seconds= if it's specified
4717 if (FApp::IsBenchmarking())
4718 {
4719 if (FParse::Value(FCommandLine::Get(),TEXT("BENCHMARKSECONDS="),FloatMaxTickTime) && FloatMaxTickTime)
4720 {
4721 MaxTickTime = FloatMaxTickTime;
4722 }
4723 }
4724
4725 // Use -FPS=X to override fixed tick rate if e.g. -BENCHMARK is used.
4726 float FixedFPS = 0;
4727 FParse::Value(FCommandLine::Get(),TEXT("FPS="),FixedFPS);
4728 if( FixedFPS > 0 )
4729 {
4730 FApp::SetFixedDeltaTime(1 / FixedFPS);
4731 }
4732
4733#endif // !UE_BUILD_SHIPPING
4734
4735 // convert FloatMaxTickTime into number of frames (using 1 / FApp::GetFixedDeltaTime() to convert fps to seconds )
4736 MaxFrameCounter = FMath::TruncToInt(MaxTickTime / FApp::GetFixedDeltaTime());
4737}

4747int32 FEngineLoop::Init()
4748{
4749 ON_SCOPE_EXIT
4750 {
4751#if TRACK_DISK_UTILIZATION
4752 CSV_METADATA(TEXT("BootMBLoaded"), *FString::FromInt(GDiskUtilizationTracker.GetLongTermStats().TotalBytesRead / (1024 * 1024)));
4753#endif
4754 FBootProfiling::OnInitComplete();
4755 };
4756 LLM_SCOPE(ELLMTag::EngineInitMemory);
4757 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("FEngineLoop::Init");
4758
4759 DECLARE_SCOPE_CYCLE_COUNTER( TEXT( "FEngineLoop::Init" ), STAT_FEngineLoop_Init, STATGROUP_LoadTime );
4760
4761 FScopedSlowTask SlowTask(100);
4762 SlowTask.EnterProgressFrame(10);
4763
4764 FEmbeddedCommunication::ForceTick(10);
4765
4766 // Figure out which UEngine variant to use.
4767 UClass* EngineClass = nullptr;
4768 if( !GIsEditor )
4769 {
4770 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("Create GEngine");
4771 // We're the game.
4772 FString GameEngineClassName;
4773 GConfig->GetString(TEXT("/Script/Engine.Engine"), TEXT("GameEngine"), GameEngineClassName, GEngineIni);
4774 EngineClass = StaticLoadClass( UGameEngine::StaticClass(), nullptr, *GameEngineClassName);
4775 if (EngineClass == nullptr)
4776 {
4777 UE_LOGF(LogInit, Fatal, "Failed to load Game Engine class '%ls'.", *GameEngineClassName);
4778 }
4779 GEngine = NewObject<UEngine>(GetTransientPackage(), EngineClass);
4780 }
4781 else
4782 {
4783#if WITH_EDITOR
4784 // We're UnrealEd.
4785 FString UnrealEdEngineClassName;
4786 GConfig->GetString(TEXT("/Script/Engine.Engine"), TEXT("UnrealEdEngine"), UnrealEdEngineClassName, GEngineIni);
4787 EngineClass = StaticLoadClass(UUnrealEdEngine::StaticClass(), nullptr, *UnrealEdEngineClassName);
4788 if (EngineClass == nullptr)
4789 {
4790 UE_LOGF(LogInit, Fatal, "Failed to load UnrealEd Engine class '%ls'.", *UnrealEdEngineClassName);
4791 }
4792 GEngine = GEditor = GUnrealEd = NewObject<UUnrealEdEngine>(GetTransientPackage(), EngineClass);
4793#else
4794 check(0);
4795#endif
4796 }
4797
4798 FEmbeddedCommunication::ForceTick(11);
4799
4800 check( GEngine );
4801
4802 if (IsMoviePlayerEnabled())
4803 {
4804 GetMoviePlayer()->PassLoadingScreenWindowBackToGame();
4805 }
4806
4807 if (FPreLoadScreenManager::Get())
4808 {
4809 FPreLoadScreenManager::Get()->PassPreLoadScreenWindowBackToGame();
4810 }
4811
4812 {
4813 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("GEngine->ParseCommandline()");
4814 GEngine->ParseCommandline();
4815 }
4816
4817 FEmbeddedCommunication::ForceTick(12);
4818
4819 {
4820 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("InitTime");
4821 InitTime();
4822 }
4823
4824 SlowTask.EnterProgressFrame(60);
4825
4826 {
4827 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("GEngine->Init");
4828 GEngine->Init(this);
4829 }
4830
4831 // Call init callbacks
4832 {
4833 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("FCoreDelegates::OnPostEngineInit");
4834PRAGMA_DISABLE_DEPRECATION_WARNINGS
4835 FCoreDelegates::OnPostEngineInit.Broadcast();
4836PRAGMA_ENABLE_DEPRECATION_WARNINGS
4837 FCoreDelegates::GetOnPostEngineInit().Broadcast();
4838 }
4839
4840 SlowTask.EnterProgressFrame(30);
4841
4842 // initialize engine instance discovery
4843 if (FPlatformProcess::SupportsMultithreading())
4844 {
4845 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("SessionService etc");
4846 if (!IsRunningCommandlet())
4847 {
4848 SessionService = FModuleManager::LoadModuleChecked<ISessionServicesModule>("SessionServices").GetSessionService();
4849
4850 if (SessionService.IsValid())
4851 {
4852 SessionService->Start();
4853 }
4854 }
4855
4856 EngineService = new FEngineService();
4857 TraceService = new FTraceService();
4858 }
4859
4860 {
4861 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("IProjectManager::Get().LoadModulesForProject(ELoadingPhase::PostEngineInit)");
4862 // Load all the post-engine init modules
4863 if (!IProjectManager::Get().LoadModulesForProject(ELoadingPhase::PostEngineInit) || !IPluginManager::Get().LoadModulesForEnabledPlugins(ELoadingPhase::PostEngineInit))
4864 {
4865 RequestEngineExit(TEXT("One or more modules failed PostEngineInit"));
4866 return 1;
4867 }
4868 }
4869
4870 // Call module loading phases completion callbacks
4871 SetEngineStartupModuleLoadingComplete();
4872
4873 // Disable the backlog only after module loading is complete because that gives modules
4874 // a chance to consume the backlog when constructing output devices.
4875 GLog->EnableBacklog(false);
4876
4877 {
4878 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("GEngine->Start()");
4879 GEngine->Start();
4880 }
4881
4882 FEmbeddedCommunication::ForceTick(13);
4883
4884 if (FPreLoadScreenManager::Get() && FPreLoadScreenManager::Get()->HasActivePreLoadScreenType(EPreLoadScreenTypes::EngineLoadingScreen))
4885 {
4886 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("WaitForEngineLoadingScreenToFinish");
4887 FPreLoadScreenManager::Get()->SetEngineLoadingComplete(true);
4888 FPreLoadScreenManager::Get()->WaitForEngineLoadingScreenToFinish();
4889 }
4890 else if (IsMoviePlayerEnabled())
4891 {
4892 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("WaitForMovieToFinish");
4893 GetMoviePlayer()->WaitForMovieToFinish();
4894 }
4895
4896 FTraceAuxiliary::EnableCommandlineChannels();
4897
4898#if !UE_SERVER
4899 // initialize media framework
4900 IMediaModule* MediaModule = FModuleManager::LoadModulePtr<IMediaModule>("Media");
4901
4902 if (MediaModule != nullptr)
4903 {
4904 MediaModule->SetTimeSource(MakeShareable(new FAppMediaTimeSource));
4905 }
4906#endif
4907
4908 FEmbeddedCommunication::ForceTick(14);
4909
4910 // initialize automation worker
4911#if WITH_AUTOMATION_WORKER
4912 FModuleManager::Get().LoadModule("AutomationWorker");
4913#endif
4914
4915 // Automation tests can be invoked locally in non-editor builds configuration (e.g. performance profiling in Test configuration)
4916#if WITH_ENGINE && !UE_BUILD_SHIPPING
4917 FModuleManager::Get().LoadModule("AutomationController");
4918 FModuleManager::GetModuleChecked<IAutomationControllerModule>("AutomationController").Init();
4919#endif
4920
4921#if WITH_EDITOR
4922 FModuleManager::Get().LoadModule(TEXT("SequenceRecorder"));
4923 FModuleManager::Get().LoadModule(TEXT("SequenceRecorderSections"));
4924#endif
4925
4926 GIsRunning = true;
4927
4928 if (!GIsEditor)
4929 {
4930 // hide a couple frames worth of rendering
4931 FViewport::SetGameRenderingEnabled(true, 3);
4932 }
4933
4934 FEmbeddedCommunication::ForceTick(15);
4935
4936 FCoreDelegates::StarvedGameLoop.BindStatic(&GameLoopIsStarved);
4937
4938 // Ready to measure thread heartbeat
4939 FThreadHeartBeat::Get().Start();
4940
4941 FShaderPipelineCache::PauseBatching();
4942 {
4943#if defined(WITH_CODE_GUARD_HANDLER) && WITH_CODE_GUARD_HANDLER
4944 void CheckImageIntegrity();
4945 CheckImageIntegrity();
4946#endif
4947 }
4948
4949 {
4950 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("FCoreDelegates::OnFEngineLoopInitComplete");
4951 FCoreDelegates::OnFEngineLoopInitComplete.Broadcast();
4952 }
4953 FShaderPipelineCache::ResumeBatching();
4954
4955#if BUILD_EMBEDDED_APP
4956 FEmbeddedCommunication::AllowSleep(TEXT("Startup"));
4957 FEmbeddedCommunication::KeepAwake(TEXT("FirstTicks"), true);
4958#endif
4959
4960#if UE_EXTERNAL_PROFILING_ENABLED
4961 FExternalProfiler* ActiveProfiler = FActiveExternalProfilerBase::InitActiveProfiler();
4962 if (ActiveProfiler)
4963 {
4964 ActiveProfiler->Register();
4965 }
4966#endif // UE_EXTERNAL_PROFILING_ENABLED
4967
4968 FDelayedAutoRegisterHelper::RunAndClearDelayedAutoRegisterDelegates(EDelayedRegisterRunPhase::EndOfEngineInit);
4969
4970 FThreadHeartBeat::Get().InitSettings();
4971 FGameThreadHitchHeartBeat::Get().InitSettings();
4972
4973 // Emit logging. Don't edit! Automation looks for this to detect failures during initialization.
4974 UE_LOGF(LogInit, Display, "Engine is initialized. Leaving FEngineLoop::Init()");
4975 return 0;
4976}

4979// 5.4.2 local change to avoid modifying public headers
4980namespace PipelineStateCache
4981{
4982 // Waits for any pending tasks to complete.
4983 extern RHI_API void WaitForAllTasks();
4984
4985}
4986
4987void FEngineLoop::Exit()
4988{
4989 STAT_ADD_CUSTOMMESSAGE_NAME( STAT_NamedMarker, TEXT( "EngineLoop.Exit" ) );
4990 SCOPED_NAMED_EVENT_TEXT("FEngineLoop::Exit", FrameColor);
4991 TRACE_BOOKMARK(TEXT("EngineLoop.Exit"));
4992
4993 // Reset all ticker elements. Registered lambda ticker functions can hold on to resources in their captures,
4994 // so we want to make sure those are released before shutting down.
4995 FTSTicker::GetCoreTicker().Reset();
4996
4997 ClearPendingCleanupObjects();
4998
4999 GIsRunning = 0;
5000 GLogConsole = nullptr;
5001
5002 IInstallBundleManager::InstallBundleCompleteDelegate.RemoveAll(this);
5003
5004 if (FPreLoadScreenManager::Get())
5005 {
5006 // If we exit before the preload screen is done, clean it up before shutting down
5007 if (FPreLoadScreenManager::Get()->HasActivePreLoadScreenType(EPreLoadScreenTypes::EngineLoadingScreen))
5008 {
5009 FPreLoadScreenManager::Get()->SetEngineLoadingComplete(true);
5010 FPreLoadScreenManager::Get()->WaitForEngineLoadingScreenToFinish();
5011 }
5012
5013 FPreLoadScreenManager::Destroy();
5014 }
5015
5016 // shutdown visual logger and flush all data
5017#if ENABLE_VISUAL_LOG
5018 FVisualLogger::Get().TearDown();
5019#endif
5020
5021 FAssetCompilingManager::Get().Shutdown();
5022
5023#if WITH_ENGINE
5024 // shut down messaging
5025 delete EngineService;
5026 EngineService = nullptr;
5027
5028 delete TraceService;
5029 TraceService = nullptr;
5030
5031 if (SessionService.IsValid())
5032 {
5033 SessionService->Stop();
5034 SessionService.Reset();
5035 }
5036
5037 if (GDistanceFieldAsyncQueue)
5038 {
5039 delete GDistanceFieldAsyncQueue;
5040 GDistanceFieldAsyncQueue = nullptr;
5041 }
5042
5043 if (GCardRepresentationAsyncQueue)
5044 {
5045 delete GCardRepresentationAsyncQueue;
5046 GCardRepresentationAsyncQueue = nullptr;
5047 }
5048#endif // WITH_ENGINE
5049
5050 // Make sure we're not in the middle of loading something after this point as some
5051 // systems are shut down during PreExit and it can cause issues and crashes if loading continues
5052 // beyond this point.
5053 FlushAsyncLoading();
5054
5055 if ( GEngine != nullptr )
5056 {
5057#if WITH_EDITOR
5058 if (GIsEditor)
5059 {
5060 SCOPED_NAMED_EVENT_TEXT("FCoreDelegates::OnEditorPreExit", CoreDelegatesColor);
5061 FEditorDelegates::OnEditorPreExit.Broadcast();
5062 }
5063#endif // WITH_EDITOR
5064
5065 GEngine->PreExit();
5066 }
5067
5068 if (GEngine != nullptr)
5069 {
5070 GEngine->ReleaseAudioDeviceManager();
5071 }
5072
5073
5074 // Make sure we're not in the middle of loading something.
5075 {
5076 FlushAsyncLoading();
5077
5078 // From now on it's not allowed to request new async loads
5079 // any new requests done during the scope of the flush should have been flushed as well, now prevent any new requests
5080 SetAsyncLoadingAllowed(false);
5081 }
5082
5083 // Block till all outstanding resource streaming requests are fulfilled.
5084 if (!IStreamingManager::HasShutdown())
5085 {
5086 UTexture2D::CancelPendingTextureStreaming();
5087 if (FStreamingManagerCollection* StreamingManager = IStreamingManager::Get_Concurrent())
5088 {
5089 StreamingManager->BlockTillAllRequestsFinished();
5090 }
5091 }
5092 FAudioDeviceManager::Shutdown();
5093
5094 // close all windows
5095 FSlateApplication::Shutdown();
5096
5097#if !UE_SERVER
5098 if ( FEngineFontServices::IsInitialized() )
5099 {
5100 FEngineFontServices::Destroy();
5101 }
5102#endif
5103
5104
5105
5106#if WITH_EDITOR
5107 // These module must be shut down first because other modules may try to access them during shutdown.
5108 // Accessing these modules at shutdown causes instability since the object system will have been shut down and these modules uses uobjects internally.
5109 FModuleManager::Get().UnloadModule("AssetTools", true);
5110
5111#endif // WITH_EDITOR
5112 FModuleManager::Get().UnloadModule("WorldBrowser", true);
5113
5114
5115#if WITH_ENGINE
5116 // Reset any in progress PSO compile requests, reduces pipelinestatecache task wait time.
5117 ClearMaterialPSORequests();
5118#endif
5119
5120 // Wait for any pending tasks to complete.
5121 PipelineStateCache::WaitForAllTasks();
5122
5123 AppPreExit();
5124
5125 TermGamePhys();
5126
5127#if WITH_EDITOR
5128 IBulkDataRegistry::Shutdown();
5129#endif
5130
5131#if WITH_COREUOBJECT
5132 // PackageResourceManager depends on AssetRegistry, so must be shutdown before we unload the AssetRegistry module
5133 IPackageResourceManager::Shutdown();
5134#endif
5135 FModuleManager::Get().UnloadModule("AssetRegistry", true);
5136
5137 // Stop the rendering thread.
5138 ShutdownRenderingThread();
5139
5140 // Disable the PSO cache
5141 FShaderPipelineCache::Shutdown();
5142
5143 // Free the global shader map, needs to happen before FShaderCodeLibrary::Shutdown to avoid warnings
5144 // about leaking RHI references.
5145 ShutdownGlobalShaderMap();
5146
5147 // Close shader code map, if any
5148 FShaderCodeLibrary::Shutdown();
5149
5150 // Stop IoDispatcher after FShaderCodeLibrary, as it holds on to file requests
5151#if WITH_ENGINE
5152 UE::DerivedData::IoStore::TearDownIoDispatcher();
5153#endif
5154#if USE_IO_DISPATCHER
5155 FIoDispatcher::Shutdown();
5156 FModuleManager::Get().UnloadModule("IoStoreOnDemandCore", true);
5157#if UE_WITH_IOSTOREONDEMAND
5158 FModuleManager::Get().UnloadModule("IoStoreOnDemand", true);
5159#endif
5160#endif
5161
5162#if WITH_EDITOR
5163 // Make sure we shut this down before the modules are torn down, we can clean this up if/when the
5164 // virtualization module is moved to be a plugin
5165 UE::Virtualization::Shutdown();
5166#endif //WITH_EDITOR
5167
5168#if WITH_ENGINE
5169 // Save the hot reload state
5170 IHotReloadInterface* HotReload = IHotReloadInterface::GetPtr();
5171 if(HotReload != nullptr)
5172 {
5173 HotReload->SaveConfig();
5174 }
5175#endif
5176
5177 // Unload all modules. Note that this doesn't actually unload the module DLLs (that happens at
5178 // process exit by the OS), but it does call ShutdownModule() on all loaded modules in the reverse
5179 // order they were loaded in, so that systems can unregister and perform general clean up.
5180 {
5181 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("UnloadModulesAtShutdown");
5182 FModuleManager::Get().UnloadModulesAtShutdown();
5183 }
5184
5185 IStreamingManager::Shutdown();
5186
5187 DestroyMoviePlayer();
5188
5189 // Move earlier?
5190#if STATS
5191 FThreadStats::StopThread();
5192#endif
5193
5194 // Clean up the thread pool
5195 // GThreadPool might be a wrapper around GLargeThreadPool so we have to destroy it first
5196 if (GThreadPool != nullptr)
5197 {
5198 GThreadPool->Destroy();
5199 }
5200
5201#if WITH_EDITOR
5202 if (GLargeThreadPool != nullptr)
5203 {
5204 GLargeThreadPool->Destroy();
5205 }
5206#endif // WITH_EDITOR
5207
5208 if (GBackgroundPriorityThreadPool != nullptr)
5209 {
5210 GBackgroundPriorityThreadPool->Destroy();
5211 }
5212
5213 RHIExit();
5214
5215 FTaskGraphInterface::Shutdown();
5216
5217 FPlatformMisc::ShutdownTaggedStorage();
5218
5219#if WITH_EDITOR && PLATFORM_WINDOWS

5221#endif
5222
5223#if WITH_ENGINE && FRAMEPRO_ENABLED
5224 FFrameProProfiler::TearDown();
5225#endif // FRAMEPRO_ENABLED
5226
5227 UE::Trace::Exit();

5230
5231void FEngineLoop::ProcessLocalPlayerSlateOperations() const
5232{
5233 FSlateApplication& SlateApp = FSlateApplication::Get();
5234
5235 // For all the game worlds drill down to the player controller for each game viewport and process it's slate operation
5236 for ( const FWorldContext& Context : GEngine->GetWorldContexts() )
5237 {
5238 UWorld* CurWorld = Context.World();
5239 if ( CurWorld && CurWorld->IsGameWorld() )
5240 {
5241 UGameViewportClient* GameViewportClient = CurWorld->GetGameViewport();
5242 TSharedPtr< SViewport > ViewportWidget = GameViewportClient ? GameViewportClient->GetGameViewportWidget() : nullptr;
5243
5244 if ( ViewportWidget.IsValid() )
5245 {
5246 FWidgetPath PathToWidget;
5247 SlateApp.GeneratePathToWidgetUnchecked(ViewportWidget.ToSharedRef(), PathToWidget);
5248
5249 if (PathToWidget.IsValid())
5250 {
5251 for (FConstPlayerControllerIterator Iterator = CurWorld->GetPlayerControllerIterator(); Iterator; ++Iterator)
5252 {
5253 APlayerController* PlayerController = Iterator->Get();
5254 if (PlayerController)
5255 {
5256 if (ULocalPlayer* LocalPlayer = Cast<ULocalPlayer>(PlayerController->Player))
5257 {
5258 TOptional<int32> UserIndex = SlateApp.GetUserIndexForController(LocalPlayer->GetControllerId());
5259 if (UserIndex.IsSet())
5260 {
5261 FReply& TheReply = LocalPlayer->GetSlateOperations();
5262 SlateApp.ProcessExternalReply(PathToWidget, TheReply, UserIndex.GetValue());
5263
5264 TheReply = FReply::Unhandled();
5265 }
5266 }
5267 }
5268 }
5269 }
5270 }
5271 }
5272 }
5273}

5325bool FEngineLoop::ShouldUseIdleMode() const
5326{
5327 static const auto CVarIdleWhenNotForeground = IConsoleManager::Get().FindTConsoleVariableDataInt(TEXT("t.IdleWhenNotForeground"));
5328 bool bIdleMode = false;
5329
5330 // Yield cpu usage if desired
5331 if (FApp::IsGame()
5332 && FPlatformProperties::SupportsWindowedMode()
5333 && CVarIdleWhenNotForeground->GetValueOnGameThread()
5334 && !FApp::HasFocus())
5335 {
5336 bIdleMode = true;
5337 }
5338
5339#if BUILD_EMBEDDED_APP
5340 if (FEmbeddedCommunication::IsAwakeForTicking() == false)
5341 {
5342 bIdleMode = true;
5343 }
5344#endif
5345
5346 if (bIdleMode)
5347 {
5348 for (const FWorldContext& Context : GEngine->GetWorldContexts())
5349 {
5350 if (!Context.World()->AreAlwaysLoadedLevelsLoaded())
5351 {
5352 bIdleMode = false;
5353 break;
5354 }
5355 }
5356 }
5357
5358 return bIdleMode;
5359}

5361#if !UE_BUILD_SHIPPING && !UE_BUILD_TEST && MALLOC_GT_HOOKS
5362
5363#include "Containers/StackTracker.h"
5364static TAutoConsoleVariable<int32> CVarLogGameThreadMallocChurn(
5365 TEXT("LogGameThreadMallocChurn.Enable"),
5366 0,
5367 TEXT("If > 0, then collect sample game thread malloc, realloc and free, periodically print a report of the worst offenders."));
5368
5369static TAutoConsoleVariable<int32> CVarLogGameThreadMallocChurn_PrintFrequency(
5370 TEXT("LogGameThreadMallocChurn.PrintFrequency"),
5371 300,
5372 TEXT("Number of frames between churn reports."));
5373
5374static TAutoConsoleVariable<int32> CVarLogGameThreadMallocChurn_Threshhold(
5375 TEXT("LogGameThreadMallocChurn.Threshhold"),
5376 10,
5377 TEXT("Minimum average number of allocs per frame to include in the report."));
5378
5379static TAutoConsoleVariable<int32> CVarLogGameThreadMallocChurn_SampleFrequency(
5380 TEXT("LogGameThreadMallocChurn.SampleFrequency"),
5381 100,
5382 TEXT("Number of allocs to skip between samples. This is used to prevent churn sampling from slowing the game down too much."));
5383
5384static TAutoConsoleVariable<int32> CVarLogGameThreadMallocChurn_StackIgnore(
5385 TEXT("LogGameThreadMallocChurn.StackIgnore"),
5386 2,
5387 TEXT("Number of items to discard from the top of a stack frame."));
5388
5389static TAutoConsoleVariable<int32> CVarLogGameThreadMallocChurn_RemoveAliases(
5390 TEXT("LogGameThreadMallocChurn.RemoveAliases"),
5391 1,
5392 TEXT("If > 0 then remove aliases from the counting process. This essentialy merges addresses that have the same human readable string. It is slower."));
5393
5394static TAutoConsoleVariable<int32> CVarLogGameThreadMallocChurn_StackLen(
5395 TEXT("LogGameThreadMallocChurn.StackLen"),
5396 3,
5397 TEXT("Maximum number of stack frame items to keep. This improves aggregation because calls that originate from multiple places but end up in the same place will be accounted together."));
5398
5399
5400extern CORE_API TFunction<void(int32)>* GGameThreadMallocHook;
5401
5402struct FScopedSampleMallocChurn
5403{
5404 static FStackTracker GGameThreadMallocChurnTracker;
5405 static uint64 DumpFrame;
5406
5407 bool bEnabled;
5408 int32 CountDown;
5409 TFunction<void(int32)> Hook;
5410
5411 FScopedSampleMallocChurn()
5412 : bEnabled(CVarLogGameThreadMallocChurn.GetValueOnGameThread() > 0)
5413 , CountDown(CVarLogGameThreadMallocChurn_SampleFrequency.GetValueOnGameThread())
5414 , Hook(
5415 [this](int32 Index)
5416 {
5417 if (--CountDown <= 0)
5418 {
5419 CountDown = CVarLogGameThreadMallocChurn_SampleFrequency.GetValueOnGameThread();
5420 CollectSample();
5421 }
5422 }
5423 )
5424 {
5425 if (bEnabled)
5426 {
5427 check(IsInGameThread());
5428 check(!GGameThreadMallocHook);
5429 if (!DumpFrame)
5430 {
5431 DumpFrame = GFrameCounter + CVarLogGameThreadMallocChurn_PrintFrequency.GetValueOnGameThread();
5432 GGameThreadMallocChurnTracker.ResetTracking();
5433 }
5434 GGameThreadMallocChurnTracker.ToggleTracking(true, true);
5435 GGameThreadMallocHook = &Hook;
5436 }
5437 else
5438 {
5439 check(IsInGameThread());
5440 GGameThreadMallocChurnTracker.ToggleTracking(false, true);
5441 if (DumpFrame)
5442 {
5443 DumpFrame = 0;
5444 GGameThreadMallocChurnTracker.ResetTracking();
5445 }
5446 }
5447 }
5448 ~FScopedSampleMallocChurn()
5449 {
5450 if (bEnabled)
5451 {
5452 check(IsInGameThread());
5453 check(GGameThreadMallocHook == &Hook);
5454 GGameThreadMallocHook = nullptr;
5455 GGameThreadMallocChurnTracker.ToggleTracking(false, true);
5456 check(DumpFrame);
5457 if (GFrameCounter > DumpFrame)
5458 {
5459 PrintResultsAndReset();
5460 }
5461 }
5462 }
5463
5464 void CollectSample()
5465 {
5466 check(IsInGameThread());
5467 GGameThreadMallocChurnTracker.CaptureStackTrace(CVarLogGameThreadMallocChurn_StackIgnore.GetValueOnGameThread(), nullptr, CVarLogGameThreadMallocChurn_StackLen.GetValueOnGameThread(), CVarLogGameThreadMallocChurn_RemoveAliases.GetValueOnGameThread() > 0);
5468 }
5469 void PrintResultsAndReset()
5470 {
5471 DumpFrame = GFrameCounter + CVarLogGameThreadMallocChurn_PrintFrequency.GetValueOnGameThread();
5472 FOutputDeviceRedirector* Log = FOutputDeviceRedirector::Get();
5473 float SampleAndFrameCorrection = float(CVarLogGameThreadMallocChurn_SampleFrequency.GetValueOnGameThread()) / float(CVarLogGameThreadMallocChurn_PrintFrequency.GetValueOnGameThread());
5474 GGameThreadMallocChurnTracker.DumpStackTraces(CVarLogGameThreadMallocChurn_Threshhold.GetValueOnGameThread(), *Log, SampleAndFrameCorrection);
5475 GGameThreadMallocChurnTracker.ResetTracking();
5476 }
5477};
5478FStackTracker FScopedSampleMallocChurn::GGameThreadMallocChurnTracker;
5479uint64 FScopedSampleMallocChurn::DumpFrame = 0;
5480
5481#endif

5486
5487static inline void BeginFrameRenderThread(FRHICommandListImmediate& RHICmdList, uint64 CurrentFrameCounter)
5488{
5489 if ( !FApp::CanEverRender() )
5490 {
5491 GFrameNumberRenderThread++;
5492 return;
5493 }
5494
5495 TRACE_BEGIN_FRAME(TraceFrameType_Rendering);
5496 GFrameNumberRenderThread++;
5497
5498#if WITH_RHI_BREADCRUMBS
5499#if CSV_PROFILER
5500 if (FCsvProfiler::Get()->IsCapturing_Renderthread())
5501 {
5502 GRHIFrameBreadcrumb.Emplace(RHICmdList, RHI_BREADCRUMB_DESC_FORWARD_VALUES(TEXT("Frame"), TEXT("Frame %d (CsvFrame %d)"), RHI_GPU_STAT_ARGS_NONE)(
5503 RHI_BREADCRUMB_FIELD("Frame Number", CurrentFrameCounter)
5504 , RHI_BREADCRUMB_FIELD("Csv Frame Number", FCsvProfiler::Get()->GetCaptureFrameNumberRT())
5505 ));
5506 }
5507 else
5508#endif // CSV_PROFILER
5509 {
5510 GRHIFrameBreadcrumb.Emplace(RHICmdList, RHI_BREADCRUMB_DESC_FORWARD_VALUES(TEXT("Frame"), TEXT("Frame %d"), RHI_GPU_STAT_ARGS_NONE)(
5511 RHI_BREADCRUMB_FIELD("Frame Number", CurrentFrameCounter)
5512 ));
5513 }
5514#endif // WITH_RHI_BREADCRUMBS
5515
5516 {
5517 SCOPED_NAMED_EVENT_TEXT("FCoreDelegates::OnBeginFrameRT", CoreDelegatesColor);
5518 FCoreDelegates::OnBeginFrameRT.Broadcast();
5519 }
5520
5521 RHICmdList.EnqueueLambda([CurrentFrameCounter](FRHICommandListImmediate& InRHICmdList)
5522 {
5523 UEngine::SetRenderSubmitLatencyMarkerStart(CurrentFrameCounter);
5524 });
5525
5526#if CSV_PROFILER_STATS
5527 FCsvProfiler::BeginExclusiveStat("RenderThreadOther");
5528#endif
5529
5530 GVisualizeTexture.BeginFrameRenderThread();
5531
5532 // Waits after this point but before BeginRenderingViewFamilies are not on the RT critical path (since we're waiting for the GT)
5533 UE::Stats::FThreadIdleStats::EndCriticalPath();
5534}
5535
5536
5537static inline void EndFrameRenderThread(FRHICommandListImmediate& RHICmdList, uint64 CurrentFrameCounter)
5538{
5539 if ( !FApp::CanEverRender() )
5540 {
5541 RHICmdList.EndFrame();
5542 return;
5543 }
5544
5545#if CSV_PROFILER_STATS
5546 FCsvProfiler::EndExclusiveStat("RenderThreadOther");
5547#endif
5548
5549 RHICmdList.EnqueueLambda([CurrentFrameCounter](FRHICommandListImmediate& InRHICmdList)
5550 {
5551 UEngine::SetRenderSubmitLatencyMarkerEnd(CurrentFrameCounter);
5552 });
5553
5554 {
5555 SCOPED_NAMED_EVENT_TEXT("FCoreDelegates::OnEndFrameRT", CoreDelegatesColor);
5556 FCoreDelegates::OnEndFrameRT.Broadcast();
5557 }
5558
5559 GVisualizeTexture.EndFrameRenderThread();
5560
5561#if WITH_RHI_BREADCRUMBS
5562 GRHIFrameBreadcrumb->End(RHICmdList);
5563 GRHIFrameBreadcrumb.Reset();
5564#endif
5565
5566 RHICmdList.EndFrame();
5567
5568 TRACE_END_FRAME(TraceFrameType_Rendering);
5569}
