5574
5575void FEngineLoop::Tick()
5576{
5577 SCOPED_NAMED_EVENT_TEXT("FEngineLoop::Tick", FrameColor);
5578 SCOPE_STALL_COUNTER(FEngineLoop::Tick, 2.0);
5579
5580#if !UE_BUILD_SHIPPING && !UE_BUILD_TEST && MALLOC_GT_HOOKS
5581 FScopedSampleMallocChurn ChurnTracker;
5582#endif
5583 // let the low level mem tracker pump once a frame to update states
5584 LLM(FLowLevelMemTracker::Get().UpdateStatsPerFrame());
5585
5586 LLM_SCOPE(ELLMTag::EngineMisc);
5587
5588 BeginExitIfRequested();
5589#if !UE_BUILD_SHIPPING
5590 if (GScopedTestExit.IsValid() && GScopedTestExit->RequestExit())
5591 {
5592 UE_LOGF(LogExit, Display, "**** TestExit: %ls ****", *GScopedTestExit->RequestExitPhrase());
5593 FPlatformMisc::RequestExit(true, TEXT("FEngineLoop::Tick.GScopedTestExit"));
5594 }
5595#endif
5596
5597 {
5598 SCOPED_NAMED_EVENT(FEngineLoop_HeartBeat, SystemColor);
5599 // Send a heartbeat for the diagnostics thread
5600 FThreadHeartBeat::Get().HeartBeat();
5601
5602 FGameThreadHitchHeartBeat::Get().FrameStart();
5603 }
5604
5605 // Must be called on the game thread outside of any frame breadcrumbs.
5606 LatchRenderThreadConfiguration();
5607
5608 // Make sure something is ticking the rendering tickables in -onethread mode to avoid leaks/bugs.
5609 if (!GUseThreadedRendering)
5610 {
5611 SCOPED_NAMED_EVENT(Tick_RenderingTickables, SystemColor);
5612 TickRenderingTickables(FRHICommandListImmediate::Get());
5613 }
5614
5615 // Ensure we aren't starting a frame while loading or playing a loading movie
5616 FMoviePlayerProxy::BlockingForceFinished();
5617 ensure(!IsMoviePlayerEnabled() || (GetMoviePlayer()->IsLoadingFinished() && !GetMoviePlayer()->IsMovieCurrentlyPlaying()));
5618
5619 // Frame profiling kickoff
5620#if UE_EXTERNAL_PROFILING_ENABLED
5621 FExternalProfiler* ActiveProfiler = FActiveExternalProfilerBase::GetActiveProfiler();
5622 if (ActiveProfiler)
5623 {
5624 ActiveProfiler->FrameSync();
5625 }
5626#endif // UE_EXTERNAL_PROFILING_ENABLED
5627
5628 FPlatformMisc::BeginNamedEventFrame();
5629
5630 uint64 CurrentFrameCounter = GFrameCounter;
5631
5632#if ENABLE_NAMED_EVENTS
5633 bool bTraceCpuChannelEnabled = false;
5634#if CPUPROFILERTRACE_ENABLED
5635 bTraceCpuChannelEnabled = UE_TRACE_CHANNELEXPR_IS_ENABLED(CpuChannel);
5636 static FAutoNamedEventsToggler TraceNamedEventsToggler;
5637 TraceNamedEventsToggler.Update(bTraceCpuChannelEnabled && UE::Trace::IsTracing());
5638#endif // CPUPROFILERTRACE_ENABLED
5639
5640 // Generate the Frame event string
5641 TCHAR IndexedFrameString[32] = { 0 };
5642 const TCHAR* FrameStringPrefix = bTraceCpuChannelEnabled ? TEXT(" ") : TEXT("Frame ");
5643#if CSV_PROFILER
5644 if (FCsvProfiler::Get()->IsCapturing())
5645 {
5646 FCString::Snprintf(IndexedFrameString, 32, TEXT("Csv%s%d"), FrameStringPrefix, FCsvProfiler::Get()->GetCaptureFrameNumber());
5647 }
5648 else
5649#endif // CSV_PROFILER
5650 {
5651 FCString::Snprintf(IndexedFrameString, 32, TEXT("%s%d"), FrameStringPrefix, CurrentFrameCounter);
5652 }
5653 const TCHAR* FrameString = IndexedFrameString;
5654#if CPUPROFILERTRACE_ENABLED
5655 UE_TRACE_LOG_SCOPED_T(Cpu, Frame, CpuChannel)
5656 << Frame.Name(FrameString);
5657#endif // CPUPROFILERTRACE_ENABLED
5658
5659#if PLATFORM_LIMIT_PROFILER_UNIQUE_NAMED_EVENTS
5660 FrameString = TEXT("FEngineLoop");
5661#endif
5662 SCOPED_NAMED_EVENT_TCHAR_CONDITIONAL(FrameString, FrameColor, !bTraceCpuChannelEnabled);
5663#endif // ENABLE_NAMED_EVENTS
5664
5665 // execute callbacks for cvar changes
5666 {
5667 SCOPED_NAMED_EVENT(FEngineLoop_CallAllConsoleVariableSinks, SystemColor);
5668 IConsoleManager::Get().CallAllConsoleVariableSinks();
5669 }
5670
5671 TRACE_BEGIN_FRAME(TraceFrameType_Game);
5672
5673 {
5674 SCOPE_CYCLE_COUNTER(STAT_FrameTime);
5675
5676#if WITH_ENGINE && CSV_PROFILER
5677 UpdateCoreCsvStats_BeginFrame();
5678#endif
5679
5680 {
5681 SCOPED_NAMED_EVENT_TEXT("FCoreDelegates::OnBeginFrame", CoreDelegatesColor);
5682 FCoreDelegates::OnBeginFrame.Broadcast();
5683 }
5684
5685 // flush debug output which has been buffered by other threads
5686 {
5687 SCOPED_NAMED_EVENT(FEngineLoop_FlushThreadedLogs, SystemColor);
5688 GLog->FlushThreadedLogs(EOutputDeviceRedirectorFlushOptions::Async);
5689 }
5690
5691 // exit if frame limit is reached in benchmark mode, or if time limit is reached
5692 if ((FApp::IsBenchmarking() && MaxFrameCounter && (GFrameCounter > MaxFrameCounter)) ||
5693 (MaxTickTime && (TotalTickTime > MaxTickTime)))
5694 {
5695 FPlatformMisc::RequestExit(false, TEXT("FEngineLoop::Tick.Benchmarking"));
5696 }
5697
5698 // set FApp::CurrentTime, FApp::DeltaTime and potentially wait to enforce max tick rate
5699 {
5700 SCOPED_NAMED_EVENT(FEngineLoop_UpdateTimeAndHandleMaxTickRate, SystemColor);
5701 GEngine->UpdateTimeAndHandleMaxTickRate();
5702 GEngine->SetSimulationLatencyMarkerStart(CurrentFrameCounter);
5703#if WITH_ENGINE && CSV_PROFILER
5704 FCsvProfiler::Get()->UpdateFrameTime();
5705#endif
5706 }
5707
5708 // beginning of RHI frame
5709 {
5710 SCOPED_NAMED_EVENT(Render_BeginFrame, SystemColor);
5711
5712#if WITH_RHI_BREADCRUMBS
5713 // Uses _NOMARKER to avoid intersecting "BeginFrame" scope with the "Frame" breadcrumb from BeginFrameRenderThread().
5714 ENQUEUE_RENDER_COMMAND_NOMARKER(BeginFrame)([CurrentFrameCounter](FRHICommandListImmediate& RHICmdList)
5715 {
5716 BeginFrameRenderThread(RHICmdList, CurrentFrameCounter);
5717 });
5718#else // WITH_RHI_BREADCRUMBS
5719 ENQUEUE_RENDER_COMMAND(BeginFrame)([CurrentFrameCounter](FRHICommandListImmediate& RHICmdList)
5720 {
5721 BeginFrameRenderThread(RHICmdList, CurrentFrameCounter);
5722 });
5723#endif // WITH_RHI_BREADCRUMBS
5724
5725 for (FSceneInterface* Scene : GetRendererModule().GetAllocatedScenes())
5726 {
5727 ENQUEUE_RENDER_COMMAND(FScene_StartFrame)([Scene](FRHICommandListImmediate& RHICmdList)
5728 {
5729 Scene->StartFrame();
5730 });
5731 }
5732
5733 UE::RenderCommandPipe::StartRecording();
5734
5735#if !UE_SERVER && WITH_ENGINE
5736 if (!GIsEditor && GEngine->GameViewport && GEngine->GameViewport->GetWorld() && GEngine->GameViewport->GetWorld()->IsCameraMoveable())
5737 {
5738 // When not in editor, we emit dynamic resolution's begin frame right after RHI's.
5739 GEngine->EmitDynamicResolutionEvent(EDynamicResolutionStateEvent::BeginFrame);
5740 }
5741#endif
5742 }
5743
5744 // tick performance monitoring
5745 {
5746 SCOPED_NAMED_EVENT(Tick_PerformanceMonitoring, SystemColor);
5747 GEngine->TickPerformanceMonitoring( FApp::GetDeltaTime() );
5748
5749 extern COREUOBJECT_API void ResetAsyncLoadingStats();
5750 ResetAsyncLoadingStats();
5751 }
5752
5753#if UPDATE_MALLOC_STATS
5754 // update memory allocator stats
5755 {
5756 SCOPED_NAMED_EVENT(Malloc_UpdateStats, SystemColor);
5757 UE::Private::GMalloc->UpdateStats();
5758 }
5759#endif
5760 }
5761
5762 UE::Stats::FStats::AdvanceFrame( false, UE::Stats::FStats::FOnAdvanceRenderingThreadStats::CreateStatic( &AdvanceRenderingThreadStatsGT ) );
5763
5764 {
5765 SCOPE_CYCLE_COUNTER( STAT_FrameTime );
5766
5767 // Calculates average FPS/MS (outside STATS on purpose)
5768 CalculateFPSTimings();
5769
5770 // handle some per-frame tasks on the rendering thread
5771 ENQUEUE_RENDER_COMMAND(ResetDeferredUpdates)(
5772 [](FRHICommandListImmediate& RHICmdList)
5773 {
5774 FDeferredUpdateResource::ResetNeedsUpdate();
5775 });
5776
5777 // Don't pump messages if we're running embedded as the outer application
5778 // will pass us messages instead.
5779 if (!GUELibraryOverrideSettings.bIsEmbedded)
5780 {
5781 GEngine->SetInputSampleLatencyMarker(CurrentFrameCounter);
5782
5783 SCOPED_NAMED_EVENT(FEngineLoop_PumpMessages, SystemColor);
5784 FPlatformApplicationMisc::PumpMessages(true);
5785 }
5786
5787 bool bIdleMode;
5788 {
5789 SCOPED_NAMED_EVENT(FEngineLoop_Idle, SystemColor);
5790
5791 // Idle mode prevents ticking and rendering completely
5792 bIdleMode = ShouldUseIdleMode();
5793 if (bIdleMode)
5794 {
5795 // Yield CPU time
5796 FPlatformProcess::Sleep(.1f);
5797 }
5798 }
5799
5800 // @todo vreditor urgent: Temporary hack to allow world-to-meters to be set before
5801 // input is polled for motion controller devices each frame.
5802 extern ENGINE_API float GNewWorldToMetersScale;
5803 if( GNewWorldToMetersScale != 0.0f )
5804 {
5805#if WITH_ENGINE
5806 UWorld* WorldToScale = GWorld;
5807
5808#if WITH_EDITOR
5809 if( GIsEditor && GEditor->PlayWorld != nullptr && GEditor->bIsSimulatingInEditor )
5810 {
5811 WorldToScale = GEditor->PlayWorld;
5812 }
5813#endif //WITH_EDITOR
5814
5815 if( WorldToScale != nullptr )
5816 {
5817 if( GNewWorldToMetersScale != WorldToScale->GetWorldSettings()->WorldToMeters )
5818 {
5819 WorldToScale->GetWorldSettings()->WorldToMeters = GNewWorldToMetersScale;
5820 }
5821 }
5822
5823 GNewWorldToMetersScale = 0.0f;
5824 }
5825#endif //WITH_ENGINE
5826
5827 // tick active platform files
5828 FPlatformFileManager::Get().TickActivePlatformFile();
5829
5830 // Roughly track the time when the input was sampled
5831 {
5832 SCOPED_NAMED_EVENT_TEXT("FCoreDelegates::OnSamplingInput", CoreDelegatesColor);
5833 FCoreDelegates::OnSamplingInput.Broadcast();
5834 }
5835
5836 // process accumulated Slate input
5837 if (FSlateApplication::IsInitialized() && !bIdleMode)
5838 {
5839 CSV_SCOPED_TIMING_STAT_EXCLUSIVE(Input);
5840 SCOPE_TIME_GUARD(TEXT("SlateInput"));
5841 SCOPED_NAMED_EVENT(Tick_SlateInput, SystemColor);
5842 LLM_SCOPE(ELLMTag::UI);
5843
5844 FSlateApplication& SlateApp = FSlateApplication::Get();
5845 {
5846 TRACE_CPUPROFILER_EVENT_SCOPE(PollGameDeviceState);
5847 SlateApp.PollGameDeviceState();
5848 }
5849 // Gives widgets a chance to process any accumulated input
5850 {
5851 TRACE_CPUPROFILER_EVENT_SCOPE(FinishedInputThisFrame);
5852 SlateApp.FinishedInputThisFrame();
5853 }
5854 }
5855
5856 {
5857 SCOPED_NAMED_EVENT(Tick_Engine, SystemColor);
5858 // main game engine tick (world, game objects, etc.)
5859 GEngine->Tick(FApp::GetDeltaTime(), bIdleMode);
5860 }
5861
5862 // If a movie that is blocking the game thread has been playing,
5863 // wait for it to finish before we continue to tick or tick again
5864 // We do this right after GEngine->Tick() because that is where user code would initiate a load / movie.
5865 {
5866 if (FPreLoadScreenManager::Get())
5867 {
5868 if (FPreLoadScreenManager::Get()->HasRegisteredPreLoadScreenType(EPreLoadScreenTypes::EngineLoadingScreen))
5869 {
5870 //Wait for any Engine Loading Screen to stop
5871 if (FPreLoadScreenManager::Get()->HasActivePreLoadScreenType(EPreLoadScreenTypes::EngineLoadingScreen))
5872 {
5873 FPreLoadScreenManager::Get()->WaitForEngineLoadingScreenToFinish();
5874 }
5875
5876 //Switch Game Window Back
5877 UGameEngine* GameEngine = Cast<UGameEngine>(GEngine);
5878 if (GameEngine)
5879 {
5880 GameEngine->SwitchGameWindowToUseGameViewport();
5881 }
5882 }
5883
5884#if !UE_SERVER
5885 // Is it ok to start up the movie player?
5886 if (IsMoviePlayerEnabled() && !GetMoviePlayer()->IsMovieCurrentlyPlaying())
5887 {
5888 // Enable the MoviePlayer now that the preload screen manager is done.
5889 if (FSlateRenderer* Renderer = FSlateApplication::Get().GetRenderer())
5890 {
5891 GetMoviePlayer()->Initialize(*Renderer, FPreLoadScreenManager::Get()->GetRenderWindow());
5892 }
5893 }
5894#endif // !UE_SERVER
5895
5896 //Destroy / Clean Up PreLoadScreenManager as we are now done
5897 FPreLoadScreenManager::Destroy();
5898 }
5899 else if (IsMoviePlayerEnabled())
5900 {
5901 TRACE_CPUPROFILER_EVENT_SCOPE(WaitForMovieToFinish);
5902 GetMoviePlayer()->WaitForMovieToFinish(true);
5903 }
5904 }
5905
5906 FAssetCompilingManager::Get().ProcessAsyncTasks(true);
5907
5908 FMoviePlayerProxy::BlockingForceFinished();
5909 // Tick the platform and input portion of Slate application, we need to do this before we run things
5910 // concurrent with networking.
5911 if (FSlateApplication::IsInitialized() && !bIdleMode)
5912 {
5913 {
5914 SCOPED_NAMED_EVENT(ProcessLocalPlayerSlateOperations, SystemColor);
5915 check(!IsRunningDedicatedServer());
5916
5917 // Process slate operations accumulated in the world ticks.
5918 ProcessLocalPlayerSlateOperations();
5919 }
5920
5921 FSlateApplication::Get().Tick(ESlateTickType::PlatformAndInput);
5922 }
5923
5924#if WITH_ENGINE
5925 // process concurrent Slate tasks
5926 FGraphEventRef ConcurrentTask;
5927 FEvent* ConcurrentTaskCompleteEvent = nullptr;
5928 const bool bDoConcurrentSlateTick = GEngine->ShouldDoAsyncEndOfFrameTasks();
5929
5930 const UGameViewportClient* const GameViewport = GEngine->GameViewport;
5931 const UWorld* const GameViewportWorld = GameViewport ? GameViewport->GetWorld() : nullptr;
5932 UDemoNetDriver* const CurrentDemoNetDriver = GameViewportWorld ? GameViewportWorld->GetDemoNetDriver() : nullptr;
5933
5934 const bool bValidateReplicatedProperties = CurrentDemoNetDriver && CVarDoAsyncEndOfFrameTasksValidateReplicatedProperties.GetValueOnGameThread() != 0;
5935
5936 if (bDoConcurrentSlateTick)
5937 {
5938 const float DeltaSeconds = FApp::GetDeltaTime();
5939
5940 if (CurrentDemoNetDriver && CurrentDemoNetDriver->ShouldTickFlushAsyncEndOfFrame())
5941 {
5942 ConcurrentTaskCompleteEvent = FPlatformProcess::GetSynchEventFromPool();
5943 check(ConcurrentTaskCompleteEvent);
5944
5945 ConcurrentTask = TGraphTask<FExecuteConcurrentWithSlateTickTask>::CreateTask(nullptr, ENamedThreads::GameThread).ConstructAndDispatchWhenReady(
5946 [CurrentDemoNetDriver, DeltaSeconds]()
5947 {
5948 if (CVarDoAsyncEndOfFrameTasksRandomize.GetValueOnAnyThread(true) > 0)
5949 {
5950 FPlatformProcess::Sleep(FMath::RandRange(0.0f, .003f)); // this shakes up the threading to find race conditions
5951 }
5952
5953 if (CurrentDemoNetDriver != nullptr)
5954 {
5955 CurrentDemoNetDriver->TickFlushAsyncEndOfFrame(DeltaSeconds);
5956 }
5957 },
5958 ConcurrentTaskCompleteEvent);
5959 check(ConcurrentTask.IsValid());
5960
5961 // If we're validating, we want to only test the slate tick so wait for the task
5962 if (bValidateReplicatedProperties)
5963 {
5964 CSV_SCOPED_SET_WAIT_STAT(ConcurrentWithSlate);
5965
5966 TRACE_CPUPROFILER_EVENT_SCOPE(ConcurrentWithSlateTickTasks_Wait);
5967 check(ConcurrentTaskCompleteEvent);
5968 ConcurrentTaskCompleteEvent->Wait();
5969 FPlatformProcess::ReturnSynchEventToPool(ConcurrentTaskCompleteEvent);
5970 ConcurrentTaskCompleteEvent = nullptr;
5971 ConcurrentTask = nullptr;
5972 }
5973 }
5974 }
5975
5976 // Optionally validate that Slate has not modified any replicated properties for client replay recording.
5977 FDemoSavedPropertyState PreSlateObjectStates;
5978 if (bValidateReplicatedProperties)
5979 {
5980 PreSlateObjectStates = CurrentDemoNetDriver->SavePropertyState();
5981 }
5982#endif
5983
5984 // Tick(Advance) Time for the application and then tick and paint slate application widgets.
5985 // We split separate this action from the one above to permit running network replication concurrent with slate widget ticking and painting.
5986 if (FSlateApplication::IsInitialized() && !bIdleMode)
5987 {
5988 const bool bRenderingSuspended = GEngine->IsRenderingSuspended();
5989
5990 FMoviePlayerProxy::SetIsSlateThreadAllowed(false);
5991 FSlateApplication::Get().Tick(bRenderingSuspended ? ESlateTickType::Time : ESlateTickType::TimeAndWidgets);
5992 FMoviePlayerProxy::SetIsSlateThreadAllowed(true);
5993 }
5994
5995#if WITH_ENGINE
5996 if (bValidateReplicatedProperties)
5997 {
5998 const bool bReplicatedPropertiesDifferent = CurrentDemoNetDriver->ComparePropertyState(PreSlateObjectStates);
5999 if (bReplicatedPropertiesDifferent)
6000 {
6001 UE_LOGF(LogInit, Log, "Replicated properties changed during Slate tick!");
6002 }
6003 }
6004
6005 if (ConcurrentTask.GetReference())
6006 {
6007 CSV_SCOPED_SET_WAIT_STAT(ConcurrentWithSlate);
6008
6009 TRACE_CPUPROFILER_EVENT_SCOPE(ConcurrentWithSlateTickTasks_Wait);
6010 check(ConcurrentTaskCompleteEvent);
6011 ConcurrentTaskCompleteEvent->Wait();
6012 FPlatformProcess::ReturnSynchEventToPool(ConcurrentTaskCompleteEvent);
6013 ConcurrentTaskCompleteEvent = nullptr;
6014 ConcurrentTask = nullptr;
6015 }
6016#endif
6017
6018#if STATS
6019 // Clear any stat group notifications we have pending just in case they weren't claimed during FSlateApplication::Get().Tick
6020 extern CORE_API void ClearPendingStatGroups();
6021 ClearPendingStatGroups();
6022#endif
6023
6024#if WITH_EDITOR && !UE_BUILD_SHIPPING
6025 // tick automation controller (Editor only)
6026 {
6027 SCOPED_NAMED_EVENT(Tick_AutomationController, SystemColor);
6028 static FName AutomationController("AutomationController");
6029 if (FModuleManager::Get().IsModuleLoaded(AutomationController))
6030 {
6031 FModuleManager::GetModuleChecked<IAutomationControllerModule>(AutomationController).Tick();
6032 }
6033 }
6034#endif
6035
6036#if WITH_ENGINE && WITH_AUTOMATION_WORKER
6037 // tick automation worker
6038 {
6039 SCOPED_NAMED_EVENT(Tick_AutomationWorker, SystemColor);
6040 static const FName AutomationWorkerModuleName = "AutomationWorker";
6041 if (FModuleManager::Get().IsModuleLoaded(AutomationWorkerModuleName))
6042 {
6043 FModuleManager::GetModuleChecked<IAutomationWorkerModule>(AutomationWorkerModuleName).Tick();
6044 }
6045 }
6046#endif
6047
6048 {
6049 SCOPED_NAMED_EVENT(Render_UpdateFrame, SystemColor);
6050
6051 UE::RenderCommandPipe::StopRecording();
6052
6053 for (FSceneInterface* Scene : GetRendererModule().GetAllocatedScenes())
6054 {
6055 ENQUEUE_RENDER_COMMAND(FScene_EndFrame)([Scene](FRHICommandListImmediate& RHICmdList)
6056 {
6057 Scene->EndFrame(RHICmdList);
6058 });
6059 }
6060
6061 // tick render hardware interface
6062 {
6063 SCOPE_CYCLE_COUNTER(STAT_RHITickTime);
6064 RHITick( FApp::GetDeltaTime() ); // Update RHI.
6065 }
6066 }
6067
6068 // We need to set this marker before EndFrameRenderThread is enqueued.
6069 // If multithreaded rendering is off, it can cause a bad ordering of game and rendering markers.
6070 GEngine->SetSimulationLatencyMarkerEnd(CurrentFrameCounter);
6071
6072 // Disregard first few ticks for total tick time as it includes loading and such.
6073 if (GFrameCounter > 5)
6074 {
6075 TotalTickTime += FApp::GetDeltaTime();
6076 }
6077
6078 // Find the objects which need to be cleaned up the next frame.
6079 FPendingCleanupObjects* PreviousPendingCleanupObjects = PendingCleanupObjects;
6080 PendingCleanupObjects = GetPendingCleanupObjects();
6081
6082 // This could be perhaps moved down to get greater parallelism
6083 // Sync game and render/RHI threads.
6084 FFrameEndSync::Sync(FFrameEndSync::EFlushMode::EndFrame);
6085
6086 // tick core ticker, threads & deferred commands
6087 {
6088 SCOPE_CYCLE_COUNTER(STAT_DeferredTickTime);
6089 CSV_SCOPED_TIMING_STAT_EXCLUSIVE(DeferredTickTime);
6090 // Delete the objects which were enqueued for deferred cleanup before the previous frame.
6091
6092 {
6093 SCOPED_NAMED_EVENT(DeletePendingCleanupObjects, SystemColor);
6094
6095 delete PreviousPendingCleanupObjects;
6096#if WITH_COREUOBJECT
6097 DeleteLoaders(); // destroy all linkers pending delete
6098#endif
6099 }
6100
6101 {
6102 SCOPED_NAMED_EVENT(Tick_Core, SystemColor);
6103 FTSTicker::GetCoreTicker().Tick(FApp::GetDeltaTime());
6104 FThreadManager::Get().Tick();
6105 }
6106
6107 {
6108 SCOPED_NAMED_EVENT(Tick_DeferredCommands, SystemColor);
6109 GEngine->TickDeferredCommands();
6110 }
6111 }
6112 FMoviePlayerProxy::BlockingForceFinished();
6113
6114#if !UE_SERVER
6115 // tick media framework
6116 static const FName MediaModuleName("Media");
6117 IMediaModule* MediaModule = FModuleManager::LoadModulePtr<IMediaModule>(MediaModuleName);
6118 if (MediaModule != nullptr)
6119 {
6120 SCOPED_NAMED_EVENT(Tick_PostRender, SystemColor);
6121 MediaModule->TickPostRender();
6122 }
6123#endif
6124
6125 {
6126 SCOPED_NAMED_EVENT_TEXT("FCoreDelegates::OnEndFrame", CoreDelegatesColor);
6127 FCoreDelegates::OnEndFrame.Broadcast();
6128 }
6129
6130 // Increment global frame counter. Once for each engine tick.
6131 GFrameCounter++;
6132
6133 ENQUEUE_RENDER_COMMAND(FrameCounter)(
6134 [CurrentFrameCounter = GFrameCounter](FRHICommandListImmediate& RHICmdList)
6135 {
6136 GFrameCounterRenderThread = CurrentFrameCounter;
6137 });
6138
6139#if WITH_ENGINE && CSV_PROFILER
6140 // By design, update this after incrementing GFrameCounter. Calls PlatformMemoryHelpers::GetFrameMemoryStats, which caches
6141 // memory stats based on the value of GFrameCounter. Placing this after the increment guarantees that cached memory stats are
6142 // canonically updated at this same point each frame, as opposed to arbitrarily in various other code paths (at least when the
6143 // CSV profiler is compiled in, which is true in all builds except shipping).
6144 UpdateCoreCsvStats_EndFrame();
6145#endif
6146
6147 {
6148 SCOPED_NAMED_EVENT(Render_EndFrame, SystemColor);
6149
6150 // Tick DumpGPU to start/stop frame dumps
6151#if WITH_ENGINE && WITH_DUMPGPU
6152 UE::RenderCore::DumpGPU::TickEndFrame();
6153#endif
6154
6155#if !UE_SERVER && WITH_ENGINE
6156 {
6157 // We emit dynamic resolution's end frame right before RHI's. GEngine is going to ignore it if no BeginFrame was done.
6158 GEngine->EmitDynamicResolutionEvent(EDynamicResolutionStateEvent::EndFrame);
6159 }
6160#endif
6161
6162 // end of RHI frame
6163 ENQUEUE_RENDER_COMMAND(EndFrame)(
6164 [CurrentFrameCounter](FRHICommandListImmediate& RHICmdList)
6165 {
6166 EndFrameRenderThread(RHICmdList, CurrentFrameCounter);
6167 });
6168 }
6169
6170 // Set CPU utilization stats.
6171 const FCPUTime CPUTime = FPlatformTime::GetCPUTime();
6172 SET_FLOAT_STAT( STAT_CPUTimePct, CPUTime.CPUTimePct );
6173 SET_FLOAT_STAT( STAT_CPUTimePctRelative, CPUTime.CPUTimePctRelative );
6174
6175 // Set the UObject count stat
6176#if !UE_BUILD_TEST && !UE_BUILD_SHIPPING
6177 SET_DWORD_STAT(STAT_Hash_NumObjects, GUObjectArray.GetObjectArrayNumMinusAvailable());
6178#endif // !UE_BUILD_TEST && !UE_BUILD_SHIPPING
6179 }
6180
6181 TRACE_END_FRAME(TraceFrameType_Game);
6182
6183#if BUILD_EMBEDDED_APP
6184 static double LastSleepTime = FPlatformTime::Seconds();
6185 double TimeNow = FPlatformTime::Seconds();
6186 if (LastSleepTime > 0 && TimeNow - LastSleepTime >= CVarSecondsBeforeEmbeddedAppSleeps.GetValueOnAnyThread())
6187 {
6188 LastSleepTime = 0;
6189 FEmbeddedCommunication::AllowSleep(TEXT("FirstTicks"));
6190 }
6191#endif
6192
6193#if PLATFORM_MAC
6194 // drain the apple async task queue from the game thread
6195 FMacPlatformApplicationMisc::ProcessAsyncTasks();
6196#endif
6197}

6211 TEXT("log.Timestamp"),
6212 1,
6213 TEXT("Defines if time is included in each line in the log file and in what form. Layout: [time][frame mod 1000]\n"
6214 " 0 = Do not display log timestamps\n"
6215 " 1 = Log time stamps in UTC and frame time (default) e.g. [2015.11.25-21.28.50:803][376]\n"
6216 " 2 = Log timestamps in seconds elapsed since GStartTime e.g. [0130.29][420]"
6217 " 3 = Log timestamps in local time and frame time e.g. [2017.08.04-17.59.50:803][420]"
6218 " 4 = Log timestamps with the engine's timecode and frame time e.g. [17:59:50:18][420]"),

6230
6231// Gets called any time cvars change (on the main thread)
6232static void CVarLogSinkFunction()
6233{
6234 {
6235 // for debugging
6236 ELogTimes::Type OldGPrintLogTimes = GPrintLogTimes;
6237
6238 int32 LogTimestampValue = CVarLogTimestamp.GetValueOnGameThread();
6239
6240 // Note GPrintLogTimes can be used on multiple threads but it should be no issue to change it on the fly
6241 switch(LogTimestampValue)
6242 {
6243 default:
6244 case 0: GPrintLogTimes = ELogTimes::None; break;
6245 case 1: GPrintLogTimes = ELogTimes::UTC; break;
6246 case 2: GPrintLogTimes = ELogTimes::SinceGStartTime; break;
6247 case 3: GPrintLogTimes = ELogTimes::Local; break;
6248 case 4: GPrintLogTimes = ELogTimes::Timecode; break;
6249 }
6250 }
6251
6252 {
6253 int32 LogCategoryValue = CVarLogCategory.GetValueOnGameThread();
6254
6255 // Note GPrintLogCategory can be used on multiple threads but it should be no issue to change it on the fly
6256 GPrintLogCategory = LogCategoryValue != 0;
6257 }
6258}
6259
6260
6261FAutoConsoleVariableSink CVarLogSink(FConsoleCommandDelegate::CreateStatic(&CVarLogSinkFunction));
6262
6263static void CheckForPrintTimesOverride()
6264{
6265 // Determine whether to override the default setting for including timestamps in the log.
6266 FString LogTimes;
6267 if (GConfig->GetString( TEXT( "LogFiles" ), TEXT( "LogTimes" ), LogTimes, GEngineIni ))
6268 {
6269 if (LogTimes == TEXT( "None" ))
6270 {
6271 CVarLogTimestamp->Set((int)ELogTimes::None, ECVF_SetBySystemSettingsIni);
6272 }
6273 else if (LogTimes == TEXT( "UTC" ))
6274 {
6275 CVarLogTimestamp->Set((int)ELogTimes::UTC, ECVF_SetBySystemSettingsIni);
6276 }
6277 else if (LogTimes == TEXT( "SinceStart" ))
6278 {
6279 CVarLogTimestamp->Set((int)ELogTimes::SinceGStartTime, ECVF_SetBySystemSettingsIni);
6280 }
6281 else if (LogTimes == TEXT( "Local" ))
6282 {
6283 CVarLogTimestamp->Set((int)ELogTimes::Local, ECVF_SetBySystemSettingsIni);
6284 }
6285 else if (LogTimes == TEXT( "Timecode" ))
6286 {
6287 CVarLogTimestamp->Set((int)ELogTimes::Timecode, ECVF_SetBySystemSettingsIni);
6288 }
6289 // Assume this is a bool for backward compatibility
6290 else if (FCString::ToBool( *LogTimes ))
6291 {
6292 CVarLogTimestamp->Set((int)ELogTimes::UTC, ECVF_SetBySystemSettingsIni);
6293 }
6294 }
6295
6296 if (FParse::Param( FCommandLine::Get(), TEXT( "LOGTIMES" ) ))
6297 {
6298 CVarLogTimestamp->Set((int)ELogTimes::UTC, ECVF_SetByCommandline);
6299 }
6300 else if (FParse::Param( FCommandLine::Get(), TEXT( "UTCLOGTIMES" ) ))
6301 {
6302 CVarLogTimestamp->Set((int)ELogTimes::UTC, ECVF_SetByCommandline);
6303 }
6304 else if (FParse::Param( FCommandLine::Get(), TEXT( "NOLOGTIMES" ) ))
6305 {
6306 CVarLogTimestamp->Set((int)ELogTimes::None, ECVF_SetByCommandline);
6307 }
6308 else if (FParse::Param( FCommandLine::Get(), TEXT( "LOGTIMESINCESTART" ) ))
6309 {
6310 CVarLogTimestamp->Set((int)ELogTimes::SinceGStartTime, ECVF_SetByCommandline);
6311 }
6312 else if (FParse::Param( FCommandLine::Get(), TEXT( "LOCALLOGTIMES" ) ))
6313 {
6314 CVarLogTimestamp->Set((int)ELogTimes::Local, ECVF_SetByCommandline);
6315 }
6316 else if (FParse::Param(FCommandLine::Get(), TEXT( "LOGTIMECODE" )))
6317 {
6318 CVarLogTimestamp->Set((int)ELogTimes::Timecode, ECVF_SetByCommandline);
6319 }
6320}

6331bool DoesCurrentTargetRequireUpgrade(const FString& EditorTargetFileName, FString& InTargetName)
6332{
6333 FTargetReceipt Receipt;
6334
6335 if (!FPaths::FileExists(EditorTargetFileName))
6336 {
6337 return false;
6338 }
6339
6340 // We do not return on Receipt.Read returning false, as Target upgrade requirements occur before a full target receipt can be emitted.
6341 // Only partial target receipts exist, of which the most important properties are BuildSettingsVersion && TargetBuildEnvironment.
6342 Receipt.Read(EditorTargetFileName);
6343
6344 // Handle backwards compatibility before we added these properties to the receipt at 5.7.
6345 if (Receipt.BuildSettingsVersion.IsEmpty() || Receipt.TargetBuildEnvironment.IsEmpty())
6346 {
6347 UE_LOGF(
6348 LogInit,
6349 Log,
6350 "Unable to discern build settings version & build environment used for target - target may require upgrade. Target file: %ls",
6351 *EditorTargetFileName
6352 );
6353 return false;
6354 }
6355
6356 InTargetName = Receipt.TargetName;
6357 const bool bIsShared = (Receipt.TargetBuildEnvironment == TEXT("Shared"));
6358 const bool bIsUpToDate = (Receipt.BuildSettingsVersion == TEXT("V7"));
6359
6360 if (!bIsUpToDate && bIsShared)
6361 {
6362 UE_LOGF(
6363 LogInit,
6364 Warning,
6365 "Current target requires upgrade to V7, as it is not a unique build environment. File: %ls, BuildSettingsVersion: %ls, TargetBuildEnvironment: %ls",
6366 *EditorTargetFileName,
6367 *Receipt.BuildSettingsVersion,
6368 *Receipt.TargetBuildEnvironment
6369 );
6370
6371 return true;
6372 }
6373
6374 return false;
6375}
6376
6377bool DoesCurrentExecutableMatch(const FString& EditorTargetFileName)
6378{
6379 FTargetReceipt Receipt;
6380 if (!FPaths::FileExists(EditorTargetFileName) || !Receipt.Read(EditorTargetFileName))
6381 {
6382 return false;
6383 }
6384
6385 // Returning false for -Cmd matches legacy behavior; do we want to change this?
6386 const bool bCheckLaunch_true = true, bCheckCmd_false = false;
6387 return Receipt.LaunchesCurrentExecutable(bCheckLaunch_true, bCheckCmd_false);
6388}
6389
6390bool LaunchCorrectEditorExecutable(const FString& EditorTargetFileName)
6391{
6392 // Don't allow relaunching the executable if we're running some unattended scripted process.
6393 if(FApp::IsUnattended())
6394 {
6395 return false;
6396 }
6397
6398 // Figure out the executable that we should be running
6399 FString LaunchExecutableName;
6400 if(EditorTargetFileName.Len() == 0)
6401 {
6402 LaunchExecutableName = FPlatformProcess::GenerateApplicationPath(TEXT("UnrealEditor"), FApp::GetBuildConfiguration());
6403 if(const TCHAR* ArchitectureSuffix = FPlatformProcess::GetArchitectureSuffix())
6404 {
6405 // GenerateApplicationPath does not add the architecture suffix; insert it where UBT places it, immediately before the extension.
6406 const FString Extension = FPaths::GetExtension(LaunchExecutableName, /*bIncludeDot*/ true);
6407 LaunchExecutableName.InsertAt(LaunchExecutableName.Len() - Extension.Len(), ArchitectureSuffix);
6408 }
6409 }
6410 else
6411 {
6412 FTargetReceipt Receipt;
6413 if(!FPaths::FileExists(EditorTargetFileName) || !Receipt.Read(EditorTargetFileName))
6414 {
6415 return false;
6416 }
6417 LaunchExecutableName = Receipt.Launch;
6418 }
6419 CleanUpPath(LaunchExecutableName);
6420
6421 // Get the current executable name. Don't allow relaunching if we're running the console app.
6422 FString CurrentExecutableName = FPlatformProcess::ExecutablePath();
6423 if(FPaths::GetBaseFilename(CurrentExecutableName).EndsWith(TEXT("-Cmd")))
6424 {
6425 return false;
6426 }
6427 CleanUpPath(CurrentExecutableName);
6428
6429 // Nothing to do if they're the same
6430 if(FPaths::IsSamePath(LaunchExecutableName, CurrentExecutableName))
6431 {
6432 return false;
6433 }
6434
6435 // Relaunch the correct executable
6436 UE_LOGF(LogInit, Display, "Running incorrect executable for target (%ls). Launching %ls instead...", *CurrentExecutableName, *LaunchExecutableName);
6437 FPlatformProcess::CreateProc(*IFileManager::Get().ConvertToAbsolutePathForExternalAppForRead(*LaunchExecutableName), FCommandLine::GetOriginal(), true, false, false, nullptr, 0, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr);
6438 return true;
6439}
6440#endif

6444
6445void FEngineLoop::AppInitUpToSetupOutputDevices()
6446{
6447 {
6448 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("BeginInitTextLocalization");
6449 BeginInitTextLocalization();
6450 }
6451
6452
6453
6454 // Error history.
6455 FCString::Strcpy(GErrorHist, TEXT("Fatal error!" LINE_TERMINATOR_ANSI LINE_TERMINATOR_ANSI));
6456
6457 // Platform specific pre-init.
6458 {
6459 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("FPlatformMisc::PlatformPreInit");
6460 FPlatformMisc::PlatformPreInit();
6461 }
6462#if WITH_APPLICATION_CORE
6463 {
6464 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("FPlatformApplicationMisc::PreInit");
6465 FPlatformApplicationMisc::PreInit();
6466 }
6467#endif
6468
6469 // Keep track of start time.
6470 GSystemStartTime = FDateTime::Now().ToString();
6471
6472 // Switch into executable's directory.
6473#if !defined(DISABLE_CWD_CHANGES) || DISABLE_CWD_CHANGES==0
6474 FPlatformProcess::SetCurrentWorkingDirectoryToBaseDir();
6475#endif
6476
6477 {
6478 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("IFileManager::Get().ProcessCommandLineOptions()");
6479 // Now finish initializing the file manager after the command line is set up
6480 IFileManager::Get().ProcessCommandLineOptions();
6481 }
6482
6483 FPageAllocator::Get().LatchProtectedMode();
6484
6485 if (FParse::Param(FCommandLine::Get(), TEXT("purgatorymallocproxy")))
6486 {
6487 FMemory::EnablePurgatoryTests();
6488 }
6489
6490 if (FParse::Param(FCommandLine::Get(), TEXT("poisonmallocproxy")))
6491 {
6492 FMemory::EnablePoisonTests();
6493 }
6494
6495#if !UE_BUILD_SHIPPING
6496 if (FParse::Param(FCommandLine::Get(), TEXT("BUILDMACHINE")))
6497 {
6498 GIsBuildMachine = true;
6499 // propagate to subprocesses, especially because some - like ShaderCompileWorker - use DDC, for which this switch matters
6500 FCommandLine::AddToSubprocessCommandLine(TEXT(" -buildmachine"), ECommandLineArgumentFlags::AllContexts);
6501 }
6502#endif // !UE_BUILD_SHIPPING
6503
6504#if PLATFORM_WINDOWS
6505
6506 // make sure that the log directory tree exists

6561

6566
6567 // Load "asap" plugin modules
6568 IPluginManager& PluginManager = IPluginManager::Get();
6569 IProjectManager& ProjectManager = IProjectManager::Get();
6570 if (!ProjectManager.LoadModulesForProject(ELoadingPhase::EarliestPossible) || !PluginManager.LoadModulesForEnabledPlugins(ELoadingPhase::EarliestPossible))
6571 {
6572 return false;
6573 }

6576
6577 {
6578 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("FPlatformStackWalk::Init");

6580 FPlatformStackWalk::Init();

6582
6583 CheckForPrintTimesOverride();
6584
6585 // Check whether the project or any of its plugins are missing or are out of date
6586#if UE_EDITOR && !IS_MONOLITHIC
6587 if(!GIsBuildMachine && !FApp::IsUnattended() && FPaths::IsProjectFilePathSet() && !PluginManager.GetPreloadBinaries())
6588 {
6589 // Check all the plugins are present
6590 if(!PluginManager.AreRequiredPluginsAvailable())
6591 {
6592 return false;
6593 }
6594
6595 // Find the editor target
6596 FString EditorTargetFileName;
6597 FString DefaultEditorTarget;
6598 bool bIsRunningExe = false;
6599 GConfig->GetString(TEXT("/Script/BuildSettings.BuildSettings"), TEXT("DefaultEditorTarget"), DefaultEditorTarget, GEngineIni);
6600
6601 // If we have multiple targets for the same code, then try to find a target that matches the running executable. Otherwise
6602 // we use the first matching target.
6603 for (const FTargetInfo& Target : FDesktopPlatformModule::Get()->GetTargetsForProject(FPaths::GetProjectFilePath()))
6604 {
6605 if (Target.Type == EBuildTargetType::Editor)
6606 {
6607 const TCHAR* ArchitectureSuffix = FPlatformProcess::GetArchitectureSuffix();
6608
6609 FString ScratchEditorTargetFileName;
6610 if (FPaths::IsUnderDirectory(Target.Path, FPlatformMisc::ProjectDir()))
6611 {
6612 ScratchEditorTargetFileName = FTargetReceipt::GetDefaultPath(FPlatformMisc::ProjectDir(), *Target.Name, FPlatformProcess::GetBinariesSubdirectory(), FApp::GetBuildConfiguration(), ArchitectureSuffix);
6613 }
6614 else if (FPaths::IsUnderDirectory(Target.Path, FPaths::EngineDir()))
6615 {
6616 ScratchEditorTargetFileName = FTargetReceipt::GetDefaultPath(*FPaths::EngineDir(), *Target.Name, FPlatformProcess::GetBinariesSubdirectory(), FApp::GetBuildConfiguration(), ArchitectureSuffix);
6617 }
6618
6619 if (DoesCurrentExecutableMatch(ScratchEditorTargetFileName))
6620 {
6621 EditorTargetFileName = MoveTemp(ScratchEditorTargetFileName);
6622 bIsRunningExe = true;
6623 break;
6624 }
6625 else if (DefaultEditorTarget.Len() == 0 || Target.Name == DefaultEditorTarget)
6626 {
6627 if (EditorTargetFileName.Len() == 0)
6628 {
6629 EditorTargetFileName = MoveTemp(ScratchEditorTargetFileName);
6630 }
6631 }
6632 }
6633 }
6634
6635 // If we're not running the correct executable for the current target, and the listed executable exists, run that instead
6636 if (!bIsRunningExe && LaunchCorrectEditorExecutable(EditorTargetFileName))
6637 {
6638 return false;
6639 }
6640
6641 // Check if we need to compile
6642 bool bNeedCompile = false;
6643 GConfig->GetBool(TEXT("/Script/UnrealEd.EditorLoadingSavingSettings"), TEXT("bForceCompilationAtStartup"), bNeedCompile, GEditorPerProjectIni);
6644 if(FParse::Param(FCommandLine::Get(), TEXT("SKIPCOMPILE")) || FParse::Param(FCommandLine::Get(), TEXT("MULTIPROCESS")))
6645 {
6646 bNeedCompile = false;
6647 }
6648 if(!bNeedCompile)
6649 {
6650 // Check if any of the target, project or plugin modules are out of date, and the user wants to compile them.
6651 FString targetName;
6652 bool TargetRequiresUpgrade = DoesCurrentTargetRequireUpgrade(EditorTargetFileName, targetName);
6653
6654 if (TargetRequiresUpgrade)
6655 {
6656 FString TargetRequiresUpgradeMessage = FString::Printf(
6657 TEXT("The last build used an outdated BuildSettingsVersion, or the target still requires upgrading."
6658 "\n\nPlease upgrade %s.Target.cs:"
6659 "\n\n Update the build settings version (Installed Engine Build & Source Build):"
6660 "\n DefaultBuildSettings = BuildSettingsVersion.V7;"
6661 "\n\n OR"
6662 "\n\n Declare a unique build environment (Source Build only):"
6663 "\n BuildEnvironment = TargetBuildEnvironment.Unique;"
6664 "\n\nIf you have already updated the target, would you like to rebuild & open the project?"),
6665 *targetName
6666 );
6667
6668 if (FPlatformMisc::MessageBoxExt(EAppMsgType::YesNo, *TargetRequiresUpgradeMessage, TEXT("Target Upgrade Required")) == EAppReturnType::No)
6669 {
6670 return false;
6671 }
6672
6673 // Rebuilding should update the target receipt file, and prevent subsequent checks.
6674 bNeedCompile = true;
6675 }
6676
6677 TArray<FString> IncompatibleFiles;
6678 ProjectManager.CheckModuleCompatibility(IncompatibleFiles);
6679
6680 TArray<FString> IncompatibleEngineFiles;
6681 PluginManager.CheckModuleCompatibility(IncompatibleFiles, IncompatibleEngineFiles);
6682
6683 if (IncompatibleFiles.Num() > 0)
6684 {
6685 // Log the modules which need to be rebuilt
6686 for (int Idx = 0; Idx < IncompatibleFiles.Num(); Idx++)
6687 {
6688 UE_LOGF(LogInit, Warning, "Incompatible or missing module: %ls", *IncompatibleFiles[Idx]);
6689 }
6690
6691 // Build the error message for the dialog box
6692 FString ModulesList = "The following modules are missing or built with a different engine version:\n\n";
6693
6694 int NumModulesToDisplay = (IncompatibleFiles.Num() <= 20)? IncompatibleFiles.Num() : 15;
6695 for (int Idx = 0; Idx < NumModulesToDisplay; Idx++)
6696 {
6697 ModulesList += FString::Printf(TEXT(" %s\n"), *IncompatibleFiles[Idx]);
6698 }
6699 if(IncompatibleFiles.Num() > NumModulesToDisplay)
6700 {
6701 ModulesList += FString::Printf(TEXT(" (+%d others, see log for details)\n"), IncompatibleFiles.Num() - NumModulesToDisplay);
6702 }
6703
6704 // If we're running with -stdout, assume that we're a non interactive process and about to fail
6705 if (FApp::IsUnattended() || FParse::Param(FCommandLine::Get(), TEXT("stdout")))
6706 {
6707 return false;
6708 }
6709
6710 // If there are any engine modules that need building, force the user to build through the IDE
6711 if(IncompatibleEngineFiles.Num() > 0)
6712 {
6713 FString CompileForbidden = ModulesList + TEXT("\nEngine modules cannot be compiled at runtime. Please build through your IDE.");
6714 FPlatformMisc::MessageBoxExt(EAppMsgType::Ok, *CompileForbidden, TEXT("Missing Modules"));
6715 return false;
6716 }
6717
6718 // Ask whether to compile before continuing
6719 FString CompilePrompt = ModulesList + TEXT("\nWould you like to rebuild them now?");
6720 if (FPlatformMisc::MessageBoxExt(EAppMsgType::YesNo, *CompilePrompt, *FString::Printf(TEXT("Missing %s Modules"), FApp::GetProjectName())) == EAppReturnType::Yes)
6721 {
6722 bNeedCompile = true;
6723 }
6724 else
6725 {
6726 FString ProceedWithoutCompilePrompt = ModulesList + TEXT("\nWould you like to proceed anyway? Code and content that depends on these modules may not work correctly. Enter at your own risk.");
6727 if (FPlatformMisc::MessageBoxExt(EAppMsgType::YesNo, *ProceedWithoutCompilePrompt, *FString::Printf(TEXT("Missing %s Modules"), FApp::GetProjectName())) == EAppReturnType::No)
6728 {
6729 return false;
6730 }
6731 }
6732 }
6733 else if(EditorTargetFileName.Len() > 0 && !FPaths::FileExists(EditorTargetFileName))
6734 {
6735 // Prompt to compile. The target file isn't essential, but we
6736 if (FPlatformMisc::MessageBoxExt(EAppMsgType::YesNo, *FString::Printf(TEXT("The %s file does not exist. Would you like to build the editor?"), *FPaths::GetCleanFilename(EditorTargetFileName)), TEXT("Missing target file")) == EAppReturnType::Yes)
6737 {
6738 bNeedCompile = true;
6739 }
6740 }
6741 }
6742
6743 FEmbeddedCommunication::ForceTick(16);
6744
6745 if(bNeedCompile)
6746 {
6747 // Try to compile it
6748 FFeedbackContext *Context = (FFeedbackContext*)FDesktopPlatformModule::Get()->GetNativeFeedbackContext();
6749 Context->BeginSlowTask(FText::FromString(TEXT("Starting build...")), true, true);
6750 ECompilationResult::Type CompilationResult = ECompilationResult::Unknown;
6751 bool bCompileResult = FDesktopPlatformModule::Get()->CompileGameProject(FPaths::RootDir(), FPaths::GetProjectFilePath(), Context, &CompilationResult);
6752 Context->EndSlowTask();
6753
6754 // Check if we're running the wrong executable now
6755 if(bCompileResult && LaunchCorrectEditorExecutable(EditorTargetFileName))
6756 {
6757 return false;
6758 }
6759
6760 // Check if we needed to modify engine files
6761 if (!bCompileResult && CompilationResult == ECompilationResult::FailedDueToEngineChange)
6762 {
6763 FPlatformMisc::MessageBoxExt(EAppMsgType::Ok, TEXT("Engine modules are out of date, and cannot be compiled while the engine is running. Please build through your IDE."), TEXT("Missing Modules"));
6764 return false;
6765 }
6766
6767 // Get a list of modules which are still incompatible
6768 TArray<FString> StillIncompatibleFiles;
6769 ProjectManager.CheckModuleCompatibility(StillIncompatibleFiles);
6770
6771 TArray<FString> StillIncompatibleEngineFiles;
6772 PluginManager.CheckModuleCompatibility(StillIncompatibleFiles, StillIncompatibleEngineFiles);
6773
6774 if(!bCompileResult || StillIncompatibleFiles.Num() > 0)
6775 {
6776 for (int Idx = 0; Idx < StillIncompatibleFiles.Num(); Idx++)
6777 {
6778 UE_LOGF(LogInit, Warning, "Still incompatible or missing module: %ls", *StillIncompatibleFiles[Idx]);
6779 }
6780 if (!FApp::IsUnattended())
6781 {
6782 FPlatformMisc::MessageBoxExt(EAppMsgType::Ok, *FString::Printf(TEXT("%s could not be compiled. Try rebuilding from source manually."), FApp::GetProjectName()), TEXT("Error"));
6783 }
6784 return false;
6785 }
6786 }
6787 }
6788#endif
6789
6790 // Put the command line and config info into the suppression system (before plugins start loading)
6791 FLogSuppressionInterface::Get().ProcessConfigAndCommandLine();
6792
6793#if WITH_APPLICATION_CORE && (PLATFORM_IOS || PLATFORM_TVOS)
6794 // Now that the config system is ready, init the audio system.
6795 [[IOSAppDelegate GetDelegate] InitializeAudioSession];
6796#endif
6797
6798 // Show log if wanted.
6799 if (GLogConsole && FParse::Param(FCommandLine::Get(), TEXT("LOG")))
6800 {
6801 GLogConsole->Show(true);
6802 }
6803
6804
6805 // NOTE: This is the earliest place to init the online subsystems (via plugins)
6806 // Code needs GConfigFile to be valid
6807 // Must be after FThreadStats::StartThread();
6808 // Must be before Render/RHI subsystem D3DCreate() for platform services that need D3D hooks like Steam
6809
6810 {
6811 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("Load pre-init plugin modules");
6812 UE_SCOPED_ENGINE_ACTIVITY(TEXT("Loading Plugins (PreInit)"));
6813
6814 // Load "pre-init" plugin modules
6815 if (!ProjectManager.LoadModulesForProject(ELoadingPhase::PostConfigInit) || !PluginManager.LoadModulesForEnabledPlugins(ELoadingPhase::PostConfigInit))
6816 {
6817 return false;
6818 }
6819 }
6820
6821 FEmbeddedCommunication::ForceTick(17);
6822
6823 // after the above has run we now have the REQUIRED set of engine .INIs (all of the other .INIs)
6824 // that are gotten from .h files' config() are not requires and are dynamically loaded when the .u files are loaded
6825
6826#if !UE_BUILD_SHIPPING
6827 // Prompt the user for remote debugging?
6828 bool bPromptForRemoteDebug = false;
6829 GConfig->GetBool(TEXT("Engine.ErrorHandling"), TEXT("bPromptForRemoteDebugging"), bPromptForRemoteDebug, GEngineIni);
6830 bool bPromptForRemoteDebugOnEnsure = false;
6831 GConfig->GetBool(TEXT("Engine.ErrorHandling"), TEXT("bPromptForRemoteDebugOnEnsure"), bPromptForRemoteDebugOnEnsure, GEngineIni);
6832
6833 if (FParse::Param(FCommandLine::Get(), TEXT("PROMPTREMOTEDEBUG")))
6834 {
6835 bPromptForRemoteDebug = true;
6836 }
6837
6838 if (FParse::Param(FCommandLine::Get(), TEXT("PROMPTREMOTEDEBUGENSURE")))
6839 {
6840 bPromptForRemoteDebug = true;
6841 bPromptForRemoteDebugOnEnsure = true;
6842 }
6843
6844 FPlatformMisc::SetShouldPromptForRemoteDebugging(bPromptForRemoteDebug);
6845 FPlatformMisc::SetShouldPromptForRemoteDebugOnEnsure(bPromptForRemoteDebugOnEnsure);
6846
6847 // Feedback context.
6848 if (FParse::Param(FCommandLine::Get(), TEXT("WARNINGSASERRORS")))
6849 {
6850 GWarn->TreatWarningsAsErrors = true;
6851 }
6852
6853 if (FParse::Param(FCommandLine::Get(), TEXT("ERRORSASWARNINGS")))
6854 {
6855 GWarn->TreatErrorsAsWarnings = true;
6856 }
6857
6858 if (FParse::Param(FCommandLine::Get(), TEXT("SILENT")))

6860 GIsSilent = true;

6863 if (FParse::Param(FCommandLine::Get(), TEXT("RUNNINGUNATTENDEDSCRIPT")))

6865 GIsRunningUnattendedScript = true;
6866 }
6867
6868#endif // !UE_BUILD_SHIPPING

6871 FApp::PrintStartupLogMessages();

6873 // if a logging build, clear out old log files. Avoid races when multiple processes are running at once.
6874#if !NO_LOGGING

6881#if !UE_BUILD_SHIPPING

6883 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("FApp::InitializeSession");
6884 FApp::InitializeSession();

6886#endif

6888#if PLATFORM_USE_PLATFORM_FILE_MANAGED_STORAGE_WRAPPER

6890 FPersistentStorageManager::Get().Initialize();

6892
6893 // Checks.
6894 static_assert(sizeof(uint8) == 1);
6895 static_assert(sizeof(int8) == 1);
6896 static_assert(sizeof(uint16) == 2);
6897 static_assert(sizeof(uint32) == 4);
6898 static_assert(sizeof(uint64) == 8);
6899 static_assert(sizeof(ANSICHAR) == 1);
6900 static_assert(sizeof(TCHAR) == 2);
6901 static_assert(sizeof(int16) == 2);
6902 static_assert(sizeof(int32) == 4);
6903 static_assert(sizeof(int64) == 8);

6912 GConfig->GetBool(TEXT("AutomationTesting"), TEXT("bForceSmokeTests"), bForceSmokeTests, GEngineIni);
6913 bForceSmokeTests |= FParse::Param(FCommandLine::Get(), TEXT("bForceSmokeTests"));
6914 FAutomationTestFramework::Get().SetForceSmokeTests(bForceSmokeTests);
6915
6916 FEmbeddedCommunication::ForceTick(18);
6917
6918 // Init other systems.
6919 {
6920 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("FCoreDelegates::OnInit");
6921 FCoreDelegates::OnInit.Broadcast();
6922 }
6923
6924 FEmbeddedCommunication::ForceTick(19);
6925
6926 return true;

6929void FEngineLoop::AppPreExit( )
6930{
6931 SCOPED_BOOT_TIMING("AppPreExit");
6932
6933 UE_LOGF(LogExit, Log, "Preparing to exit." );
6934
6935 {
6936 SCOPED_NAMED_EVENT_TEXT("FCoreDelegates::OnPreExit", CoreDelegatesColor);
6937 FCoreDelegates::OnPreExit.Broadcast();
6938 }
6939
6940#if WITH_EDITOR
6941 FRemoteConfig::Flush();
6942#endif
6943
6944 {
6945 SCOPED_NAMED_EVENT_TEXT("FCoreDelegates::OnExit", CoreDelegatesColor);
6946 FCoreDelegates::OnExit.Broadcast();
6947 }
6948
6949 // FGenericRHIGPUFence uses GFrameNumberRenderThread to tell when a frame is finished. If such an object is added in the last frame before we
6950 // exit, it will never be "signaled", since nothing ever increments GFrameNumberRenderThread again. This can lead to deadlocks in code
6951 // which uses async tasks to wait until resources are safe to be deleted (for example, FMediaTextureResource).
6952 // To avoid this, we set the frame number to the maximum possible value here, before waiting for the thread pool to die. It's safe to do so
6953 // because FlushRenderingCommands() is called multiple times on exit before reaching this point, so there's no way the render thread has any
6954 // more frames in flight.
6955 GFrameNumberRenderThread = MAX_uint32;
6956
6957 if (GIOThreadPool != nullptr)
6958 {
6959 GIOThreadPool->Destroy();
6960 }
6961
6962#if (WITH_VERSE_VM || defined(__INTELLISENSE__)) && WITH_COREUOBJECT
6963 Verse::VerseVM::Shutdown();
6964#endif
6965
6966#if WITH_ENGINE
6967 if ( GShaderCompilingManager )
6968 {
6969 delete GShaderCompilingManager;
6970 GShaderCompilingManager = nullptr;
6971 }
6972 if(GShaderCompilerStats)
6973 {
6974 delete GShaderCompilerStats;
6975 GShaderCompilerStats = nullptr;
6976 }
6977
6978#if WITH_ODSC
6979 if (GODSCManager)
6980 {
6981 delete GODSCManager;
6982 GODSCManager = nullptr;
6983 }
6984#endif
6985
6986#else
6987#if WITH_COREUOBJECT
6988 // Shutdown the PackageResourceManager in AppPreExit for programs that do not call FEngineLoop::Exit
6989 IPackageResourceManager::Shutdown();
6990#endif
6991#endif
6992
6993}

7070void FEngineLoop::PreInitHMDDevice()
7071{
7072#if WITH_ENGINE && !UE_SERVER
7073 if (!FParse::Param(FCommandLine::Get(), TEXT("nohmd")) && !FParse::Param(FCommandLine::Get(), TEXT("emulatestereo")))
7074 {
7075 // Get a list of modules that implement this feature
7076 FName Type = IHeadMountedDisplayModule::GetModularFeatureName();
7077 IModularFeatures& ModularFeatures = IModularFeatures::Get();
7078 TArray<IHeadMountedDisplayModule*> HMDModules = ModularFeatures.GetModularFeatureImplementations<IHeadMountedDisplayModule>(Type);
7079
7080 // Check whether the user passed in an explicit HMD module on the command line
7081 FString ExplicitHMDName;
7082 bool bUseExplicitHMDName = FParse::Value(FCommandLine::Get(), TEXT("hmd="), ExplicitHMDName);
7083
7084 // Iterate over modules, checking ExplicitHMDName and calling PreInit
7085 for (auto HMDModuleIt = HMDModules.CreateIterator(); HMDModuleIt; ++HMDModuleIt)
7086 {
7087 IHeadMountedDisplayModule* HMDModule = *HMDModuleIt;
7088
7089
7090 bool bUnregisterHMDModule = false;
7091 if (bUseExplicitHMDName)
7092 {
7093 TArray<FString> HMDAliases;
7094 HMDModule->GetModuleAliases(HMDAliases);
7095 HMDAliases.Add(HMDModule->GetModuleKeyName());
7096
7097 bUnregisterHMDModule = true;
7098 for (const FString& HMDModuleName : HMDAliases)
7099 {
7100 if (ExplicitHMDName.Equals(HMDModuleName, ESearchCase::IgnoreCase))
7101 {
7102 bUnregisterHMDModule = !HMDModule->PreInit();
7103 break;
7104 }
7105 }
7106 }
7107 else
7108 {
7109 bUnregisterHMDModule = !HMDModule->PreInit();
7110 }
7111
7112 if (bUnregisterHMDModule)
7113 {
7114 // Unregister modules which don't match ExplicitHMDName, or which fail PreInit
7115 ModularFeatures.UnregisterModularFeature(Type, HMDModule);
7116 }
7117 }
7118 // Note we do not disable or warn here if no HMD modules matched ExplicitHMDName, as not all HMD plugins have been loaded yet.
7119 }
7120#endif // #if WITH_ENGINE && !UE_SERVER
7121}
